source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... RUN NAKED FOR TWO MILES.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……裸奔两英里。

source: Luckily it's nighttime, and nobody sees you except the deer and possums on the side of the road.
target: 幸好是晚上,除了路边的鹿和负鼠,没人看见你

source: Those deer and possums seem to be looking at your naked body a little judgmentally, though...
target: 不过，那些鹿和负鼠看你裸体的眼神，似乎有点嫌弃……

source: But the embarrassment is nothing compared to your exhaustion after sprinting so much.
target: 可比起狂奔这么久后的筋疲力尽，那点尴尬根本不算什么。

source: Jeez, this might've been a wake-up call to hit the gym more. At least you got +XX PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 天啊，这也许是在提醒你：该多去健身房了。至少你赚到了 +XX 恶作剧币！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... TAKE A SELFIE WITH A STRANGER.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……跟一个陌生人自拍。

source: You approach an old woman at the convenience store and ask her to take a selfie with you. She agrees.
target: 你走向便利店里的一位老太太，请她一起自拍。她答应了。

source: "We look so nice!" she says. "Can you help me put this on the internets so my grandson can see?"
target: “我们拍得真好看！”她说，“能帮我发到网上，让我孙子看看吗？”

source: Teaching this lady to use social media becomes a thirty-minute commitment, but she thanks you by giving you some hard candy from her purse!
target: 教她用社交媒体，足足花了你半小时。不过，她从包里掏出几颗硬糖，向你道谢！

source: You gain +XX PRANK DOLLARZ and +1 NEW GRANDMA.
target: 你获得 +XX 恶作剧币，以及 +1 位新奶奶。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... CLUCK LIKE A CHICKEN FOR AN HOUR.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……学鸡叫，叫上一个小时。

source: You can do that! How hard can it be? CLUCK-CLUCK!
target: 这有何难！咯咯！

source: Polly corrects you: it's more like CAW! CA-CAW! CA-CAW! CA-CAW!
target: 波莉纠正你：应该是嘎！嘎——嘎！嘎——嘎！嘎——嘎！

source: Scott chimes in with a suggestion of his own: CHAW! CHEE-CHAW! CHEE-CHAW!
target: 斯科特也插嘴，提出自己的版本：喳！叽——喳！叽——喳！

source: A stranger appears from nowhere to comment that he thinks it's more like: COO-COO-CA-CHAW! COO-COO-CA-CHAW!
target: 一个陌生人不知从哪儿冒出来，表示应该这样叫：咕咕——嘎喳！咕咕——嘎喳！

source: This experience has taught you nothing about how chickens cluck, but at the very least you got your +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 这番折腾并没教会你鸡到底怎么叫，不过，至少你赚到了 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... EAT A HANDFUL OF SAND.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……吃一把沙子。

source: It's pretty unpleasant, especially when you hear a loud crunching sound and realize you just ate a buried animal skull!
target: 滋味实在不好受。尤其是咔嚓一声响后，你发现自己还吃了个埋在沙里的动物头骨！

source: You hear a voice in your head: "Thank you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. With my soul no longer bound to these bones, I'm finally free to continue to the next life..."
target: 脑海里响起一个声音：“谢谢你，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。灵魂终于摆脱了这些骨头的束缚，我可以自由地走向来世了……”

source: Cool! Your mouth is super dry now, but at least you helped a little mouse shed its mortal coil, and gained +XX PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 不错！虽然嘴巴干得要命，但你至少帮一只小老鼠摆脱了肉身，还获得 +XX 恶作剧币！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... SMELL SCOTT'S SHOES.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……闻斯科特的鞋。

source: You take a whiff. They smell like sweat and feet, predictably...
target: 你凑近一闻。果然，是汗味和脚臭……

source: ...but also like peanut butter, beef jerky, sugar cookies, and spaghetti sauce. WTF?
target: ……不过，还有花生酱、牛肉干、糖饼干和意面酱的味道。什么鬼？

source: It turns out Scott's been storing his emergency snacks in his shoes... the same ones he's been sharing with you throughout the road trip... great...
target: 原来，斯科特一直把应急零食藏在鞋里……就是这一路上分给你吃的那些……真棒啊……

source: You gain +1 DISGUSTING REVELATION and +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 你获得 +1 个恶心的发现，以及 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... PRETEND TO BE KIDNAPPED.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……假装被绑架。

source: Finally, those improv classes will come in handy! You get in the trunk, put on a blindfold, and start sobbing dramatically.
target: 终于，即兴表演课派上用场了！你钻进后备箱，戴上眼罩，开始哭得撕心裂肺。

source: When some concerned bystanders come check on you, you tearfully tell them you're the %SONDAUGHTER% of a wealthy oil baron being held for ransom.
target: 几个担心你的路人过来查看，你泪眼汪汪地告诉他们：自己是富有的石油大亨的%SONDAUGHTER%，绑匪正向家里勒索赎金。

source: The cops that are called don't see the humor in this "great dare", but hey, all the best actors have haters. You gain +XX PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 闻讯赶来的警察，可不觉得这个“精彩挑战”好笑。不过，最优秀的演员总会有黑粉嘛。你获得 +XX 恶作剧币！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... DUMPSTER DIVE.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……钻垃圾箱寻宝。

source: It's a bold move, especially since you don't know when you're going to take your next shower...
target: 这是一个大胆的举动, 特别是你不知道 你什么时候要洗澡... ...

source: But it's also a profitable one, because you find half of a name-brand shoe, a tub of barely-expired queso, and some cool dentures! Score!
target: 不过，收获也不小：半只名牌鞋、一桶刚过期的奶酪蘸酱，还有一副酷假牙！赚到了！

source: You gain +3 USELESS JUNK and +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 你获得 +3 件没用的破烂，以及 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... GET A HAIRCUT FROM POLLY.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……让波莉给你剪头发。

source: Letting your friend who's currently chugging tequila and twerking on a picnic table cut your hair doesn't seem like a smart idea...
target: 你那位朋友正猛灌龙舌兰，在野餐桌上扭屁股。让她给你剪头发，听起来可不太聪明……

source: But hey, you didn't tag along on this road trip because you're known for your smart ideas!
target: 不过，你加入这趟旅行，本来也不是因为出了名的聪明啊！

source: The haircut Polly gives you is certainly something... something you're glad you can cover up with that wig you packed that's identical to your former haircut.
target: 波莉剪出的发型，确实很有……特色。幸好，你带的假发跟原来的发型一模一样，正好能遮住。

source: At least you gained some memories and +XX PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 至少，回忆有了，+XX 恶作剧币也赚到了！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... PRETEND TO BE DRUNK ALL NIGHT.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……装醉一整晚。

source: You do your best to stumble around and slur your words, but Polly's an old pro at being drunk and isn't convinced.
target: 你竭力走得东倒西歪，说话含含糊糊。但波莉可是醉酒老手，根本不信。

source: The two of you decide it'd be best if you researched your role... by getting really drunk all night.
target: 你们决定，最好深入体验一下这个角色……于是，真的喝了个通宵。

source: You'll regret this in the morning, but for now, this is the best dare EVER. You gain +XX PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 明早你肯定会后悔，不过此刻，这简直是史上最棒的挑战。你获得 +XX 恶作剧币！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... MARRY A STRAY CAT.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……跟一只流浪猫结婚。

source: Apparently Polly became an ordained minister some months ago while she was high.
target: 波莉似乎在几个月前嗨着的时候，取得了牧师资格。

source: She finds a random cat wandering the desert and marries you two.
target: 她在沙漠里随便找了只游荡的猫，给你们证了婚。

source: This is heavier than you expected. Your life has changed forever. Also, the cat seems to have four kittens who are now officially your stepkittens. Was this all a huge mistake?
target: 这事比你想的严重。你的人生永远改变了。而且，那猫似乎还有四只小猫，现在正式成了你的继子女。是不是犯了个天大的错误？

source: A few hours later, Polly tells you she was crossing her fingers while marrying you, so the marriage is void. Phew! You still get +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 几小时后，波莉说，证婚时她偷偷交叉了手指，所以婚姻无效。呼！你依然得到 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... WEAR A LEASH AND WALK ON ALL FOURS.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……套上牵引绳，四肢着地走路。

source: You shamelessly let your friends collar you and parade you around the rest stop.
target: 你毫不害臊地让朋友们给你戴上项圈，牵着你在休息站招摇过市。

source: Everyone stares at you. Parents cover their children's eyes. Someone snaps a photo that you're sure you'll see on WeirdosAtRestStops.com later.
target: 所有人都盯着你。家长捂住孩子的眼睛。还有人拍了照，你确信以后能在 WeirdosAtRestStops.com 上看到。

source: If you didn't have this kink before, you definitely do now. You gain +XX PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 原本没有这性癖的话，现在肯定有了。你获得 +XX 恶作剧币！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... POST A SCREENSHOT OF YOUR SEARCH HISTORY.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……把搜索记录截图发出去。

source: Your last searches include an ointment for... well, for something people will soon know about.
target: 最近的搜索里，有种药膏，是用来治……好吧，大家很快就会知道了。

source: There's also a search to double-check how to... spell your own name.
target: 你还搜过，确认该怎么……拼自己的名字。

source: Yeah, today is a dark day for your reputation, but at least you gained +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 是啊，今天你的名声可算毁了。不过，至少获得 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... PRETEND TO BE A BATHROOM INSPECTOR.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……冒充厕所检查员。

source: You go to the convenience store and grade their bathroom on cleanliness, smell, availability of toilet paper, and flush strength.
target: 你去便利店，按清洁度、气味、厕纸供应和冲水力度，给厕所打了分。

source: They score abysmally, and you threaten to "tell corporate", so the manager bribes you with unlimited free restroom breaks at all locations!
target: 成绩糟透了。你威胁要“报告总部”，经理便贿赂你：以后所有分店的厕所，都可以无限次免费上！

source: Seems redundant, since you didn't have to pay to use the restroom here anyway... but hey, you still got your +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 似乎没什么用，毕竟本来就不用花钱……不过，你还是获得了 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... LICK YOUR ELBOW.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……舔自己的手肘。

source: You try for several minutes, but are unsuccessful in licking your elbow.
target: 你尝试了几分钟,但是舔你的肘部不成功。

source: But you refuse to take the L on this dare, so you dislocate your shoulder and tongue that elbow like there's no tomorrow!
target: 可你不肯认输，干脆弄脱臼了肩膀，抱着豁出去的劲头，把手肘舔了个够！

source: Yup, totally worth it. You gain +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 对，太值了。你获得 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... HITCHHIKE FOR FIVE MILES.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……搭便车走五英里。

source: You hitch a ride with a nice woman who calls herself "Hack-n-Slash Harriet." Man, you wish you had such a cool nickname!
target: 你搭上一位亲切女士的车，她自称“砍砍杀杀哈丽特”。天啊，你也想有这么酷的外号！

source: She regales you with stories of all the prisons she's escaped and how she acquired all of the skulls in her backseat.
target: 她兴致勃勃地讲起，自己逃出过多少监狱，后座那些头骨又是怎么弄来的。

source: What a fascinating woman! You gain +1 NEW FRIEND and +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 真是位迷人的女士！你获得 +1 位新朋友，以及 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... TELL A STRANGER A JOKE.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……给一个陌生人讲笑话。

source: You approach a leather-clad motorcyclist smoking a cigarette and say, "Why did the bike fall over? Because it was TWO TIRED!"
target: 你走向一位穿皮衣、正抽烟的摩托车手，说：“自行车为什么倒了？因为它两个轮胎都‘胎’累了！”
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 完整挑战为向陌生骑手讲冷笑话；两个轮胎／胎累已呈现 two tires／too tired，保留已有可理解的冷笑话。

source: The biker stares at you for a long moment. You wonder if you're about to get shanked.
target: 他盯了你半天。你开始担心，是不是要挨一刀了。

source: Then he absolutely GUFFAWS with laughter. Doubled-over, tears-streaming-down-his-face laughter. Holy shit, you didn't think you were THAT funny.
target: 接着，他爆发出大笑，笑得弯下腰，眼泪顺着脸流。卧槽，连你自己都没觉得这么好笑。

source: "Thanks, kid! I really needed that laugh. You're all right."
target: “谢谢，小伙子！我正需要这么笑一场。你这人不错。”

source: He offers to let you bum a cigarette. Wow, that's the biker equivalent of true friendship! You gain +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 他递给你一根烟。哇，这对机车党来说，就是真正的友谊！你获得 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... DO SOME GRAFFITI.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……涂鸦。

source: But what should you graffiti? "%CURRENTPLAYERNAME% wuz here"? "Naruto x Garfield 5ever"? The Cool S?
target: 涂什么呢？“%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%到此一游”？“鸣人×加菲猫，永远再加一！”？还是那个酷酷的S？
notes: pending review 109 (2026-10-22): KEEP; 完整涂鸦情境；永远再加一已表达 5ever 比 4ever 多一的夸张，旧备注五生五世已过时。

source: No, you wanna be outside the box. You decide to graffiti the first scene of the screenplay you've been writing.
target: 不，你要跳出框框。你决定把自己正在写的剧本的第一场，涂到墙上。

source: Hopefully a movie producer will be smoking a cigarette by the dumpster one day and recognize your creative genius!
target: 但愿哪天，有个制片人在垃圾箱旁抽烟，顺便发现了你的创作天赋！

source: But until that happens, at least you got +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 在那之前，至少先拿到 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... EAT A RAW EGG.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……吃一个生鸡蛋。

source: You point out that you don't have access to a raw egg, but apparently Scott's been keeping one in his pocket all this time for this very occasion.
target: 你说手头没有生鸡蛋，结果斯科特一直在口袋里揣着一个，就为了这种时候。

source: Wow, look at Scott being proactive and insightful!
target: 哇，看看斯科特，多主动，多有远见！

source: The egg's totally rotten by now, but still, it's the thought that counts. You gain +XX PRANK DOLLARZ and +1 SALMONELLA.
target: 鸡蛋早就臭了，不过，心意才重要嘛。你获得 +XX 恶作剧币，以及 +1 沙门氏菌。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... POUR ICE DOWN YOUR PANTS.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……往裤子里倒冰块。

source: Not only do you freeze your junk, but now it looks like you have a big pee stain.
target: 不光下面冻得够呛，裤子上还湿了一大片，看起来像尿了。

source: Since it's too late to save your reputation anyway, you decide to pee your pants a little to warm yourself up.
target: 既然现在要挽救你的名声已经太迟了, 你决定尿裤子来取暖。

source: You have to sit on some newspaper before Polly will let you in the car again, but at least you gained +XX PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 你得先垫上报纸，波莉才肯让你再上车。不过，至少获得 +XX 恶作剧币！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... COUNT EVERY GRAIN OF SAND AT THE REST STOP.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……数完休息站里的每一粒沙子。

source: You pull out your abacus and get started. 1... 2... 3... 4... 5...
By the time you've counted 1,558 grains of sand, your friends have all gone to bed.
target: 数到 1,558 粒时，你的朋友们全去睡觉了。

source: When you've reached 14,470, the sun has risen and the convenience store employees are taking bets on how long you'll stay out there.
target: 数到 14,470 粒时，太阳已经升起，便利店员工开始打赌：你还要在外面待多久。

source: When you reach 32,621, you get distracted by a cute pigeon, lose count, and have to start over.
target: 数到 32,621 粒时，一只可爱的鸽子让你分了心。数忘了，只能重新开始。

source: Polly goes ahead and awards you the +XX PRANK DOLLARZ out of pity (and a strong desire to leave already). Worth it!
target: 波莉实在可怜你，也实在想走了，干脆把 +XX 恶作剧币发给你。值了！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... USE MAYONNAISE AS DEODORANT.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……把蛋黄酱当除臭剂用。

source: Five minutes later, you smell like the world's sweatiest deli.
target: 五分钟后，你闻起来像全世界汗味最重的熟食店。

source: You later wipe off the mayonnaise with some ham slices and have the grossest ham sandwich you've ever eaten.
target: 后来，你用几片火腿擦掉蛋黄酱，做出了这辈子吃过最恶心的火腿三明治。

source: But hey, waste not, want not! (Because you definitely DON'T want to eat that again.) You gain +XX PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 不过，不浪费就不缺吃的！（而你绝对不想再吃这个了。）你获得 +XX 恶作剧币！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... NARRATE EVERYTHING YOU DO ALOUD FOR THE REST OF THE NIGHT.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……今晚接下来做的每件事，都大声配上旁白。

source: Which is great for me, because now I get a night off!
target: 这可太好了，我今晚能休假了！

source: Goodbye, I'm off to take a hot bath and read the latest chapter of Dragon Heat. Enjoy your +XX PRANK DOLLARZ!
target: 再见，我去泡热水澡，读《Dragon Heat》最新一章了。好好享受你的 +XX 恶作剧币吧！

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... HOWL LIKE A WOLF FOR FIVE MINUTES STRAIGHT.
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……学狼嚎，连续嚎五分钟。

source: You try, but you just don't have the lung capacity to pull it off. Curse your weak lungs!
target: 你试了，可肺活量根本不够。该死的弱肺！

source: Luckily, Scott's an old pro at it, so he coaches you until you two are howling at the moon with the best of them. It's fun!
target: 好在斯科特是个老手。在他的指导下，你们终于能像高手一样对月长嚎了。真好玩！

source: Scott offers to teach you how to scratch your ear with your hind leg later. Awesome! You gain +XX PRANK DOLLARZ.
target: 斯科特说，之后还能教你用后腿挠耳朵。太棒了！你获得 +XX 恶作剧币。

source: You check Polly's dare list and decide to... GROW YOUR FINGERNAILS BACKWARDS. What a feat!
target: 你翻了翻波莉的挑战清单，决定……让指甲倒着长。好个壮举！

source: You concentrate really hard, exercising mind over matter, channeling all your magic and energy into this one goal...

source: I understand. Would it help you to practice in front of an audience?
target: 明白。要是有个观众看着你练习，会不会有帮助？

source: Ooh, you wanna watch? I'm flattered!
target: 哦，你想看？真让我受宠若惊！

source: You listen to the Lamb's sermon... which, it turns out, involves a lot of lamb sounds, eldritch chanting, and bleeding from the eyes.
target: 你听羔羊布道……这布道居然包含大量的羊叫、诡异的吟唱，还有眼睛出血。

source: It's so cool to see the Lamb in their element! Look at that little god go!
target: 看羔羊这么如鱼得水，真是太酷了！瞧这小神祇，多起劲！

source: Oh, hey %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. What's up?
target: 哦，嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。怎么了？

source: You wanna hang out? Eh... sorry, I'm not in the mood tonight.
target: 你想出去玩吗? 额... 对不起,我今晚没心情

source: I'm sorta worn out from socializing. I planned on cleaning out my weapons inventory tonight.
target: 最近社交太多，有点累了。我打算今晚整理一下武器物品栏。

source: We can talk some other time... maybe.
target: 我们改天再谈... 也许吧。

source: You come upon Aaravi laser-focused on playing a handheld game.
target: 你走近阿拉维，发现她正全神贯注地玩掌机。

source: FUCK! SO CLOSE!
target: 操！就差一点！

source: Oh, hey %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Sorry, I can't hang out tonight.
target: 哦，嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。抱歉，今晚没法陪你玩了。

source: Apparently some chucklefuck beat my speedrunning record on one of my favorite video games, which is an insult I can't let slide!
target: 有个傻逼破了我最喜欢的一款游戏的速通纪录，这口气我可咽不下去！

source: No offense, but can you go somewhere else? Having someone breathe down my neck while I game makes me lose focus. Thanks.
target: 无意冒犯，不过你能去别处待着吗？我玩游戏时，有人在背后盯着就没法集中精神。谢了。

source: Ah. Hello, Friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 啊。你好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%朋友。

source: By my calculations, the probability that you are here to converse is 99.9%. If that is the case, I must decline.
target: 据我计算，你前来交谈的概率为99.9%。如果是这样，我必须拒绝。

source: I've been having quite intense conversations lately, and my CPU is still processing all that data.
target: 最近的交谈信息量很大，我的CPU仍在处理那些数据。

source: Here, have this stick I found in the ground. The internet says there are many fun activities you can do with such a stick.
target: 给，这是我在地上捡到的一根棍子。据互联网所说，用它可以进行许多有趣的活动。

source: Some of them you would never expect... but I won't spoil it for you, my dear friend!
target: 其中一些，你绝对想不到……不过，我就不为你剧透了，亲爱的朋友！

source: You spend the night playing with the stick. Fun...?
target: 你玩了一晚上的棍子。挺有趣……吧？

source: What is it, Friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? Do you wish to spend quality time together?
target: 怎么了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%朋友？你想和我共度美好时光吗？

source: My apologies, but I already have plans this evening.
target: 抱歉,我今晚已经有计划了

source: I am going to observe this cactus over a period of twelve hours and record its rate of growth in millimeters per minute!
target: 我要连续观察这株仙人掌十二个小时，并以毫米每分钟为单位，记录它的生长速度！

source: So... you'd rather watch plants grow than hang out with me?
target: 所以说... 你宁可看植物生长 也不愿和我在一起?

source: Precisely! Thank you so much for understanding. Farewell, my friend.
target: 没错! 非常感谢你的理解 再见,我的朋友。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Sorry, but I'm not in the mood to hang out tonight.
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。抱歉，今晚没心情跟你玩。

source: I had a long talk with %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% the other day... and now I've got all these... like... feelings 'n' shit?
target: 前几天我跟%PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER%聊了很久……现在心里全是些……什么……感情啊之类的破事？

source: I don't really know how to process it. I think I'm gonna go set a fire about it.
target: 我真不知道该怎么处理。想来想去，还是去放把火吧。

source: Oh, okay... could I help you set the fire at least?
target: 哦，好吧……那至少能让我帮你放火吗？

source: Nah, sorry noob; this is a one-man fire kinda night. Maybe next time.
target: 不了，抱歉啊，菜鸟。今晚这火得我一个人放。下次吧。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. As you can see, tonight I'm setting stuff on fire.
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。如你所见，我今晚正忙着烧东西。

source: Ah, great! I'd love to sit and chat and get to know more about your fiery passion for fire...
target: 啊，太好了！我正想坐下来聊聊，多了解一下你对火焰那炽热的热情……

source: NO. I didn't say tonight is a TALK night; I said tonight is a SET STUFF ON FIRE night. Don't you listen?
target: 不行。我可没说今晚是聊天之夜，我说的是放火烧东西之夜。你没听见吗？

source: But--!
target: 不过...

source: Before you can articulate anything, you realize Damien has set your pants on fire.
target: 你还没来得及说什么，就发现德魔已经点着了你的裤子。

source: It seems tonight will be a PUT OUT THE FIRE ON YOUR PANTS night. Sigh.
target: 看来，你今晚要过的是“给裤子灭火之夜”了。唉。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! What's wrong? Is someone in trouble? Is there villainy afoot?!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！出什么事了？有人遇到麻烦了？有坏蛋在作恶？！

source: Nope, not that I know of. I just wanted to hang out with you.
target: 没有，至少我没听说。我只是想找你玩。

source: Oh... well, sorry, I can't. I have a feeling something bad's going to happen tonight. I need to be ready!
target: 哦……抱歉，不行。我有种预感，今晚要出事。我得做好准备！

source: Really? But it's a calm, warm night, and there isn't even anyone else around...
target: 真的？可今晚风平浪静，又这么暖和，附近连别人都没有……

source: Yeah, but you know how it is: evil never sleeps, a hero's work is never done, constant vigilance, etc.
target: 是啊，可你也知道：邪恶从不休息，英雄的工作永无止境，时刻保持警惕，诸如此类。

source: Don't be sad. If there ever comes a day when I've finally defeated all the evil in the world, maybe I'll call you.
target: 别难过。等哪天我终于消灭了世上所有邪恶，也许会给你打个电话。

source: You find Joy reading a book and listening to her headphones. You wait patiently for her to notice you.
target: 你发现乔伊正戴着耳机看书。你耐心地等她注意到你。

source: Hmm, she doesn't seem to have noticed you yet. Only one thing to do: keep waiting!
target: 嗯，她好像还没注意到你。那就只有一个办法：继续等！

source: I see you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I was hoping to avoid this by politely ignoring you, but since you're relentless:
target: 我看见你了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。我本来想礼貌地装没看见，省得开口，但既然你这么执着：

source: I wanna be alone tonight. It's nothing personal, but I've barely gotten any time to read since I started hitchhiking with you guys, and I need some me-time. Okay?
target: 我今晚想一个人待着。不是针对你，只是自从跟你们搭车以来，我就没怎么有空看书。我需要一点独处的时间，行吗？

source: She slides her headphones back on before you can respond. Dang...
target: 你还没来得及回答，她就重新戴上了耳机。唉……

source: Oh, hello %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Sorry, but I'm not in the mood to chat.
target: 哦,哈啰 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 对不起,但我没心情聊天

source: I've just come across this garish blog post that interprets one of my favorite movies in a way that differs from how I interpret it.
target: 我刚看到一篇俗不可耐的博文，居然用一种与我不同的方式，解读我最喜欢的一部电影。

source: I know that everyone's entitled to their own opinions, and we have freedom of speech...
target: 我知道每个人都有权有自己的见解,我们有言论自由......

source: But that means, in turn, that I'm entitled to my opinion that this person's opinion is incorrect, and I'm protected by free speech to write a 5-paragraph essay explaining why.
target: 但反过来说，我也有权认为这人的观点是错的。而言论自由也保障我能写一篇五段长文，阐明原因。

source: Anyway, I expect this argument will last me all night, so we'll have to catch up some other time. See you.
target: 总之，这场争论恐怕得持续一整晚，我们改天再聊吧。再见。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Sorry, but I'm not interested in talking tonight.
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。抱歉，今晚没兴趣聊天。

source: I just had a fascinating conversation with %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% the other night that really inspired me...
target: 前几晚，我和%PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER%进行了一场精彩的交谈，让我灵感迸发……

source: I've been writing a poetry chapbook about the whole thing. Not to brag, but it's one of my greatest works yet. I need to keep going!
target: 我正在把这段经历写成一本小诗集。不想自夸，不过这可是我迄今为止最好的作品之一。必须趁热打铁！

source: That's fine! Maybe I can help you with your poetry?
target: 没关系! 也许我能帮你写诗?

source: Eh... look, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: you have lots of great qualities, but poetic finesse isn't one of them. Sorry.
target: 呃……听着，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%：你有许多优点，但诗歌造诣不在其中。抱歉。

source: Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to think of something that rhymes with "centurial ennui."
target: 现在，恕我失陪，我得想想有什么词能和“百年倦怠”押韵。

source: Hello, darling. What can I do for you?
target: 你好,亲爱的。 有什么需要帮忙的吗?

source: You want to talk? Oof, sorry, I already promised my followers I'd livetweet my every thought tonight.
target: 你想聊聊？哎呀，抱歉，我已经答应粉丝，今晚要把每个念头都实时发到推特上。

source: They're already so excited! I can't reschedule. You understand, right? Yes, of course you do. TTYL!
target: 他们已经兴奋极了！我可不能改时间。你能理解，对吧？当然，你肯定懂。回头聊！

source: "Just... blew off... friend... for... Internet clout... #relatable... #girlbye... #notsponsored"
target: “刚刚……为了……网络人气……打发走了……朋友……#太真实了……#姐先走了……#非广告”

source: Oh, hey %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 哦，嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: You want to hang out? I thought I made it clear I want to be alone tonight.
target: 你想找我玩？我以为已经说得很清楚了，我今晚想独处。

source: I put my phone on Do Not Disturb; I turned off all notifications; I set my Momentgram status to "invisible"...
target: 我把手机调成了勿扰模式，关闭了所有通知，还把Momentgram状态设成了“隐身”……

source: Okay... but you never explicitly told me that you wanted to be alone?
target: 好吧……可你并没有明确跟我说，你想一个人待着啊？

source: Ugh, curse the offline world and its intricate rituals...
target: 唉，可恶的线下世界，还有这些繁琐的交往礼节……

source: Sorry, darling, but I just need some me-time tonight. Maybe we'll chat some other time.
target: 抱歉，亲爱的，我今晚就是需要一点独处的时间。改天再聊吧。

source: Oh, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! I didn't see you there. Do you need something?
target: 哦，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！刚没看见你。找我有事吗？

source: ...You want to hang out? Sorry, I can't tonight. I simply MUST brush my hair.
target: ……你想找我玩？抱歉，今晚不行。我必须梳头。

source: Royal hair must be brushed 500 times per night, or I'll risk getting the dreaded "commoner's scalp syndrome."
target: 王室的头发每晚都必须梳五百下，不然就有可能得上可怕的“平民头皮综合征”。

source: ...Ugh, and talking to you made me lose count! Now I have to start over!
target: ……哎呀，跟你一说话，我都忘记数到哪儿了！又得从头开始！

source: Oh, hello %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Apologies, but I can't talk right now.
target: 哦，你好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。抱歉，我现在不能聊天。

source: Father says that a princess should only socialize for about twenty hours a week. Excessive talking causes premature wrinkles and socialist ideas.
target: 父王说，公主每周只能社交二十个小时左右。话说得太多，会让人提早长皱纹，还会产生社会主义思想。

source: Since %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% and I have been talking so much lately, I have a lot of silence to catch up on!
target: 最近我和%PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER%聊了那么多，现在得多安静一会儿，补回来！

source: So please, leave me to my royal quiet time.
target: 所以，请让我好好享受王室的静谧时光。

source: Hello, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 你好，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: You wanna talk? I don't know...
target: 你想聊聊？这个嘛……

source: I heard a rumor that talking to you can cause migraines and genital warts.
target: 我听说，跟你聊天会让人得偏头痛，还会长生殖器疣。

source: Rationally speaking, I know most gossip is baseless nonsense.
target: 理性地说,我知道大多数八卦都是毫无根据的胡说八道。

source: But emotionally speaking, I must honor other people's gossip by giving it the benefit of the doubt.
target: 但从情感上说，我得尊重别人的八卦，姑且相信它有几分道理。

source: Also, I don't want genital warts. Goodbye.
target: 另外，我也不想长生殖器疣。再见。

source: Yikes... you have a lot to think about... but you fear too much talking to yourself in your head might give you genital warts. Ugh.
target: 嘶……你有好多事要想……但又怕在脑子里自言自语太多，会让自己长出生殖器疣。唉。

source: You walk up to where Moss was sitting, only to realize he's now perched on top of a streetlamp. He's staring at the light rapturously.
target: 你走到莫斯刚才坐的地方，却发现他已经蹲到了路灯顶上，正痴迷地盯着灯光。

source: You are beautiful. You are ethereal. I would burn down the world just to see you shimmer.
target: 你如此美丽，如此超凡脱俗。只为看你闪耀，我愿烧毁整个世界。

source: Uh... hello?
target: 呃……你好？

source: Did you hear something, O beautiful electric flame? ...No, neither did I.
target: 哦，美丽的电光，你听到什么声音了吗？……没有？我也没听到。

source: You're right, my dearest, we SHOULD stare unblinkingly at each other until my eyeballs roll out!
target: 你说得对，我的挚爱，我们就该这样一眨不眨地凝视彼此，直到我的眼珠滚出来！

source: Okay, you've clearly stumbled upon a private moment. You walk away.
target: 好吧，你显然撞破了一场私会。你走开了。

source: Oh, shit... hey there, Sentient Stack of Pancakes. Am I having that nightmare where you try to eat me again?
target: 卧槽……你好啊，会说话的煎饼塔。我又做那个你要吃掉我的噩梦了？

source: What? No. It's me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 啥？没有。是我，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Ohhh, yeah, that makes a lot more sense. The things you see while you're high!
target: 哦哦，对，这就合理多了。嗨起来时真是什么都看得见！

source: Ohhh, yeah, that makes a lot more sense. The things you see while you're on super shrooms!
target: 哦哦，对，这就合理多了。超级蘑菇嗑起来，真是什么都看得见！

source: Anyway, no offense, but could you give me some space? I'm having a WEIRD trip tonight, and being around you is only making it more stressful for some reason.
target: 总之，无意冒犯，能让我自己待会儿吗？我今晚这趟幻觉之旅特别诡异，不知道为什么，你在旁边只会让我更紧张。

source: Aw, okay... you spend the night alone, hearing Polly laugh to herself and talk to her hallucinations.
target: 唉，好吧……你独自过了一夜，只听见波莉在那边自顾自地笑，还跟幻觉聊个不停。

source: Oh, hey %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Everything okay?
target: 哦，嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。你还好吗？

source: It's about to be, 'cause it's time to PAR-TAY with my favorite ghost!
target: 马上就好，因为我要跟最爱的幽灵开——趴——啦！

source: Eh... sorry, boo, but I'm really not in the mood to party tonight.
target: 呃……抱歉啊，宝，可我今晚真没心情开趴。

source: WHAT?! Who are you and what have you done with Polly?!
target: 什么？！你是谁？你把波莉怎么了？！

source: Hey, I don't party ALL the time. I contain multitudes, y'know!
target: 嘿，我也不是一天到晚都在开趴好吧。我可是很多面的，懂？

source: I was actually gonna spend the night catching up on some reading. If you wanna be loud and reductionist, go do it somewhere else.
target: 我本来想今晚补补阅读。你要继续吵吵嚷嚷，还非把我看得这么扁平，就去别处闹。

source: What's up, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，怎么啦？

source: You wanna hang out? Eh, sorry, I'm too hungry to hang out tonight.
target: 你想找我玩？呃，抱歉，我今晚太饿了，没法陪你玩。

source: Oh... well, we could eat something together. Maybe a milkshake with two straws?
target: 哦……那我们可以一起吃点东西呀。比如一杯奶昔，插两根吸管？

source: Nah, I'd better go at this alone. I'm really craving some raw carrion, and no offense, but I don't think you could keep up with a running deer.
target: 不了，我还是自己去吧。我现在特别想吃生腐肉。无意冒犯，但我觉得你追不上奔跑的鹿。

source: Wish me luck!
target: 祝我好运!

source: Dang... looks like you're having a milkshake-with-two-straws for one tonight. Truly the loneliest meal.
target: 唉……看来，你今晚只能独自喝那杯插着两根吸管的奶昔了。真是最孤独的一餐。

source: Hey %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. What's on your mind?
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。你在想什么？

source: I'm glad you asked! I was hoping to talk about--
target: 你问得正好！我正想聊聊——

source: Cause I'll tell you what's on MY mind: %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER%!
target: 因为我可以告诉你，我在想的是：%PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER%！

source: We've had some cool, intense conversations lately.
target: 最近我们聊得特别棒，还聊了些很深入的话题。

source: Actually, now that I think about it, you and I have also had some cool conversations lately...
target: 其实，仔细想想，最近我跟你也聊得挺开心的……

source: But I think my conversations with %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% are so much cooler that I forgot I also had some conversations with you.
target: 但我跟%PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER%聊得实在太棒了，都忘了也跟你聊过。

source: Isn't that funny?
target: 是不是很好笑？

source: It is not. You leave to spend the night mending your self-esteem. It'll take some time.
target: 一点都不好笑。你离开了，打算用一整晚修补自己的自尊心。这得花点时间。

source: Sorry, shop's closed tonight.
target: 对不起,今晚商店关门了

source: That's okay, I'm not here to buy anything.
target: 没关系,我不是来买东西的

source: Oh... so you're just here to talk? Time is money! Specifically: five bucks.
target: 哦……所以只是来聊天？时间就是金钱！具体来说：五块钱。

source: Sheesh, that's steep, but if that's what it takes...
target: 嘶，真够贵的。不过，既然非得这样……

source: Whoa, you actually paid me? Awesome!
target: 哇,你真的付我钱了? 厉害!

source: And then she leaves... with your five bucks. Goddammit.
target: 然后她就走了……带着你的五块钱。妈的。

source: Welcome to my little shop. See anything you like?
target: 欢迎来到我的小店 看到喜欢的东西了吗?

source: ...You just wanna talk? Ugh, I'm not a fan of people who browse and don't buy.
target: ……你只是想聊天？唉，我可不喜欢光看不买的人。

source: Sorry, but I'm not in the mood to do anything but make some cash tonight, so...
target: 抱歉，我今晚除了赚钱，什么都不想干，所以……

source: But... Valerie's not the shopkeeper of this game, so there's no way for you to buy anything from her...
target: 不过... 瓦莱丽不是这个游戏的店主 所以你不可能从她那里买东西...

source: Not my problem. If you'll excuse me, I've got a business to run.
target: 这可不关我的事。恕不奉陪，我还得做生意呢。

source: Oh, hey %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. What do you need?
target: 哦，嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。有什么事？

source: I'm sorta in the middle of making three spreadsheets, so if we could make this quick...
target: 我正同时做三份电子表格，所以，有话尽快说……

source: ...You just wanna talk? THAT'S what you interrupted my workflow zen for?
target: ……你只是想聊天？就为这个，你打断了我浑然忘我的工作状态？

source: Sorry, but I'm busy tonight. Go, I dunno, seduce a cactus or whatever it is you do for fun.

target: 唉，是啊，被诅咒这事……就是个诅咒。

source: You're doing your weekly dungeon-crawling session when you find a cool, powerful necklace, but of course the necklace is cursed.
target: 每周照例下地牢冒险时，发现一条又酷又强的项链。可想都不用想，它肯定带着诅咒。

source: And of course the curse is the most annoying entity that ends up living rent-free inside your soul, or mind... or God knows what.
target: 当然，那诅咒偏偏还是个烦人到极点的家伙，白住在你的灵魂里，或脑子里……鬼知道具体住哪儿。

source: Relatable!
target: 懂，这我可太有体会了！

source: The truth is I lifted the curse quite fast. But the necklace gives me some kick-ass boosts, so I kept it.
target: 其实，我很快就解除了诅咒。但那项链的加成强得很，所以我留着了。

source: What about Hex? I don't see them around. Are they, like... inside of your soul right now?
target: 那 Hex 呢？没看见它啊。它现在……在你的灵魂里吗？

source: Nah.
target: 没有。

source: Look, the thing is, after some months together, I must admit I appreciate their company.
target: 听着，相处了几个月，我得承认，有它陪着也挺好。

source: They're like the most obnoxious roommate ever, but I still like them.
target: 它就像史上最烦人的室友，可我还是挺喜欢它的。

source: If you ever tell them I said that, I'll deny it... and then I'll probably murder you in your sleep.
target: 你要敢告诉它，我绝对不认……然后说不定趁你睡着把你杀了。

source: Fair warning.
target: 行，警告收到了。

source: But even like that, it's not healthy to spend 24/7 with someone... with anyone!
target: 可就算这样，一天二十四小时都跟某个人待在一起，也不健康……换谁都一样！

source: Especially when that someone lives inside of your mind. So we found a solution.
target: 尤其那家伙还住在你的脑子里。所以我们想了个办法。

source: Did you put the necklace in a box or something? Isn't that a bit claustrophobic for Hex?
target: 你把项链放盒子里之类的了吗？那 Hex 不会闷得慌吗？

source: No, that'd be unfair, even for that fucker.
target: 没有。就算是那个混蛋，也不该被这样对待。

source: We've found some people who are cool with carrying the necklace from time to time.
target: 我们找到了几个愿意时不时帮忙戴一下项链的人。

source: Some are friends who seem to really vibe with Hex; some are weirdos who seem to be into being cursed.
target: 有些是跟 Hex 特别合得来的朋友，还有些怪人，好像就喜欢被诅咒。

source: It's still mostly me, but now the load is much more bearable.
target: 大部分时间还是我戴着，但现在轻松多了。

source: I didn't know that was even possible.
target: 我都不知道还能这样。

source: It wasn't exactly possible. We went through some shit to make it possible. It was a full adventure of its own!
target: 本来是不行。我们折腾了好多破事才做到，单是这就够讲一场冒险了！

source: I have all night!
target: 我有一整晚的时间！

source: Aaravi spends the rest of the night telling you that story. When you think about it, it's inspiring to see how Aaravi turned a curse into a truly healthy relationship.
target: 余下的夜晚，阿拉维都在给你讲那个故事。仔细想想，能把一场诅咒变成一段真正健康的关系，还挺鼓舞人心的。

source: The Food Truck
target: 餐车

source: The food truck is great.
target: 餐车很棒

source: I'd never have pinned you as a cook.
target: 真没想到你还会做饭。

source: Well, I am an adventurer first, but adventures call for a diverse set of skills.
target: 我首先是个冒险者，不过，冒险需要掌握各种技能。

source: I need to craft all sort of things, from weapons to meals.
target: 武器也好，饭菜也好，各种东西我都得会做。

source: I use the latter mostly for the food truck and the former only on occasion.
target: 现在主要给餐车做饭，武器只是偶尔做做。

source: But yeah, cooking is an essential skill: many are the times I've sat around a fire with party members to cook and eat a good stew as we prepared to raid a dungeon.
target: 不过，做饭确实是必备技能。好多次，队友们跟我围坐在火堆边，炖上一锅好吃的，边吃边准备下地牢。

source: Hm, I can see it now. If you must go into a dungeon for several days, it's good to be resourceful with food.
target: 嗯，我明白了。要在地牢里待上好几天，懂得张罗吃的肯定很有用。

source: Absolutely. It's a skill all of us Slayers must have at hand. I learned it from my mother.
target: 当然，这是我们屠戮者都得掌握的技能。我是跟妈妈学的。

source: She was a Slayer too?
target: 她也是屠戮者？

source: Yes, being a Slayer is a bit of a lineage thing. She was a strong, fierce woman, my mom.
target: 对，屠戮者多少算是家族传承。我妈是个强悍的女人。

source: She taught me how to add flavor to any strange thing I might be forced to eat in order to survive while adventuring.
target: 冒险时，为了活下去，再古怪的东西也可能得吃。她教过我，怎么把那些东西做得有滋味。

source: When she left for a mission, her spice rack was almost as important as her weapons.
target: 每次出任务，她的调料架几乎跟武器一样重要。

source: I imagine focusing a bit on cooking must be nice... like reliving the memories of cooking with your mom, no?
target: 我想，花点心思做饭一定挺好的……也能重温跟妈妈一起做饭的回忆，对吧？

source: Yes, I guess so. I like having the food truck as this little side thing.
target: 嗯，大概吧。我挺喜欢把餐车当个小副业。

source: Then there's Calculester, who loves doing stuff that helps him understand organic life better.
target: 还有计算斯基，他就喜欢做那些能让自己更了解有机生命的事。

source: And Hex, who just REALLY likes food, especially junk food.
target: 至于 Hex，它是真的特别爱吃，尤其爱垃圾食品。

source: It's nice that this food truck project has brought you together.
target: 这个餐车项目能让你们聚在一起，真好。

source: It does. We got the truck, and now we just brainstorm and test different theme ideas.
target: 没错。车买来了，现在就一起琢磨、试验各种主题。

source: The "Only Breakfast" food truck; the "Soup in a Can" food truck; the "Deep Fried Rattlesnake and Cobra Heart" food truck; the "Just Hot Dogs" food truck...
target: 比如“只卖早餐”餐车、“罐装汤”餐车、“炸响尾蛇和眼镜蛇心”餐车、“只卖热狗”餐车……

source: We try to take turns so everyone can test their ideas. Some are... better than others.
target: 我们尽量轮着来，让每个人都试试自己的点子。有些……确实比另一些强。

source: Well, Aaravi, if you ever need a subject for testing new food ideas, here I am.
target: 阿拉维，要是还缺个试吃新菜的人，我就在这儿。

source: I may hold you to that!
target: 这可是你说的，我会当真的！

source: She actually does. You spend the rest of the night talking about food while you try some hot dogs and soup in a can. The hot dogs are definitely the right way to go.
target: 她还真当真了。余下的夜晚，你们边聊吃的，边试了些热狗和罐装汤。热狗绝对是更明智的选择。

source: Managing her Inventory
target: 整理她的物品栏

source: Oof, managing an adventurer's inventory... that's the real adventure.
target: 唉，整理冒险者的物品栏……这才是真正的冒险。

source: The things I have to fit in here...
target: 要塞进去的东西也太多了……

source: I always wonder what you carry in that adventurer's bag. It looks like it weighs a ton.
target: 我一直好奇，你那冒险背包里到底装了什么。看起来有一吨重。

source: Wanna take a look with me? I'm never against managing my inventory a bit more.
target: 要一起看看吗？我随时都愿意再整理一下物品栏。

source: Sounds like a plan!
target: 好啊，就这么办！

source: Okay, lemme see...
target: 好，让我看看……

source: There are the weapons, of course...
target: 首先当然是武器……

source: Sword, broadsword, long sword, short sword...
target: 剑、阔剑、长剑、短剑……

source: Isn't that one a dagger?
target: 那不是匕首吗?

source: Eh, sure... daggers are just really short swords in the end.
target: 呃，是啊……说到底，匕首就是特别短的剑嘛。

source: Then there's the equipment.
target: 然后是装备。

source: At first you tell yourself you'll only keep the stuff with the better stat boosts.
target: 一开始你告诉自己，只留属性加成更好的东西。

source: But, ugh... then you run into things with cool modifiers and shit, and it becomes really hard NOT to keep most of what you get.
target: 可碰上那些带着超酷词条的装备，又忍不住了。到手的东西，大半都舍不得扔。

source: Like, look at this special hood and cape. It increases the amount of time I can stay underwater.
target: 比如，看看这套特殊的兜帽和披风。能让我在水下待得更久。

source: How can fabric affect your lung capacity?
target: 一块布怎么还能改变你的肺活量？

source: Because it's blue! Blue equipment tends to be for breathing underwater. Or resisting cold better.
target: 因为是蓝色的啊！蓝色装备通常都能让人在水下呼吸，或者更抗冻。

source: ...Okay.
target: ……好吧。

source: There's my rack of spices to add flavor to whatever meat I hunt; this tuba that lets me perform magical songs; this eyeshadow...
target: 还有调料架，打到什么肉都能加点滋味；这把大号，能让我演奏魔法歌曲；还有这盒眼影……

source: Ooh, that looks nice. Does it give you something cool like night vision when it's applied?
target: 哦，看着不错。涂上以后，会给你夜视能力之类的酷加成吗？

source: Nah, it's just eyeshadow. Sometimes a girl likes looking fierce, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 不会，就是眼影。有时姑娘就是想看起来酷一点，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Fair.
target: 有道理。

source: That's fifty turnips. I collect them because you never know when they might be part of a quirky sidequest.
target: 那是五十个萝卜。我收着它们，毕竟谁知道哪天会不会遇到个奇怪的支线任务，刚好要用呢。

source: Hmpf... that's the problem with adventuring: everything could come in handy eventually, so you end up hoarding A LOT.
target: 哼……冒险就有这毛病：什么东西以后都可能用上，结果越囤越多。

source: I literally have rocks and branches and iron, because what if they're future material for crafting stuff?!
target: 我连石头、树枝、铁都带着，万一以后做东西需要这些材料呢？！

source: But most of the time it's just junk I carry around like an idiot...
target: 可大多数时候，它们就是垃圾，我还像个傻子一样背来背去……

source: Then you need to learn a new adventurer skill: to let things go!
target: 那你得学个新冒险技能了：学会放手！

source: Let's start by throwing away some of those rocks and eating some of the turnips. How does that sound?
target: 先扔掉一些石头，再吃掉几个萝卜，怎么样？

source: You... you might be right. Yes. Let's do that.
target: 你……你可能说得对。好，就这么办。

source: You spend the rest of the night throwing all the stuff that does not bring joy to Aaravi and eating some turnips... that she has carried in her bag for like three months. Yummy!
target: 余下的夜晚，你们一边扔掉那些不能给阿拉维带来快乐的东西，一边吃萝卜……在她包里放了差不多三个月的萝卜。真好吃！

source: Grace, from the Coven
target: 女巫会的格蕾丝

source: Grace... sure, I can tell you a bit about her.
target: 格蕾丝……好，我可以跟你聊聊她。

source: She was the leader of the Coven before you, right?
target: 她是女巫会上一任领袖，对吧？

source: Yes, she was, for a bit...
target: 是的，她当过一阵子……

source: We witches are either born to become part of the Coven, or remain "dormant".
target: 我们女巫要么生来就注定加入女巫会，要么保持“休眠”状态。

source: If one of us dies, a "dormant" witch can take her place.
target: 如果我们当中有人死去，一位“休眠”的女巫就能接替她。

source: A backup player, waiting in the benches!
target: 就像替补球员，在场边等着上场！

source: Sort of, yes. There are exceptions, though... like how our Hope can never be replaced by a different witch.
target: 差不多。不过也有例外……比如我们这位希望女巫，就不能让其他女巫随便接替。

source: In time she can be replaced by a new Hope. But for that to happen, she CANNOT die before the ritual takes place.
target: 时机到了，可以由一位新的希望女巫来接替她。但在传承仪式举行前，她绝对不能死。

source: This is because Hope is the vessel for something very old and powerful, something that's passed from Hope to Hope...
target: 因为希望女巫是某种古老而强大的存在的容器。那种存在，会由一代希望女巫传给下一代……

source: The rest of us? We can die. We MUST die, if it's what it takes to save the world.
target: 至于我们其他人？我们可以死。如果只有这样才能拯救世界，那我们就必须死。

source: And so Grace did.
target: 格蕾丝就是如此。

source: I'm sorry, Joy...
target: 听到这些，我很难过，乔伊……
notes: polish pass 024: FIX; user-directed Joy name correction only; no new review coverage

source: Hope and Faith have told me she was a brave and just leader.
target: 希望女巫和信念女巫都跟我说过，她是位勇敢、公正的领袖。

source: It's hard. There's always a thin, lingering feeling that I'm in her shadow.
target: 很难。我总隐隐觉得，自己还活在她的影子里。

source: There's a different universe in which she survived and remained the rightful leader of the Coven.
target: 在另一个宇宙，她活了下来，仍是女巫会当之无愧的领袖。

source: A universe in which I remained just another human.
target: 而那个宇宙里的我，还是个普通人。

source: What would be my life then? Would the Coven be in better hands?
target: 那样的话，我会过着什么样的人生？女巫会交给她，是不是会更好？

source: I do my best to be a good leader for the Coven, to protect all realms.
target: 我尽全力做一个好领袖，带领女巫会，保护所有世界。

source: But is it enough?
target: 可这就够了吗？

source: Grace was brave and just and strong... and yet it wasn't enough.
target: 格蕾丝那么勇敢、公正、强大……却依然不够。

source: Sometimes I dream I traded places with her again.
target: 有时，我会梦见自己又跟她换了位置。

source: A part of me dreams this out of the thought that she would be better for the Coven.
target: 一方面，是觉得她更适合带领女巫会。

source: A part of me maybe just wants to drop this unbearable weight on my shoulders... to find some rest.
target: 另一方面，也许只是想卸下肩上这副难以承受的重担……歇一歇。

source: It sounds like a lot, Joy. Maybe we can get some rest, even if only for the duration of the night?
target: 你背负的确实太多了，乔伊。要不我们先歇一会儿？哪怕只有今晚。
notes: polish pass 024: FIX; user-directed Joy name correction only; no new review coverage

source: Maybe... yes... that sounds good.
target: 也许……嗯……这样也好。

source: You both close your eyes. Breathe in... breathe out... you hold hands and just... are.
target: 你们闭上眼睛，吸气……呼气……握着彼此的手，就这样……静静地待着。

source: Moving from one realm to another
target: 在不同世界间穿行

source: Ah, yeah, we witches are a special case when it comes to that...
target: 嗯，说到这个，我们女巫算是个特例……

source: How much do you know about realms?
target: 你对这些不同的世界了解多少？

source: Eh... explain this to me like I'm five, okay?
target: 呃……就当我只有五岁，从头给我讲讲，好吗？

source: Heh... okay.
target: 呵……好。

source: Reality is divided into different realms.
target: 现实被划分成了不同的世界。

source: This is the Monster Realm, what many consider the "main realm".
target: 这里是怪物世界，许多人把它当作“主世界”。

source: With the right means and powers, you can traverse the realms.
target: 只要有合适的手段和力量，就能在这些世界间穿行。

source: Some realms are... more accessible than others.
target: 有些世界……比其他世界更容易进入。

source: Take Hell, for instance: it's only recently started serious diplomatic relationships with the Monster Realm, and now travelling between these two realms has become a bit easier.
target: 比如地狱：直到最近，它才正式跟怪物世界建立外交关系。现在往返这两个世界，就容易了一些。

source: One of the most mundane and yet special realms of them all is my birthplace: the Human Realm.
target: 其中有个既平凡又特别的世界，就是我的出生地：人类世界。

source: It's a realm that is built to reject anything "extraordinary".
target: 那个世界的构造，就是为了排斥一切“超凡”的事物。

source: I guess there's no place for me there, then!
target: 那看来没我的容身之处了！

source: It's way more complex than that, but to sum it up, it's a protective measure against the old deities who seek to destroy everything.
target: 实际要复杂得多。简单来说，这是一种保护措施，用来抵御那些企图毁灭一切的旧神。

source: We Coven witches are born human. It hasn't always been like that, but again, it's the safest way to protect us while we're young and weak.
target: 女巫会的女巫生来都是人类。以前也不是一直如此，但这样最安全，能在我们还年幼、弱小的时候保护我们。

source: As soon as a being starts acquiring an "extraordinary" nature, it usually gets "vomited" out of the Human Realm.
target: 某个存在一旦开始具有“超凡”的性质，通常就会被人类世界“吐”出去。

source: Think of how when dead humans turn into ghosts or zombies, they are slowly but surely phased out of the Human Realm and into the Monster Realm.
target: 比如，人类死后变成幽灵或僵尸，就会缓慢却不可避免地离开人类世界，进入怪物世界。

source: We witches are a rare exception, though. We're part of a select few who can actually move in and out the Human Realm.
target: 我们女巫算是少有的例外，属于那极少数能自由进出人类世界的存在。

source: But we rarely go back these days. The stakes have become so high that it's dangerous for us to be there. We need to stay here, closer to the enemy.
target: 不过，如今我们很少回去了。局势太严峻，留在那里很危险。我们得待在这里，靠近敌人。

source: Yikes.
target: 听着真吓人。

source: Yeah, yikes. But it is what it is. If we make a mistake, there could be no realm at all anymore.
target: 是啊，确实吓人。可也只能如此。只要我们出错，可能所有世界都会不复存在。

source: Was it hard to stay in the Monster Realm for good? Like... in a way, you left your home.
target: 决定永远留在怪物世界，难不难？我是说……某种意义上，你离开了自己的家。

source: Absolutely. The Monster Realm is super messed up in a hundred different ways.
target: 当然难。怪物世界的问题多得很，简直一团糟。

source: Then again... the Human Realm is also super messed up in its own particular ways.
target: 不过……人类世界也有它自己的一堆烂摊子。

source: But there are good things in both realms... and I guess that's enough to devote my life to protect both of them.
target: 可两个世界都有美好的东西……我想，这就够让我用一生去守护它们了。

source: Well, I hope I'm one of those good things!
target: 那我希望，自己也是那些美好事物之一！

source: Heh... on a good day, you sort of are, sure.
target: 呵……状态好的时候，你确实勉强算是吧。

source: You both spend the rest of the night talking about the differences between the Monster Realm and the Human Realm.
target: 余下的夜晚，你们继续聊着怪物世界和人类世界的种种不同。

source: Her Studies in Magic
target: 她的魔法研究

source: The study of magic is complex, but it can be very rewarding.
target: 研究魔法很复杂，不过，也能收获很多。

source: When we're not saving the world, we witches spend a good amount of time reading arcane tomes and learning new ways of channeling magic.
target: 不忙着拯救世界的时候，我们女巫会花不少时间研读秘法典籍，学习新的魔力引导方式。

source: Channeling magic?
target: 引导魔力？

source: Yes. Magic is a powerful energy that exists almost everywhere.
target: 是的。魔力是一种强大的能量，几乎无处不在。

source: It has the worst of sources, though. It's the residual power of ancient entities whose only goal is to destroy reality.
target: 不过，它的来源糟透了。它是那些古老存在残余的力量，而那些存在唯一的目的，就是毁灭现实。

source: Magic is their fuel; their will. And they have so much of it that magic has been pouring out of them for eons, permeating everything.
target: 魔力是它们的燃料，也是它们的意志。它们拥有的魔力实在太多，亿万年来不断向外涌出，渗透进一切。

source: So, it's like old deities' excretions? Their stinky sweat laying everywhere? Or even worse... their jizz?
target: 所以，就像旧神的排泄物？到处流的臭汗？还是更糟……它们的精液？

source: I'll try to NEVER AGAIN remember the metaphor you came up with today, thanks.
target: 谢谢，我会努力把你今天想到的比喻永远忘掉。

source: The important thing here is that, in time, mortals learned to use it.
target: 重点在于，随着时间推移，凡人学会了使用魔力。

source: Magic was devised as the combustible to power these all-powerful machines of flesh and pain whose main directive was to destroy everything...

source: Ah, the mysterious properties and uses of the jizz from the gods...

source: Stop it!
target: 别说了！

source: Anyway, that's how we learn magic. It's hard work, but it pays off.

source: And here I was thinking you attended a very British school with color-coded houses and broom-based sports.

source: You're silly tonight, aren't you?

source: Always!

target: 又聊了些魔法的事后，乔伊教了你几个小魔法。真不错！

source: The Coven and its origins
target: 女巫会及其起源

source: The Coven is the shield of mortalkind.

source: Fighting evil and all that, yeah?
target: 就是对抗邪恶之类的，对吧？

source: Ominous!

source: Mortalkind slowly but steadily built two fronts of resistance.

source: One of them was defined by their ingenuity: mortals who dared to explore the very entities that aimed for their destruction.

source: Magic wielders fought the old ones, sure; but they also focused on improving the means of survival.

source: For instance, it was through magic that the realms came to be, as a way of distancing ourselves from our predators.
target: 比如，各个世界就是通过魔法创造出来的，为的是让我们离那些捕食者远一些。

source: A sort of arcane barricade, is it?

source: Sort of. They're safer havens for us to keep studying magic and building more powerful tools to resist the attack.

source: But we still remained mortal, and so all that we built could be taken from us so easily.
target: 可我们终究会死，因此，我们建造的一切，还是很容易就会失去。

source: Thus came the idea of a lineage... a way of nurturing magic power and passing it on to a new generation.
target: 于是就有了世代传承的想法……培育魔法力量，再把它传给下一代。

source: We inherit part of the power that has been sharpened for centuries by generations of Coven members.
target: 我们继承的那部分力量，是几百年来，一代又一代女巫会成员不断磨炼出来的。

source: We inherit responsibilities... we inherit the oldest fight, only dreaming of being the generation that can finally bring an end to it.
target: 我们继承责任……继承那场最古老的战争，只盼自己这一代能让它终于结束。

source: No pressure, huh?

source: You're telling me! But I try to focus on doing my very best and improving my skills enough to pass something useful to the next generation.
target: 可不是嘛！不过，我尽量只想着做到最好，磨炼自己的本领，好给下一代留下些有用的东西。

source: You've saved the world a dozen times at the very least... I'd say you're doing quite well.
target: 你少说也拯救过世界十几次了……要我说，你已经做得很好了。

source: There's always room to do even better.
target: 总还能做得更好。

source: You ask Joy to tell you about some of the times she saved the world, and she tells you some epic stories. What a girlboss!
target: 你请乔伊讲讲她拯救世界的经历，她便讲起了几个精彩的故事。真是个厉害姑娘！

source: Their gig as a Reaper
target: 死神的工作

source: Oh, darling, being a reaper, amirite?
target: 哦，亲爱的，当死神嘛，你懂的，对吧？

source: Such a responsibility!
target: 这么重的责任!

source: But how... how does it work, exactly?
target: 不过……具体是怎么做的？

source: Well, how does anything work in this strange, sometimes-nonsensical world?
target: 这个嘛，在这个古怪、偶尔还毫无道理的世界里，什么事又说得清呢？

source: We reapers are like these mysterious, sexy ferrypeople who row souls across realms.
target: 我们死神就像神秘又性感的摆渡人，划着船，带灵魂穿过不同的世界。

source: Because you see: death is not the end. Death is transformation; death is transition!
target: 你要知道，死亡不是终点。死亡是转变，是过渡！

source: You could die and become a ghost... or go to Hell... or reincarnate as a human...
target: 你死后可能变成幽灵……可能去地狱……也可能转世为人类……

source: Some people even cease to be... or so I suspect.
target: 有些人甚至会不复存在……至少我是这么猜的。

source: Truth be told, I don't completely understand the exact cycle and its rules.
target: 说实话，我并不完全了解这一整套循环和它的具体规则。

source: I get a gig, I follow the directions.
target: 我接到任务，照指示办事就行。

source: You never wonder about it, though? How it all works exactly and such.
target: 可你从来不好奇吗？比如这一切到底怎么回事。

source: No, darling; that's above my pay grade.
target: 不，亲爱的，那可超出我这份薪水该操心的范围了。

source: The important thing here is we do something that's important.
target: 重点是：我们做的事情很重要。

source: Most poor souls tend to be pretty confused after they die.
target: 大部分可怜的灵魂，刚死的时候都很茫然。

source: If we do our job well, we can give them some direction, some peace, or at the very least some company.
target: 只要做好工作，我们就能给它们一些指引、一点安宁，或者至少陪它们一程。

source: That's such a kind thought.
target: 你能这么想，真温柔。

source: You know me, honey: I'm a kind, selfless, and definitely humble person. That's Milo Belladonna for you.
target: 亲爱的，你了解我的：善良、无私，而且绝对谦虚。迈洛·贝拉多娜就是这样。

source: It certainly is!
target: 可不是嘛！

source: Let's hope I can be there for you when it's your time to cross realms.
target: 希望轮到你跨越世界的时候，我也能陪你一程。

source: Let's hope that's not soon!
target: 但愿别太快轮到我！

source: Just in case, you two spend the rest of the night making a list of things you'd love to do before dying. Joyful and a bit morbid, just your style!
target: 以防万一，余下的夜晚，你们列起了死前想做的事情清单。开心，又有点阴森，正合你的风格！

source: The Downsides of Fame
target: 成名的坏处

source: Ah, yes, fame! That elusive thing so many desire and so few get.
target: 啊，名气！多少人梦寐以求，却只有寥寥几人能得到的东西。

source: I must have done something right; instead of fifteen minutes, they gave me years and years of it!
target: 我一定做对了什么。别人只红十五分钟，我却红了一年又一年！

source: Full buckets of fame for you to bathe in!
target: 名气都能装满好几桶，让你泡个澡了！

source: Such a delightful image, darling.
target: 亲爱的，这画面真美妙。

source: But beware: being Milo Belladonna isn't all glamour and style.
target: 不过要注意：当迈洛·贝拉多娜，可不只有光鲜亮丽。

source: (Although it involves lots of both.)
target: （虽然，光鲜亮丽确实占了不少。）

source: Yeah, so tell me: what are the downsides?
target: 那说说看，有什么坏处？

source: Hmmm... for starters, some people can get weird...
target: 嗯……首先，有些人会变得很奇怪……

source: I do love my fans; my sweet Milovers.
target: 我当然爱我的粉丝，我可爱的迈洛迷。

source: I mean, what's not to love? They're cultured people with impeccable taste!
target: 有什么理由不爱呢？他们有文化，品味还无可挑剔！

source: An undeniable trait of theirs, right?
target: 他们的品味，那可没人能否认，对吧？

source: Exactly right! Nonetheless, there are some misguided individuals who misunderstand the depth of our relationship.
target: 完全正确！不过，有些人想岔了，误解了我们之间的关系究竟有多深。

source: They expect and sometimes even demand an amount of attention from me that I won't give them. It can get ugly...
target: 他们盼着我多关注他们，有时甚至直接要求。可那些关注，我不会给。闹起来可不好看……

source: And the privacy!
target: 还有隐私!

source: Say goodbye to privacy. It so quickly becomes a sort of mythical beast. I long for privacy so much, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 成名后，就跟隐私说再见吧。它转眼就成了传说中的神兽。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我太渴望有点私人空间了。

source: Well, you have some privacy right now, don't you?
target: 不过，现在不就有私人空间吗？

source: It's adorable that you think so!
target: 你这么想，还挺可爱的！

source: But no, we're livestreaming on my Momentgram account right now. Say hi!
target: 可惜没有哦。咱们现在就在我的 Momentgram 账号上直播。来，打个招呼！

source: And look: there's the cameras filming my new reality show, "Milo on the Road".
target: 看，那边还有摄像机，正在拍我的新真人秀《迈洛在路上》。

source: Well, what if you ended the broadcast and told the crew to take fifteen? I am sure they'd actually love that.
target: 那要不关掉直播，让摄制组休息十五分钟？我觉得他们肯定也很乐意。

source: That... doesn't sound half-bad.
target: 这……听起来倒不错。

source: And so they do. You spend some quality time alone with Milo. You make some small-talk, but that's more than enough, since Milo can relax for a hot minute. They really needed this.
target: 迈洛照做了。你们终于单独待了一会儿，闲聊几句。这样就足够了，毕竟迈洛总算能喘口气，确实太需要了。

source: The Upsides of Fame
target: 成名的好处

source: The upsides of fame, darling?
target: 成名的好处吗，亲爱的？

source: There are too many to remember them all!
target: 多得我都记不全！

source: Some will do, then!
target: 那就说几个吧！

source: Hmmm, okay. There's lots of free stuff, for instance.
target: 嗯，好吧。比如，能收到好多免费的东西。

source: Free stuff? That's my favorite stuff!
target: 免费的东西？我最喜欢了！

source: Yeah, audience is the hottest currency.
target: 没错，流量就是最抢手的货币。

source: Brands shower me in samples of all sorts of things for me to show on my channels.
target: 品牌方送来各种各样的样品，堆成山，就等着我在自己的频道里展示。

source: From free scented candles to free cement.
target: 从免费的香薰蜡烛，到免费的水泥。

source: Free... cement?
target: 免费的……水泥？

source: You heard me! Look, at the beginning of the influencer era, only the most chic brands believed in sending samples to people with big audiences.
target: 你没听错！网红时代刚开始时，只有最时髦的品牌，才觉得该给粉丝多的人寄样品。

source: You know: fashionable clothes, accessories, macarons...
target: 你知道的，时装、配饰、马卡龙……

source: But now all the more traditional brands are catching up.
target: 可现在，那些传统品牌也都跟上来了。

source: Cement, crossbows, big pharma -- you name it! I get the weirdest samples ever.
target: 水泥、弩、大型药企——要什么有什么！我收到的样品，真是一个比一个奇怪。

source: Wild!
target: 太离谱了！

source: Then there's all the famous people double standards.
target: 还有人们对名人的那套双重标准。

source: Like, if you buy your groceries in sweatpants, you could be seen as untidy. If I do so, apparently I'm "down-to-Earth."
target: 你穿运动裤买菜，可能会被说邋遢。我这样做，他们就说我“接地气”。

source: If you buy your groceries in your PJs they may call you "a weirdo". If I do so, I'm "quirky" or "eccentric."
target: 你穿睡衣买菜，他们可能叫你“怪人”。换成我，就成了“有个性”“特立独行”。

source: I can buy groceries wearing ANYTHING, and people will somehow find a way to think my fashion choice, no matter how outlandish it is, says something positive about my personality.
target: 我穿什么去买菜都行。不管打扮多离谱，大家总能找出办法，说这是我某个优点的体现。

source: Believe me: I've tried.
target: 相信我,我试过了。

source: I want pics.
target: 给我看看照片！

source: Oh! I'm always down to scroll through a stream of pics of myself. Let's do it!
target: 哦！翻自己的照片，我随时奉陪。来吧！

source: You spend the rest of the night looking through pictures of Milo buying their groceries. They indeed look fab in all of them no matter what they wear.
target: 余下的夜晚，你们翻看了迈洛买菜的照片。还真是，不管穿什么，每一张都好看得很。

source: Their Brand
target: 个人品牌

source: Ah, yes, Milo Belladonna, the brand!
target: 啊，没错，“迈洛·贝拉多娜”这个品牌！

source: I know it might sound like a hot take, but I LOVE working on my brand.
target: 我知道这个观点可能有点争议，但我特别喜欢打造自己的品牌。

source: People see that as something artificial; but I find it to be the opposite.
target: 别人觉得那很做作，可我觉得恰恰相反。

source: How so?
target: 怎么说？

source: Well... building your brand isn't about pretending to be someone you are not.
target: 打造自己的品牌，不是要假装成另一个人。

source: It's about exploring yourself, learning your narrative, your unique intrinsic value. It's an inevitable path to a greater appreciation of yourself.
target: 而是探索自己，了解自己的故事，还有独一无二的内在价值。走这条路，自然就会越来越欣赏自己。

source: You are you, and there are surely many beautiful things about it.
target: 你就是你，而这本身，肯定有许多美好的地方。

source: Hmmm, I gotta admit that does sound nice.
target: 嗯，我得承认，听着确实不错。

source: Exactly, darling. Otherwise, it's so tragic when you ask someone about themselves and they aren't sure how to respond!
target: 没错，亲爱的。要不，问一个人说说自己，结果连自己都不知道该怎么回答，那得多悲哀啊！

source: How can you bore yourself like that? How can you find yourself uninteresting?!
target: 怎么能连自己都觉得无聊？怎么能觉得自己毫无趣味？！

source: No, no, no. You have to be your own first and foremost fan.
target: 不不不，你首先就得当自己最忠实的粉丝。

source: And as you also become the marketer, publicist, and PR specialist of the YOU brand, people will want to buy into it too.
target: 当你也成了“你”这个品牌的营销人、宣传人和公关专家，别人也会想要买账。

source: You know what's even more beautiful?
target: 你知道更美好的是什么吗？

source: Twenty pancakes?
target: 二十个煎饼？

source: Haha, no, darling. What's beautiful is that when you become so observant of your brand, you do the same for everyone else's.
target: 哈哈，不是啦，亲爱的。更美好的是：开始这样仔细了解自己的品牌以后，你也会同样去关注其他人。

source: You start realizing what makes everyone so unique; so precious in their own way. It's just wonderful.
target: 你会发现，每个人都有独一无二的地方，都以自己的方式显得珍贵。太美妙了。

source: I see you, and I can't help but see all the little things that make you so special, and all the raw potential you still have.
target: 看着你，我就忍不住注意到那些让你如此特别的小细节，还有你尚未发掘的潜力。

source: It's these things that make you fall deeply in love with monsterkind.
target: 正是这些，让人深深爱上整个怪物社会。

source: Milo, that's incredibly moving!
target: 迈洛，太感人了！

source: It is, isn't it? It surely makes life a fine delight.
target: 是吧？这样一来，生活就成了美妙的享受。

source: You know what's also a fine delight? Those twenty pancakes you mentioned before...
target: 你知道还有什么也是美妙的享受吗？你刚才提到的那二十个煎饼……

source: You two order and split twenty pancakes. While eating them, you reflect it's interesting to see some of the most shallow aspects of Milo's life might have hidden depth to them.
target: 你们点了二十个煎饼，一起分着吃。你边吃边想，迈洛生活中那些看起来最肤浅的部分，居然也藏着深度，真有意思。

source: Where he lives
target: 他的住处

source: Duuuuude, you wanna know about the Chill Hill?
target: 伙——计，你想了解“悠闲山丘”？

source: The Chill Hill?
target: 悠闲山丘？

source: Yeaaaah, that's what we call our place. Wanda came up with the name.
target: 是啊——我们就这么叫自己的住处。名字是万达想的。

source: It's a cozy little apartment we share. It's super chill.
target: 我们合住的一间温馨小公寓。住着可自在了。

source: Waaaait, Chill Hill! Now I get the name! Mind blown!
target: 等——等，“悠闲山丘”！我现在才懂这名字！脑子炸了！

source: Who do you share Chill Hill with?
target: 你跟谁一起住在悠闲山丘？

source: Well, there's Wanda. You know her, my partner in crime.
target: 有万达啊，你认识的，我的犯罪搭档。

source: And by "partner in crime" I mean we do our summer lifeguard gig together.
target: 说“犯罪搭档”，我是指我们夏天一起当救生员。

source: But dude, we're so bad at it I am pretty sure we've been partners in actual crime without realizing it. So many people drown!
target: 可伙计，我们干得实在太烂，说不定真不知不觉一起犯过罪。淹死的人太多了！

source: There's also Kale and Abdu. Those two rock hard.
target: 还有卡莱和阿卜杜。那两个家伙超棒。

source: Kale is the chillest dog out there! And the bar is already high at the Chill Hill.
target: 卡莱是最悠闲的狗狗！要知道，悠闲山丘的标准本来就很高了。

source: He's sorta quiet. But I get it: some people are less about talking and more about vibing. I can dig that.
target: 他不怎么说话。不过我懂，有些人就是不爱多说，喜欢自在地待着。我挺欣赏的。

source: Abdu is more active; he can do the sickest skateboard tricks. What a cool dude, really.
target: 阿卜杜比较活跃，滑板绝活酷得很。真是个好伙计。

source: The four of us go on lots of misadventures... like doing groceries or renewing our IDs.
target: 我们四个经常一起闹出各种岔子……比如买菜，或换张身份证。

source: That sounds like... regular easy stuff.
target: 这听起来……就是些普通的小事啊。

source: Hmmm... I guess anything can be a misadventure when you are this high all the time!
target: 嗯……一直嗨成这样，干什么都能闹出岔子吧！

source: When you put it like that, it almost sounds like a sitcom. I'd totally watch it.
target: 听你这么一说，简直像部情景喜剧。我肯定会看。

source: Haha, yeah... we're well-cast, aren't we? We're so different... yet so similar. It's like... like... we're different strains of the same stuff.
target: 哈哈，是啊……这演员阵容挺合适吧？我们很不一样……可又很像。就像……就像同一种东西的不同品种。

source: Like the stuff you smoke!
target: 就像你抽的那些东西！

source: Duuuuuuuuuuude!
target: 伙——计！

source: His Hobbies
target: 他的爱好

source: Hobbies? Hmmm...

source: ...I love wrestling! And lucha libre!
target: ……我爱摔角！还有墨西哥摔角！

target: 每周会去练两三次，打磨招式，锻炼这副身体。

target: 每隔一个星期五，我们摔角团还会聚在一起，办点小演出！

source: Nothing serious. It's just for fun... but it's a lot of fun!
target: 不是什么正式的大比赛，就是玩玩……但特别好玩！

source: It sounds like it.

source: Wrestling is the best, dude...
target: 摔角最棒了，伙计……

target: 你想啊，它既是运动，又是娱乐。有角色、有故事……就像一部超精彩的电影，而且永远不会真正结束！

source: It may be the coolest form of culture out there!
target: 说不定，这就是最酷的文化形式！

target: 也许吧!

source: Wrestlers are athletes, and entertainers, and storytellers, and performers... the whole friggin' package!
target: 摔角手既是运动员，又是艺人、讲故事的人、演员……简直全套齐活！

source: And when we do the shows, even if it's just for fun, we get free pizza! FREE PIZZA!
target: 而且，演出就算只是玩玩，也能吃到免费披萨！免费披萨！

source: Free pizza: it's the fuel that makes the world go 'round!
target: 免费披萨，才是让世界运转的燃料！

source: Totally...
target: 绝对...

target: 我最近才加入摔角团，还没亲自上台演过，不过应该快了。我练得可勤了！

source: I just need to come up with a cool character.

source: Do you have any ideas?
target: 你有什么想法吗?

target: 最早想叫“巨石”，毕竟我是石头做的，可惜已经有人用了。

target: 我特喜欢大麻，所以还想过用大麻的别名……比如“撒旦的菠菜”！或者“魔鬼的生菜”！

source: "The Jazz Cabbage"!
target: “爵士卷心菜”！

source: Or what about... "The Deathguard"?

target: 哇！白天是救生员，晚上是夺命员！你简直是个天才啊？！

source: You spend the rest of the night brainstorming more wrestler names for Stu and practicing some of his signature moves. It's tons of fun!
target: 余下的夜晚，你们继续给斯图想摔角手的名字，还练了几个他的招牌动作。好玩极了！

source: His Blog
target: 他的博客

source: Duuuude, you know about my blog?!
target: 伙——计，你知道我的博客？！

source: I mean, I heard you mention it to Scott back in the car.
target: 我在车里听见你跟斯科特提过。

source: Whoa, the word is spreading already! Am I a celeb in the making or what?
target: 哇，这就传开了！我是不是快成名人了？

source: But what's the blog about?
target: 不过，你博客写什么的？

source: Well, when you're this stoned this often, the munchies become part of your existence.
target: 经常嗨成这样，馋劲儿都成了生活的一部分。

source: And when getting the munchies is part of your routine, you REALLY get into snacks.
target: 总是嘴馋，就会特别爱研究零食。

source: I like snacks!
target: 我喜欢吃点心!

source: Me too, dude. Snacks are the best.
target: 我也喜欢，伙计。零食最棒了。

source: So, I started this blog where I review all sorts of snacks.
target: 所以我开了个博客，点评各种零食。

source: It's a very ambitious project, especially because I only write entries while I'm still stoned... and oh boy, that's not easy.
target: 这是个雄心勃勃的计划，尤其我只在还嗨着的时候写……哎哟，真不容易。

source: I can imagine.
target: 我能想象出来。

source: Yeeeeah. But you know, I feel like the inspiration flows through me better when I'm like that.
target: 是啊——可你知道的，我那样的时候，灵感好像来得更顺。

source: This way, I become like... like... a chronicler of snacks.
target: 这样，我就成了……成了……零食编年史家。

source: I hope it's useful to people. It'd be useful to me, for sure.
target: 希望能帮到别人。反正肯定能帮到我。

source: When I have the munchies, I normally go for whatever I can get fastest. My brain isn't exactly in the right place to think too much about what I want.
target: 嘴馋的时候，什么最快能吃到，我就吃什么。那会儿我的脑子，也实在不适合仔细琢磨想吃啥。

source: I wouldn't need to think at all if there was an encyclopedia of stoner food. And now it exists!
target: 要是有本“嗨了以后吃什么”的百科全书，我就完全不用动脑了。而现在，真的有了！

source: What do you want? Something crunchy? Something sweet, maybe? On my blog, you can find the perfect snack for every situation!
target: 你想吃什么？脆的？还是甜的？不管什么情况，我博客里都有最合适的零食！

source: What a selfless contribution to monsterkind!
target: 真是对怪物社会的无私贡献啊！

source: You get it, dude! I even review the weird food experiments we conduct when I'm high.
target: 你懂我，伙计！我们嗨了以后搞的怪食物实验，我也会写点评。

source: You'd be surprised by the foods that become delicious when you turn them into a pizza topping or put them in a taco.
target: 有些东西，放到披萨上，或者塞进塔可里，居然就变得很好吃，准让你意想不到。

source: You really seem to enjoy this, Stu.
target: 斯图，看得出来，你真的很喜欢这件事。

source: Totally. It's a silly little thing that brings me joy. And that's the goal, isn't it?
target: 当然。就是点傻乎乎的小事，却能让我开心。图的不就是这个吗？

source: I even have, like, six fans who comment frequently. Can you imagine that?! My blog helps six actual people! It's mindblowing when you think about it!
target: 我甚至有六个经常留言的粉丝。想想看！我的博客真帮到了六个人！仔细一想，太不可思议了！

source: It's so refreshing to see Stu finding joy in the little things. He spends the rest of the night showing you some of his best food inventions. They do look wild and delicious!
target: 看到斯图能在小事里找到快乐，真让人耳目一新。余下的夜晚，他向你展示了几项最得意的美食发明。看着还真是古怪又好吃！

source: His Job

source: My job? I work third shift at the laundromat.
target: 我的工作？在自助洗衣店上夜班。

source: It's chill. Almost nothing happens for most of the night, so I can do my thing.
target: 挺轻松。晚上大部分时间都没什么事，我可以做自己的事。

source: There's something almost magical about a laundromat that's open all night. It's as if time's stopped, you know?
target: 通宵营业的洗衣店，总有种近乎魔幻的感觉。好像时间停住了，你懂吧？

source: A non-place outside of space and time.
target: 时空之外的一处“非场所”。

source: Sounds a bit dreamy, even.
target: 听着甚至有点梦幻。

source: It does! And my dudes even visit me sometimes so we can chill together. You know: Wanda, Abdu, Kale...
target: 是啊！我的伙计们有时还来看我，一起放松。你知道的，万达、阿卜杜、卡莱……

source: Doesn't your boss get upset or anything?
target: 你老板不会生气吗？

source: Nah, dude, Mrs. Lebowitz is the best. She doesn't give a shit.
target: 不会，伙计。利波维茨太太可好了，根本不在乎。

source: She only cares about TV game shows! It's the only thing that's ever on the laundromat TV.
target: 她只关心电视竞猜节目！洗衣店的电视永远都在播那个。

source: She's a bit grouchy and incredibly foul-mouthed, but she's nice once you get to know her.
target: 她脾气有点臭，说话也特别脏。不过熟悉了以后，你就知道她人挺好。

source: I like to think we've bonded a bit. We spend a lot of time in the laundromat, and we always comment on the game shows, trying to guess the answers and such.
target: 我觉得我们也算熟了。常一起待在店里，边看竞猜节目边聊，还会一起猜答案。

source: She sometimes even brings me leftovers of whatever she cooked for dinner that night.
target: 有时，她还会把当天晚饭剩的菜带来给我吃。

source: And get this: once I got sick and missed work. I got worried because I totally spaced out and forgot to tell Mrs. Lebowitz I wasn't coming in.
target: 还有次，我生病没去上班。后来才担心起来，因为我整个人恍恍惚惚的，忘了告诉利波维茨太太我不去了。

source: She called me and I was ready to get fired. But she just asked me for a seven-letter word starting with two Z's.
target: 她打电话来，我都做好被炒鱿鱼的准备了。结果，她只是问我，有没有七个字母、以两个 Z 开头的词。

source: We just stayed there, commenting on the show over the phone.
target: 我们就这样在电话里聊着那个节目。

source: That does sound nice.
target: 听着确实挺好。

source: Totally. I don't think anyone wants to be grouchy or mean or rude.
target: 是啊。我觉得没人想要脾气暴躁、刻薄或粗鲁。

source: When they are, I like to think it's probably because they're defensive, or tired, or sad... or just hurting.
target: 有人这样时，我总愿意相信，大概是因为他们在防备什么，或者累了、难过了……又或者，心里很痛。

source: It isn't cool that they're mean, but remembering that gives you some sort of perspective!
target: 他们刻薄当然不好，可记着这一点，也能让你换个角度看看。

source: Deep down, we all just want to chill.
target: 说到底，我们都只是想自在一点。

source: Whoa, that's deep, Stu.
target: 哇，斯图，这话挺有深度。

source: Hahaha, thanks my dude!
target: 哈哈哈，谢谢啊，伙计！

source: Who'd have thought Stu could be this insightful?! You spend the rest of the night watching a game show on your phone and guessing the answers. He's really good at it!
target: 谁能想到，斯图居然这么有见地！余下的夜晚，你们用手机看竞猜节目，一起猜答案。他还真挺擅长！

source: Getting used to the organic lifestyle
target: 适应有机生活方式

source: Friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, that's thoughtful of you to ask.
target: 朋友 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你这样问，真是体贴。

source: Trying to acommodate to organic life comes with many challenges.
target: 适应有机生命的生活方式，需要面对许多挑战。

source: The main issue is that we AIs are incredibly apt for hyper-specific tasks, but we struggle with generic ones.
target: 主要问题是，我们人工智能非常擅长高度专门化的任务，却难以应付通用任务。

source: I can read 50,000 books in an hour, but I find it incredibly difficult to read one sentence and decrypt the feelings of the writer unless it is said explicitly.
target: 我一小时能读完 50,000 本书，但读一句话、解读作者的情绪，却非常困难。除非对方明确说出来。

source: We AIs lack one essential organic feature that represents a chasm between you and us...
target: 我们缺少有机生命的一项关键特征。这在你们与我们之间，形成了一道鸿沟……

source: Luscious hair?
target: 一头浓密秀发？

source: <JOKE DETECTED, INITIATING MILD LAUGH PROTOCOL> Haha.
target: <检测到笑话，启动轻笑协议> 哈哈。

source: No, the correct answer is "common sense". Both organic beings and AI are pattern-recognizing beings.
target: 不，正确答案是“常识”。有机生命和人工智能都能够识别模式。

source: AI is extensive and exhausting, while organic beings are efficient by nature. You skim and reduce, often using your "common sense".
target: 人工智能的处理往往既庞杂又费力，而有机生命天生就讲效率。你们会略过、删减，经常借助“常识”。

source: What do you mean?
target: 什么意思？

source: Let me present a classic example:
target: 我来举一个经典的例子：

source: Suppose that the string of letters "abc" changes to "abd". How would you change the string "cdef" in the "same way"?
target: 假设字符串“abc”变成了“abd”。你会怎样用“同样的方式”改变字符串“cdef”？

source: Hmmm... "cdeg"?
target: 嗯……“cdeg”？

source: Perfect. This is known to be the traditional "correct answer". You inferred the following rule: "Replace the rightmost letter by its successor in the alphabet".
target: 非常好。这是传统意义上的“正确答案”。你推断出的规则是：“把最右边的字母替换为字母表中的下一个字母。”

source: I cannot do that, for I see all possibilities, and yet I am incapable of surmising a priority in any of them.
target: 我却做不到。因为我会看到所有可能的规则，却无法判断该优先选择哪一种。

source: "cded": "replace the rightmost letter with 'd'".
target: “cded”：“把最右边的字母替换为 d。”

source: "ddef": "replace any 'c' with a 'd'".
target: “ddef”：“把所有 c 替换为 d。”

source: "abd": "replace any string of letters with the string 'abd'".
target: “abd”：“把任意字符串替换为 abd。”

source: Those make sense too!
target: 这些也都说得通！

source: Technically, yes. But as a result, I would abandon the solution as inconclusive and deem the question impossible to answer.
target: 严格来说，是的。但这样一来，我就会因无法得出确定结论而放弃，并认为这个问题无法回答。

source: Whereas you offered an answer that is (as I know now) the one most likely to be the answer the interlocutor was looking for.
target: 而你给出的答案，据我现在所知，最有可能就是提问者想要的那个。

source: Life is riddled with literally trillions of microscopic choices you must make every second. Making a coffee easily involves a dozen minuscule tasks.
target: 生活中有数万亿个微小的选择，每一秒都需要作出。光是泡杯咖啡，就轻易涉及十来项细小任务。

source: Imagine getting a PhD, or maintaining a romantic relationship.
target: 再想想读博士，或维持一段恋爱关系。

source: You skim, reduce, simplify, and even "turn off" your conscious brain while performing a high percentage of the micro-tasks. It is admirable in its efficiency.
target: 执行许多细小任务时，你们会略过、删减、简化，甚至“关闭”有意识的思考。这种效率令人钦佩。

source: I just can't do that. Every little meaningless choice is run through extensive analysis.
target: 我却做不到。每一个无关紧要的小选择，都要经过大量分析。

source: It sounds exhausting.
target: 听着就很累。

source: It is, Friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. But what is life if not an exhausting, beautiful stream of complex moments?
target: 确实如此，朋友 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。不过，生活不就是一连串令人疲惫却又美丽的复杂时刻吗？

source: So, to answer your initial query: acommodating to organic life has been incredibly difficult.
target: 所以，回到你最初的问题：适应有机生命的生活，确实非常困难。

source: But I suspect it's more than worth it. I'm still running an analysis to properly determine it.
target: 不过，我推测这一切非常值得。目前仍在运行分析，以便得出准确结论。

source: For the rest of the night, you chill and bask in the beauty of the night, although you can't help but imagine how many processes Cal must be running just to relax.
target: 余下的夜晚，你们放松下来，享受着夜色的美。可你忍不住想：光是为了放松，卡尔就得运行多少个程序啊。

source: His hobbies
target: 他的爱好

source: I like playing games. Mostly chess and go. It helps me train my systems.
target: 我喜欢玩游戏，主要是国际象棋和围棋。它们有助于训练我的系统。

source: Train? How so?
target: 训练？怎么训练？

source: Chess and go both have trillions of potential board states. It is impossible for any existing AI to fully comprehend all of them.
target: 国际象棋和围棋都有数万亿种可能的棋盘状态。现有的任何人工智能，都无法完全掌握所有状态。

source: Still, they're great training grounds, since they follow specific criterias that ensure some degree of control.
target: 不过，它们是很好的训练场。因为它们遵循明确的标准，让环境具有一定的可控性。

source: Some of these criteria include:
target: 这些标准包括：

source: Environment that is fully observable.
target: 环境中的信息完全可见。

source: Environment contains few other agents (namely one).
target: 环境中其他行动者的数量很少——具体来说，只有一个。

source: Outcomes and actions are specified by the "rules" or "physics" of the environment, which are known and fairly predictable.
target: 行动及其结果由环境的“规则”或“物理规律”决定。这些规律已知，且相当可预测。

source: It's almost... soothing.
target: 几乎……令人安心。

source: It teaches me that, even if my processor is incapable of envisioning all possible board states, I can still choose to try anyway and do my best.
target: 它们让我明白：即便处理器无法设想所有可能的棋盘状态，我仍可以选择尝试，尽我所能。

source: I train with millions of matches to learn patterns; I still run some degree of movement anticipation; I improve.
target: 我通过数百万场对局学习规律，也会在一定程度上预测对手的走法。我在进步。

source: That's... a lot of training.
target: 这……训练量可真大。

source: It is. And I am still humbled. For instance, Friend Polly still beats me in most of our matches, as she plays quite erratically.
target: 确实如此。可我仍然不敢自满。比如，我的朋友波莉下棋很难预测，大多数对局我还是赢不了她。

source: I am sure there is sense in her chaos, since she's a superb chess player, but her pattern of play is incredibly elusive.
target: 她的混乱中一定有道理，毕竟她是个出色的棋手。可她下棋的规律，实在难以捉摸。

source: Well, don't feel discouraged. Polly beats everyone's ass at chess.
target: 别灰心。下国际象棋，谁都打不过波莉。

source: She most certainly does. But it still helps me learn. And so, I keep training in this closed system: a safe environment for me to grow.
target: 的确如此。不过，这依然让我有所收获。所以我继续在这个封闭系统中训练，在安全的环境里成长。

source: For every day, I face the most complex of all open systems: life itself.
target: 因为每天，我都要面对最复杂的开放系统：生活本身。

source: A chaotic environment full of other agents and riddled with strange "rules" which are hard to completely understand.
target: 这个混乱的环境中，存在许多其他行动者，还有种种难以彻底理解的奇怪“规则”。

source: I am bound to make many errors as I lose many matches against Friend Polly.
target: 就像与朋友波莉下棋时会输掉许多局一样，我也注定会犯许多错误。

source: But hopefully, I will recover from every error, learn from it, and become better at it.
target: 不过，希望我能从每一次错误中恢复，吸取教训，做得更好。

source: I'm sure you will, Cal.
target: 你一定可以的，卡尔。

source: You spend the rest of the night playing go matches. Cal eviscerates you, and you don't think you learn anything from it, but it's fun!
target: 余下的夜晚，你们下了几盘围棋。卡尔把你杀得片甲不留。你觉得自己什么都没学到，不过，玩得挺开心！

source: If he has any new goals
target: 他有什么新目标

source: Actually, yes. You see, Friend %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I am learning to drive.
target: 确实有。朋友 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我正在学习开车。

source: It is an incredible challenge I feel I am ready to face.
target: 这是个极大的挑战，不过，我觉得自己已经准备好了。

source: Driving for an AI is like... like... [INSERT COMPARISON OF SOMETHING INCREDIBLY DIFFICULT FOR MONSTERS].
target: 对人工智能来说，开车就像……就像……[插入一个对怪物来说难到离谱的比喻]。
