source: We should eat a whole cantaloupe, for the sake of trying new things!
target: 我们应该吃一整个哈密瓜，就当尝试新事物！

source: Woooo!
target: 呜!

source: And so, you spend the rest of the night eating a whole cantaloupe and talking about nothing and everything. It's nice.
target: 于是，接下来的时间，你们吃着一整个哈密瓜，天南地北地聊着。真不错。

source: Her Passions
target: 她热爱的事

source: I have lots!
target: 那可多了！

source: But I guess a big one is engineering and robotics.
target: 不过，要说最热爱的，大概就是工程和机器人技术了。

source: I could spend all day wiring circuit components, batteries, and whatnot!
target: 给电路元件、电池之类的东西接线，我能玩一整天！

source: Zap!
target: 滋！

source: Whoa, this stuff really amps you up, doesn't it?
target: 哇，一聊这些，你就“电力十足”啊？

source: You betcha!
target: 当然了!

source: Gosh... I haven't decided on a specific field yet, so I do a bit of this; a bit of that.
target: 天哪……我还没决定要专攻哪个领域，所以这儿弄弄、那儿试试。

source: Did you know I actually studied engineering back in the human realm?
target: 你知道吗，我在人类世界的时候，其实就学过工程。

source: I had no idea.
target: 还真不知道。

source: Yeah, it was the best!
target: 是啊，棒极了！

source: To be fair, I've been tearing electronics apart since I was a child.
target: 其实，我从小就爱拆电子设备。

source: So, while most children were all hyped about playing video games...
target: 所以，当其他孩子都兴冲冲地玩电子游戏时……

source: ...I was all like, "How do all those fantasy worlds fit inside the cartridges?!"
target: ……我满脑子都是：“那些奇幻世界，是怎么装进游戏卡带里的？！”

source: But I had my tools with me, ready to delve into those mysteries of plastic, metal, and circuitry!
target: 不过，我手头有工具，随时准备钻进塑料、金属和电路的谜团里，一探究竟！

source: And... did you find those worlds inside the cartridges?
target: 那……你在卡带里找到那些世界了吗？

source: Don't be silly!
target: 别傻了!

source: But I found something way better: that with some materials and electricity, you can build almost anything!
target: 别的倒是找到了，而且棒多了：只要有些材料，再通上电，几乎什么都能造出来！

source: Zap! Zap!
target: 滋！滋！

source: That's pretty cool, Vicky.
target: 这还挺酷的，薇姬。

source: Isn't it? You dream, you build, you add some electricity... and then stuff comes to life.
target: 是吧？先想象，再动手造，再通上电……然后，它们就活过来了。

source: Just like you!
target: 就像你一样!

source: Haha... that's true!
target: 哈哈……还真是！

source: Zap?
target: 滋？

source: Zap!
target: 滋！

source: You two spend the rest of the night gazing at the stars in the sky, chilling and recharging your batteries.
target: 接下来的时间，你们一起望着满天繁星，放松心情，也给自己充充电。

source: School Adventures
target: 学校冒险

source: School was definitely a ride!
target: 学校生活可真够刺激的！

source: You couldn't even go to the bathroom without stumbling upon all sorts of misadventures.
target: 就连上个厕所，都能碰上一堆倒霉事。

source: Poop-related misadventures?
target: 跟拉屎有关的倒霉事？

source: Ew, no!
target: 咦，才不是！

source: More like going to the bathroom, but for some reason there's a wild griffin wreaking havoc there.
target: 比如，你只是去上厕所，结果不知为什么，有只野生狮鹫在里面大闹。

source: It sounds like a Scott and Damien thing.
target: 听着像是斯科特和德魔干的。

source: That one was definitely a Scott and Damien thing.
target: 那次还真是斯科特和德魔干的。

source: Or you run into Vera and Polly putting makeup on potatoes to decide who's better at makeup.
target: 或者撞见薇拉和波莉给土豆化妆，非要比比谁的化妆技术更好。

source: Uh... but who was better?
target: 额... 但谁更好?

source: Damien.
target: 德魔。

source: That tracks.
target: 合理。

source: Or maybe you want to pee, but you can't even pee in peace because people are talking non-stop in the stall next to yours!
target: 再或者，你想尿尿，可隔壁隔间里的人聊个没完，让你连尿都尿不安生！

source: First it's distracting... then it's just outright intriguing.
target: 一开始只是让人分心……后来，却让人越听越好奇。

source: By the end of it, it turns out it's Liam and Miranda discussing some nonsense written on the wall of the stall.
target: 听到最后才发现，是李姆和米兰达在讨论隔间墙上写的那些鬼话。

source: Poor Vicky!
target: 可怜的薇姬！

source: Poor Vicky indeed.
target: 可怜的薇姬，可不是嘛。

source: And that's still way tamer than when you find those two (plus Scott) trying to perform an impromptu surgery.
target: 而且，这还算轻的。更离谱的是，你会撞见他们俩，加上斯科特，临时开刀做手术。

source: ...What?
target: 什麽?

source: Something about removing Liam's face so he can see how a piercing would look on him, since mirrors aren't always an option for him.
target: 好像是要把李姆的脸取下来，让他看看自己戴上穿孔饰品是什么样子。毕竟，他也不是随时都能用镜子的。

source: Yeah... it was a mess.
target: 对... 这是一团糟。

source: You know what? That's one thing I love about this road trip: peeing peacefully in the MIDDLE OF NOWHERE.
target: 你知道吗？这趟公路旅行，有一点我特别喜欢：能在荒郊野外安安静静地尿尿。

source: I'll toast to that!
target: 为这个干杯！

source: And so, you two spend the rest of the night exchanging school memories and bathroom-related anecdotes.
target: 于是，接下来的时间，你们一直在交换校园回忆，还有各种跟厕所有关的趣事。

source: His Family
target: 他的家人

source: My family...
target: 我的家人啊……

source: Well, there's my mom...
target: 我妈妈...

source: She's the one at the helm, so to speak.
target: 可以说，家里都是她掌舵。

source: She can take care of fifteen different problems at the same time.
target: 她可以同时处理15个不同的问题.

source: She sounds like a force to be reckoned with!
target: 听起来是个厉害人物！

source: She is. She's the one who keeps both the store and the house afloat.
target: 是啊。店里和家里都靠她撑着。

source: Seeing her do her thing is almost dizzying.
target: 看她忙起来，简直让人眼花缭乱。

source: Dad helps, but he works at a different speed.
target: 我爸也帮忙，不过他的节奏不太一样。

source: He's quieter and slower... but I like to think he's steady and reliable in return.
target: 他话少，动作也慢……不过，我觉得他也更稳当、可靠。

source: A bit like you!
target: 有点像你!

source: Yeah... we like things slow.
target: 是啊……我们喜欢慢慢来。

source: You're close then?
target: 那你俩关系很好吧？

source: Well, we're not super great with words, but we do stuff together.
target: 我们都不太会说话，不过会一起做些事。

source: Mainly pickling things.
target: 主要是腌东西。

source: Yeah, as a hobby. We like pickling different foods.
target: 嗯，算是爱好吧。我们喜欢腌各种食物。

source: It's pretty chill... and you get to eat tasty stuff.
target: 挺放松的……还能吃到好吃的。

source: A win-win!
target: 双赢!

source: Totally.
target: 当然

source: Then there's my sister.
target: 我还有个姐妹。

source: She bosses me around when we're working at the store, but I know she cares about me.
target: 我们在店里工作的时候 她总管我 但我知道她很关心我

source: When we were younger, she'd protect me if anyone picked on me.
target: 小时候，要是谁欺负我，她就会护着我。

source: She sounds cool.
target: 她听起来很酷。

source: She is cool.
target: 是挺酷的。

source: And then there's Grandma.
target: 然后还有外婆.

source: She's a bit old, but she helps in the store nonetheless.
target: 她年纪有点大了，不过还是会在店里帮忙。

source: With the five of us working in the store, there's never any quiet... sigh.
target: 我们五个都在店里干活，从来就没个清静……唉。

source: Not your jam, huh?
target: 不太合你心意，是吧？

source: Eh... it's a loud and exhausting life; but it's my loud and exhausting life with my loud and exhausting family.
target: 嗯……日子又吵又累，可这就是我的日子，我的家人也就是这样，又吵又累。

source: And after a day's work, we always have dinner together and then we watch some TV. That's good.
target: 不过，每天干完活，我们总会一起吃晚饭，再看看电视。这样挺好。

source: Oh, and there's also Doggo.
target: 哦，还有狗狗。

source: Doggo?
target: 狗狗？

source: Yeah... wanna see some pics of him? He's the best.
target: 嗯……想看它的照片吗？它最棒了。

source: You spend the rest of the night looking at pictures and videos of Brian's dog. They seem thick as thieves!
target: 接下来的时间，你一直在看布赖恩家的狗的照片和视频。他们俩的关系真好！

source: His ambitions
target: 他的志向

source: Uh... none?
target: 呃……没有？

source: Like... zero?
target: 就是……完全没有？

source: Yeah... I don't know...
target: 是啊……怎么说呢……

source: Everyone always seems so stressed about goals and ambitions and whatnot...
target: 大家好像总为了目标、志向之类的事，弄得压力很大……

source: ...but who cares, really?
target: ……可这些真有那么重要吗？

source: Stress is not my thing, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我不喜欢给自己那么大压力。

source: I guess that's another way of looking at life.
target: 我想这是另一种看待生活的方式。

source: It's my way, for sure.
target: 反正，我就是这么过的。

source: Maybe I could try that sometime...
target: 也许我可以试试看...

source: There are times when I feel like I'm in an endless race where I can't stop to consider things because there's no time to lose.
target: 有时候，我觉得自己在跑一场永远不会结束的比赛，连停下来想想都不行，好像一秒钟也耽误不起。

source: But then... I'm not even sure where it's leading, or if I'll even make it to the finishing line.
target: 可实际上……我都不知道自己在往哪儿跑，也不知道能不能跑到终点。

source: Yeah, I like to think life can be about something other than big plans for the future, you know?
target: 是啊。我倒觉得，生活可以有点别的，不一定非得是对未来的宏大计划，你懂吧？

source: Life is happening right now.
target: 生活就在当下。

source: That's true...
target: 这是真的...

source: So it feels absurd when people ask where you want to be in five years... like, how could you even know that?
target: 所以，别人问你五年后想成为什么样，感觉挺荒唐的……这谁能知道啊？

source: If anything, I care about where I'll be by the end of the week:
target: 真要说，我也就关心这周结束时，自己会在哪儿：

source: Hopefully somewhere chill, maybe eating some fries.
target: 希望是个舒服的地方，也许还能吃点薯条。

source: (Man, I like fries).
target: （唉，我真喜欢薯条。）

source: I don't know, does all this sound dumb, or...? Sometimes I say dumb stuff.
target: 不知道，这些话听起来会不会很蠢……？我有时候会说蠢话。

source: It's not dumb at all, Brian.
target: 一点也不蠢，布赖恩。

source: Good. Let's celebrate by eating some fries... I don't think I want to wait till the end of the week.
target: 好。那咱们吃点薯条庆祝吧……我不想等到周末了。

source: Sounds like a plan!
target: 就这么定了！

source: And so, you two spend the rest of the night eating some fries and looking at the stars, without worrying about what tomorrow might bring.
target: 于是，接下来的时间，你们一边吃薯条，一边看星星，不再担心明天会怎样。

source: It's... refreshing.
target: 这种感觉……很轻松。

source: What's on Brian's Head?
target: 布赖恩脑袋上有什么？

source: Uh... hair, mostly.
target: 额... 主要是头发

source: And teeth.
target: 还有牙齿

source: Lots of teeth.
target: 很多牙齿。

source: No, no! I mean... you're a man of few words, you know? Sorta mysterious, even!
target: 不，不是！我是说……你平时话不多，甚至有点神秘，你知道吧？

source: So, sometimes I wonder what's on your mind!
target: 所以，我有时候会好奇，你在想什么！

source: Ah... not much.
target: 啊……没想太多。

source: Sometimes I have conversations, like, inside my head. Like... a rehearsal of sorts.
target: 有时候，我会在脑子里跟人聊天，算是……提前排练一下。

source: It's a bit useless, though... when it's showtime, I usually end up with the classics:
target: 不过，也没什么用……真要开口时，通常还是那几句老话：

source: "Sure", "Okay", or a version of that.
target: “行”“好”，或者差不多的。

source: I'm just not very good with words.
target: 我只是不太会说话

source: Tell me about it... socializing can be hard sometimes
target: 可不是嘛……有时候，跟人打交道确实挺难的。

source: Yeah... and then, other times, I just go into my worlds.
target: 是啊……还有些时候，我就待在自己的世界里。

source: What do you mean?
target: 你说什么?

source: Like, movies I play in my head, you know? Action scenarios... romcom scenarios... little dream movies I star.
target: 就像在脑子里放电影，你懂吧？动作片……爱情喜剧……我自己主演的一部部小小的梦中电影。

source: Sounds fun!
target: 听起来很有趣!

source: Yeah... all the fun without the work!
target: 是啊……乐趣全有，活儿一点不用干！

source: So that's what goes in Brian's head when he's all quiet, huh? Hypothetical conversations and imagined worlds?
target: 所以，布赖恩安安静静的时候，脑子里就是这些？预演对话，再想象些自己的世界？

source: Pretty much.
target: 差不多吧。

source: Brian?
target: 布赖恩？

source: Yeah?
target: 嗯？

source: I'm happy we got to chat, instead of just imagining the conversations in our heads. I like talking to you.
target: 能这样跟你聊聊，我很开心，总比只在各自脑子里想象聊天要好。我喜欢跟你说话。

source: Yeah... same same.
target: 嗯……我也是。

source: You spend the night talking. Brian tells you about some of these movies he makes up in his head. They're goofy and cool!
target: 你们聊了一晚。布赖恩跟你讲了几部他在脑子里编的电影，傻乎乎的，又很酷！

source: Surviving School
target: 熬过校园生活

source: Oof... surviving school was... not easy.
target: 唉……想熬过校园生活……真不容易。

source: School was already hard when I was alive...
target: 还活着的时候，上学就已经很辛苦了……

source: ...but this? This has been on a whole different level.
target: ……可现在？完全是另一个难度。

source: I feel you!
target: 我懂！

source: I wanted to focus on passing my tests... maybe playing some football...
target: 我想专注于通过我的测试... 也许打一些橄榄球...

source: But at Spooky Academy, the moment you get distracted, you may very well get murdered!
target: 可在惊悚学院，只要稍微走个神，就可能被人杀了！

source: Yeah, the murder rate at that school is... kind of worrying.
target: 是啊，那学校的谋杀率……确实让人有点担心。

source: Tell me about it!
target: 可不是嘛！

source: I still don't know how mortality works, being undead and all...
target: 我都已经是个不死生物了，还没搞懂死亡这回事，到底会怎么发生在我身上……

source: And I'm in no rush to figure that one out by myself.
target: 不过，我也不急着亲自试出来。

source: Good call!
target: 明智！

source: Still, it's not easy when people think a good strategy to win at dodgeball is "a gun".
target: 可有人觉得，打躲避球最好的取胜策略是“拿把枪”，这日子真不好过。

source: Ah, yes, the classic gun strategy.
target: 啊，没错，经典的“拿枪战术”。

source: And even if you manage to not get yourself killed, there are other dangers.
target: 而且，就算好不容易保住命，也还有别的危险。

source: Such as...?
target: 比如说... ?

source: Well, being kidnapped, for one.
target: 比如，被绑架。

source: Ah, you mean...
target: 啊,你是说...

source: Yeah, that prince guy. What's his deal?
target: 对，就是那个王子。他到底什么毛病？

source: Getting married no matter what?
target: 不管怎样，都非得结个婚？

source: Ugh...
target: 唉哟...

source: At least we owe him the classic: jaw unhinges...
target: 至少，他还给我们留下了那个经典场面：下巴脱臼……

source: ...BEES POUR OUT!
target: ……蜜蜂倾巢而出！

source: Heh... yeah, that one was good.
target: 嘿……是啊，那个确实不错。

source: Well... let's toast to school finally being behind us!
target: 好吧……为终于不用上学了，干杯！

source: Cheers!
target: 干杯！

source: You two keep reminiscing about school while looking at the stars. Brian even tells you about the time he got kidnapped by the Interdimensional Prince. It was wild!
target: 你们看着星星，继续回忆校园往事。布赖恩甚至跟你讲了他被跨次元王子绑架的那次，真够离谱的！

source: The Merkingdom
target: 人鱼王国

source: The Merkingdom is...
target: 人鱼王国是个……

source: ...a complicated place.
target: ...一个复杂的地方。

source: The Crown can be truly oppressive and ruthless. It rules with an iron fist and little mercy.
target: 王室残酷无情，压迫百姓，以铁腕统治，鲜有怜悯。

source: It's as if everything is justified as long as it keeps the Merkingdom strong, united, and in line.
target: 仿佛只要能让人鱼王国强大、团结、服从命令，一切手段就都有了正当理由。

source: When I was younger, I hated it with all my heart. How could my motherland be so atrocious?
target: 年轻时，我打心底憎恨这一切。我的祖国怎么能如此残暴？

source: And... I mean... I still hate that about the Merkingdom... but now I am conflicted.
target: 而且……我是说……我现在仍然厌恶人鱼王国的这一面……但也开始感到矛盾。

source: How so?
target: 怎么会这样?

source: Well, I've become a knight, and I've been on the front lines of the Most Important War... and it scares me.
target: 我成了骑士，也上过“最重要的战争”的前线……那让我感到恐惧。

source: The Most Important War...?
target: 最重要的战争...

source: You see, the Merkingdom is a key player in the war mortalkind wages against ancient deities that want to bring about the end of all things.
target: 凡人一直在对抗那些企图终结万物的古老神祇，而人鱼王国，是这场战争中的关键力量。

source: Years ago I thought that was just an old wives tale... another trick from the Crown to keep our people in line.
target: 多年前，我以为这不过是些无稽之谈……是王室为了让民众服从，又编的一套说辞。

source: But it's not.
target: 可事实并非如此。

source: Not so long ago, I was on a mission to stop a cabal that was channeling one of these deities into this realm.
target: 不久前，我奉命阻止一个秘密团体，他们正试图将其中一位神祇召入这个世界。

source: We managed to put a stop to it before it was too late, but... we had to face what I can only imagine was a fraction of this entity's power...
target: 我们及时阻止了他们，可……仍然不得不面对那东西的力量……而我想，那可能只是一小部分……

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... it was dozens of the finest, most valiant merknights I've ever met... and only a handful of us made it back.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……那是几十位我所见过的最优秀、最英勇的人鱼骑士……最后，只有寥寥几人活着回来。

source: I... I'm truly sorry, Adrien.
target: 我……听到这些，我真的很难过，阿德里安。

source: This is no myth or old wives tale... reality is in danger, and the enemy's power is unfathomable.
target: 这不是神话，也不是无稽之谈……现实正面临威胁，而敌人的力量深不可测。

source: Maybe the only way to survive this is by doing whatever it takes to keep us all strong, united, and in line.
target: 也许，想活下去，就只能不惜一切代价，让我们保持强大、团结，服从命令。

source: But... ugh... no... I can't justify what the Crown does...
target: 可是……唉……不，我不能为王室的所作所为开脱……

source: And yet... I feel like... even if I disagree with them... my duty now is to focus all my will and strength on stopping the end of all things.
target: 然而……我觉得……即使我不认同他们，现在也必须倾尽意志和力量，阻止万物走向终结。这是我的职责。

source: Then, after that, we can finally be reborn a better kingdom for everyone.
target: 等到那之后，我们才能重获新生，建立一个对所有人都更好的王国。

source: Look, from where I stand, it sounds like your heart is in the right place.
target: 至少在我看来，你的出发点是好的。

source: And if there are more people in the Merkingdom like you... then I think there's hope for its future.
target: 如果人鱼王国还有更多像你这样的人……那它的未来，我想还是有希望的。

source: ...Maybe.
target: 也许吧

source: Adrien truly is a brave knight, carrying the weight of the world on his shoulders. If you could only help ease that weight...
target: 阿德里安真是一位勇敢的骑士，肩上背负着整个世界的重担。真希望你能帮他减轻一些……

source: For now, you bring him some peace, if only briefly, as you two spend the rest of the night chilling and watching the stars.
target: 至少此刻，你们静静待在一起，看着星星。你给他带来了一点平静，哪怕只是片刻。

source: The Crown's enemies
target: 皇室的敌人

source: The Merkingdom has two main threats. I guess you could say three, if you counted the dissidents and internal enemies of the Crown.
target: 人鱼王国主要面临两大威胁。要是把异见者和王室的内部敌人也算上，那就是三大威胁。

source: But the main threat is the old entities trying to end reality.
target: 不过，最大的威胁，还是那些想终结现实的古老存在。

source: Well, that's more of a threat to... basically everyone.
target: 可那威胁的……基本上是所有人吧。

source: That's true; but still, they're the Merkingdom's main focus when it comes to foes to vanquish.
target: 的确。不过，说到需要击败的敌人，人鱼王国首先考虑的仍然是他们。

source: And if that wasn't enough... there's also Heaven.
target: 这还不算完……还有天堂。

source: Heaven?!
target: 天堂吗?

source: Yes. What do you know about the realms' history?
target: 是的。你对各个世界的历史了解多少？

source: Uh... not much.
target: 额... 没有太多。

source: Let me explain, then.
target: 让我来解释一下

source: Think of the realms as steps in an escape plan to put distance between mortalkind and the old deities.
target: 可以把这些世界看作一项逃亡计划中的一步步行动，目的就是让凡人尽量远离那些古老神祇。

source: Hell was the first mortal realm ever to exist outside of the Nothingness... but over time, it became corrupted by the deities trying to invade it.
target: 地狱是虚无之外，第一个诞生的凡人世界……但随着时间推移，那些试图入侵的神祇逐渐腐化了它。

source: And so mortalkind kept creating realms. The Human Realm and Heaven are the boldest moves yet, each in their own way.
target: 于是，凡人不断创造新的世界。其中，人类世界和天堂分别以各自的方式，成为迄今最大胆的尝试。

source: But Heaven? It's a hermetic place set on extreme solutions in their war against the old ones.
target: 可天堂呢？那里封闭自守，在对抗古老神祇的战争中，执意采取极端手段。

source: How extreme are we talking here?
target: 有多极端？

source: They are set on destroying Hell and the Monster Realm, as they deem those realms to be too corrupted and "far beyond salvation."
target: 他们决意摧毁地狱和怪物世界，认为这两个世界已被腐化得太严重，“彻底无可救药”。

source: As you could expect, the Merkingdom doesn't love the idea of our realm being destroyed... hence the war against Heaven.
target: 你也能想到，人鱼王国当然不愿意自己的世界被毁……于是，便与天堂开战了。

source: I disagree with the Crown on many of its choices on how to rule our motherland... but we're together on this one: Heaven must fall.
target: 对于王室治理祖国的许多做法，我并不认同……可在这件事上，我们立场一致：天堂必须覆灭。

source: I will pierce God's heart myself if that's what's necessary to save my people.
target: 如果拯救我的人民必须如此，我会亲手刺穿上帝的心脏。

source: Whoa, Adrien...
target: 哇，阿德里安……

source: You're basically in constant war, sandwiched between powerful old deities and... GOD?!
target: 所以，你们基本上一直在打仗，夹在强大的古老神祇和……上帝之间？！

source: Do you ever catch a break?!
target: 你还能有喘口气的时候吗？！

source: I do sometimes... like right now. I enjoy the peace between battles.
target: 偶尔会有……比如现在。我很珍惜战斗间隙的平静。

source: It reminds me why I fight: so that everyone is able to sit and admire the night sky without fear or suffering in their hearts.
target: 这提醒着我为何而战：为了让所有人都能坐下来，欣赏夜空，心中不再有恐惧或痛苦。

source: And that's what you do tonight. But you also admire how this valiant knight remains full of determination, even against the most hopeless odds...
target: 今晚，你们正是这样度过的。而你也敬佩这位英勇的骑士：即使希望再渺茫，他依然坚定不移……

source: Where he studied
target: 他学习的地方

source: I attended the most prestigious academy in the Merkingdom.
target: 我曾就读于人鱼王国最负盛名的学院。

source: It's exclusively available to the children of the highest-born families in all of Underwater.
target: 那里只招收整个水下世界出身最显赫的家族的子女。

source: Oooh, fancy!
target: 哦，好气派！

source: Yes, it certainly is.
target: 是的,当然是。

source: It accomplishes two goals.
target: 它有两个目的。

source: Firstly, it turns new generations of privileged merpeople into valiant knights, wise philosophers, powerful wizards, astute diplomats...
target: 首先，把新一代享有特权的人鱼培养成英勇的骑士、睿智的哲学家、强大的巫师、精明的外交官……

source: Anything that can bring value to the Crown.
target: 总之，是一切能为王室效力的人才。

source: It also keeps the most influential houses of the Merkingdom united.
target: 同时，让人鱼王国最有影响力的家族保持团结。

source: Like... yours?
target: 比如……你的家族？

source: Exactly. I come from one of the most powerful houses from the deep end of the Merkingdom.
target: 正是。我来自人鱼王国深处最有权势的家族之一。

source: Ironically, the academy is such a rich, thought-provoking environment that all sort of ideas prosper.
target: 讽刺的是，学院的环境丰富多元，又鼓励思考，各式各样的思想都能在此生根。

source: So, while some students are blindly loyal to the Crown, you'll find a handful of them who see the downsides of our monarchy.
target: 所以，虽然有些学生盲目效忠王室，也有少数人看得清君主制的弊端。

source: I've found myself sharing a table with bold minds who dare to discuss how our motherland could change and improve.
target: 我曾与一些思想大胆的人同桌而坐，讨论我们的祖国该如何改变、如何变得更好。

source: I've heard quite a bit about the Merkingdom... and it definitely sounds like there's room for improvement.
target: 我听过不少人鱼王国的事……听起来，确实有不少可以改进的地方。

source: Yes...
But that makes me think: how come Miranda studied at our academy and not yours?
target: 不过，这就让我好奇了：米兰达为什么来我们学院，而没去你那儿上学？

source: She did study at my academy. I shared some classes with Princess Miranda myself before she was transferred to an academy in the Monster Realm.
target: 她去过。我还跟米兰达公主一起上过几门课，后来她才转去怪物世界的学院。

source: I surmise that was a tactical choice to enhance the opportunity of building alliances and coalitions with domains outside of the Merkingdom.
target: 我推测，那是为了增加与人鱼王国以外的势力建立同盟的机会，一项策略性的安排。

source: She was privileged, and annoying, and cute, and spoiled... living proof that the Merkingdom must change.
target: 她享尽特权、惹人厌烦，又可爱，又娇纵……活生生地证明了，人鱼王国必须改变。

source: But I would have preferred that she stay. She could have been exposed to these daring ideas of change, and then... who knows?
target: 可我更希望她留下。这样她就能接触这些大胆的改革思想，然后……谁知道呢？

source: True, but what better way to challenge her mind than show her how things work elsewhere?
target: 确实。不过，让她亲眼看看别处的人怎么生活，不是更能挑战她原有的想法吗？

source: Hmmm... you might be right.
target: 那个... 你也许是对的。

source: I wonder if she's capable of change...
target: 不知道她是否有能力改变...

source: I like to think everyone is, Adrien.
target: 阿德里安，我愿意相信每个人都能改变。

source: You two admire the night sky as you dream of a better, more just world.
target: 你们仰望夜空，憧憬着一个更美好、更公正的世界。

source: Being a merknight
target: 当人鱼骑士

source: Truth be told, I haven't been a merknight for very long.
target: 说实话，我当人鱼骑士还没多久。

source: Until just recently, I was but a squire.
target: 直到最近,我只是一个侍从。

source: Oh, please, do tell!
target: 哦，快讲讲！

source: Of course: I was a squire to Brigadier Beluga, and joined him on many of his quests and adventures.
target: 当然。我曾是贝卢加准将的侍从，随他执行过许多任务，也经历了不少冒险。

source: Ah... I have such fond memories of that time, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 啊……%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，那段日子，留下了许多美好的回忆。

source: Brigadier Beluga was an incredible mentor. The man might appear goofy at first, but in reality he's an honorable warrior with countless victories and daring feats behind him.
target: 贝卢加准将是一位了不起的导师。初见时，他可能有点傻气，可实际上，他是一位值得尊敬的战士，立过无数战功，做过无数英勇之举。

source: He's always willing to sacrifice himself for the nation, and he firmly believes we merknights are the shield of the Merkingdom.
target: 他随时愿意为国牺牲，坚信我们人鱼骑士就是人鱼王国的盾牌。

source: Do you feel the same?
target: 你也有同感吗?

source: Hmmm... yes and no.
target: 嗯……既是，也不是。

source: Beluga is a strong loyalist to the crown. He would see the wicked ways of those in power and blindly trust they have a good reason for it. He would always protect them.
target: 贝卢加对王室忠心耿耿。哪怕亲眼看见掌权者作恶，他也会盲目地相信，他们一定有自己的理由。他总会保护他们。

source: Me? I think the Merkingdom is made up of all its subjects equally.
target: 而我认为，人鱼王国由全体臣民共同组成，每个人都同样重要。

source: I am proud to be the shield of the Merkingdom, but to me, that means being a shield for the people.
target: 我很自豪能成为人鱼王国的盾牌。但对我而言，那意味着成为人民的盾牌。

source: That's such a noble perspective, Adrien.
target: 阿德里安，这样的想法真高尚。

source: Well, the people of the Merkingdom need a champion that fights for them too.
target: 毕竟，人鱼王国的人民，也需要一位为他们而战的勇士。

source: You two sound so different, yet you seem to truly admire Brigadier Beluga.
target: 你们听起来那么不一样，可你还是很敬佩贝卢加准将。

source: I do. During our travels, we used to set camp at night. The two of us in the middle of the woods, often drinking wine and talking about everything.
target: 是的。旅途中，我们常在夜里扎营。两个人待在树林里，喝着酒，天南地北地聊。

source: We had heated discussions about these political matters. We argued passionately (and a bit drunkenly) until dawn.
target: 我们曾激烈地讨论这些政治问题，争论到天亮，既热血上头，也有点醉意上头。

source: He could have me sent to the gallows easily, just by exposing my beliefs about the need for reform... and yet, here I am.
target: 只要揭发我认为国家必须改革的想法，他就能轻易把我送上绞刑架……可我还好好地站在这里。

source: Instead, he listened to me, and chose to respect me even if he fully disagreed.
target: 他没有那么做，而是认真听我说。即使完全不认同，也选择尊重我。

source: So, while Brigadier Beluga would bleed for the Crown... I would bleed for him.
target: 所以，贝卢加准将愿为王室流血……而我，愿为他流血。

source: It's beautiful to see you have so many kind things to say about your mentor.
target: 听你这么真心地赞美自己的导师，真让人感动。

source: I think it says a lot not only about Brigadier Beluga, but also about you.
target: 我想，这不仅说明贝卢加准将是什么样的人，也说明了你是什么样的人。

source: It's just the truth.
target: 我说的只是实话。

source: You spend the rest of the night talking about Adrien's adventures as a squire. He has seen A LOT. What a humble, brave knight, this one!
target: 接下来的时间，你们一直在聊阿德里安当侍从时的冒险。他的见识可真不少。这真是一位谦逊又勇敢的骑士！

source: Competitive Tarot
target: 竞技塔罗

source: Oh, Competitive Tarot, sure!
target: 哦，竞技塔罗，当然！

source: What do you wanna know? Which major arcanas are meta this season?
target: 想知道什么？这赛季哪些大阿尔卡那最强势？

source: I meant it in a way more generic sense!
target: 我想问的没那么具体啦！

source: I've watched a few videos about it, but I still have no clue what's happening in a match half of the time.
target: 我看过几段视频，可比赛里有一半时间，都看不懂到底在干什么。

source: Playing planets to gain their influences; summoning champions; doing actual tarot reads...
target: 打出行星牌，获得它们的影响力；召唤英雄；还要真的占卜塔罗……

source: I get it. It can get confusing.
target: 懂了。是挺让人摸不着头脑的。

source: With every expansion they add new mechanics and archetypes.
target: 每出一个扩展包，都会加进新的机制和卡组体系。

source: The game keeps getting more complex and awesome...
target: 游戏变得越来越复杂，也越来越精彩……

source: ...but it admittedly gets more obscure for newcomers, too.
target: ……不过，对新人来说，确实也越来越难入门了。

source: But hey: git gud, right?
target: 可话说回来，菜就多练，对吧？

source: Eh, I suspect I won't "git gud" at this anytime soon.
target: 呃，我觉得，自己短时间内恐怕是“练不出来”了。

source: Yeah... I've looked into your future, and it's very likely you won't.
target: 嗯……我看过你的未来了，你大概还真练不出来。

source: I can live with that, but I'd still love to understand why you like it so much.
target: 我可以接受 但我还是很想了解你为什么这么喜欢它

source: Well, a card game is like this hyper-complex mechanism.
target: 怎么说呢，卡牌游戏就像一套超级复杂的机械装置。

source: At first it feels a bit intimidating, but soon you start to understand how it works.
target: 刚开始会有点望而生畏，但很快就能逐渐摸清它的运作方式。

source: Before you know it, you're thinking in terms of "tempo", "resource curves", and "card advantage". You might even build your own decks!
target: 不知不觉间，你就会开始考虑“节奏”“资源曲线”和“卡差”，甚至自己组卡组！

source: Taming such a beast and making it work in your favor feels amazing.
target: 把这样的庞然大物驯服，让它为你所用，感觉棒极了。

source: But what about the most important part: believing in the heart of the cards?!
target: 那最重要的部分呢：相信卡牌之心？！

source: Well, you're actually not wrong: no matter how good you are, there's always a degree of randomness... of fate!
target: 其实，你还真没说错。不管技术多好，总会有点随机性……有点命运的安排！

source: You never know what the next card you draw will be.
target: 你永远不知道下一张牌会是什么

source: THE HEART OF THE CARDS!!!
target: 卡牌之心！！！

source: Hehe... yes.
target: 嘿嘿……对。

source: Dang, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, this much tarot talk is making me wanna play a match...
target: 哎呀，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，聊了这么多塔罗，我都想来一局了……

source: C'mon, what do you say? I can teach you as we go.
target: 来嘛，怎么样？咱们边玩，我边教你。

source: Sure, why not?
target: 当然,为什么不呢?

source: You two spend the rest of the night playing Competitive Tarot matches.
target: 接下来的时间，你们一直在玩竞技塔罗。

source: Hope kicks your ass big time, but she's patient, and you actually learn a bit more about how the game works.
target: 希望女巫把你虐得够呛，不过她很有耐心，你也确实多学会了一点这游戏的玩法。

source: The whole Damien thing
target: 她和德魔那段往事

source: "The whole Damien thing"... that's a way to put it, huh?
target: “我和德魔那段往事”……这么说也行吧？

source: I mean, I've noticed he has... or at least HAD this sort of big crush for you... what's the story there?
target: 我是说，我看得出，他对你……至少以前对你特别着迷……你们之间到底发生过什么？

source: It's your classic teenage love story:
target: 就是个典型的青春爱情故事：

source: Girl is experimenting with her recently-awakened magic powers.
target: 女孩试着使用自己刚觉醒的魔法力量。

source: Girl sends herself to Hell and somehow ends up at an infernal palace.
target: 女孩把自己送进了地狱，稀里糊涂地来到一座地狱宫殿。

source: Boy is the Prince of that part of Hell.
target: 男孩正好是那片地狱的王子。

source: Girl and boy lock eyes.
target: 女孩和男孩，四目相对。

source: Then there's a slow dance; a first kiss; lots of new, intense, complicated emotions...
target: 然后，是一支慢舞，一个初吻，还有一大堆陌生、强烈又复杂的感情……

source: And after that? Time happens, things fade, and people move on.
target: 再后来呢？时间流逝，感情淡去，各自向前。

source: Oh...
No, it's okay, that's how these things go. Teenage love burns bright, but it doesn't tend to last.
target: 不，没关系。这种事就是这样。年少时的爱情烧得很旺，却往往不会长久。

source: And that's beautiful too.
target: 这样也很美好。

source: Sure... but I don't think Damien ever got the memo about the not-lasting part, huh?
target: 是啊……不过，德魔好像没收到“不会长久”这部分的通知，是吧？

source: Ha! Yeah...
target: 哈！是啊……

source: It's a shame, because... look, the dude's an idiot, but it's not his fault that he's having such a hard time moving on.
target: 挺可惜的……那家伙是个笨蛋，可他这么难走出来，也不是他的错。

source: If only it was that easy for two people to be in the same place emotionally...
target: 两个人在感情上要是那么容易步调一致就好了……

source: I guess sometimes people grow apart, they drift away... they become different people.
target: 有时候，人们就是会渐行渐远……各自成长为不同的人。

source: Still, I cherish our memories together, you know? Damien will always be an important chapter of my life... but one that I finished long ago.
target: 不过，我还是很珍惜我们一起度过的时光。德魔永远是我人生中重要的一章……只是这一章，我早就翻过去了。

source: I hope he starts an exciting new chapter of his own, too.
target: 我也希望他能翻开属于自己的、精彩的新篇章。

source: But hey, enough about me. Tell me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, do you have any Damiens in your past or what?
target: 不过，我的事说够了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你过去有没有过自己的“德魔”？

source: And so you spend the rest of the night exchanging corny love stories from your pasts.
target: 于是，接下来的时间，你们一直在交换过去那些俗套的爱情故事。

source: The Coven
target: 女巫会

source: Ugh... the Coven...
target: 唉……女巫会啊……

source: You don't like the Coven? I thought you were friends!
target: 你不喜欢女巫会？我还以为你们是朋友！

source: It's not that. I'd die for Faith and Joy.
target: 不是那个意思。我愿意为信念女巫和乔伊去死。

source: (I mean... I've technically died for them already.)
target: （我是说……严格来讲，我已经为她们死过了。）

source: But they're Faith and Joy; my best friends.
target: 可她们是信念女巫和乔伊，是我最好的朋友。

source: The Coven is more than that, y'know?
target: 女巫会，可不只是这样，你懂吗？

source: It's our timeless duty; our inescapable fate...
target: 那是我们永恒的职责，逃不开的命运……

source: ...it's basically our job.
target: ...这基本上是我们的工作。

source: And you know what, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? I believe in the importance of being more than your career.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我觉得，一个人不能只有工作，这很重要。

source: Even if your career is "protector of all reality".
target: 哪怕你的工作是“守护整个现实”。

source: Fair!
target: 有道理！

source: Then tell me, who is Hope beyond "a member of the Coven"?
target: 那跟我说说，除了“女巫会成员”，希望女巫还是个什么样的人？

source: That's more like it!
target: 这才像话!

source: I play Competitive Tarot; I do some side-hustles here and there; I love the fun and thrill of getting myself in trouble.
target: 我玩竞技塔罗，到处做点副业，还特别喜欢给自己惹麻烦，那种好玩又刺激的感觉。

source: While Joy and Faith are researching a Big Bad, I'm the one that gets to have a fun subplot in the 4th Circle of Hell.
target: 乔伊和信念女巫还在研究大反派的时候，我已经跑去地狱第四圈，展开自己那条好玩的支线剧情了。

source: That sounds risky... but fun.
target: 听着很冒险……不过挺好玩的。

source: Yes: in the Coven, I'm definitely the one who's fun.
target: 没错，女巫会里，最会找乐子的肯定是我。

source: Sometimes I try to push those two out of their comfort zones and away from all the Coven stuff.
target: 有时候，我会推她们一把，让她们走出舒适区，暂时放下女巫会的那些事。

source: Stuff like "Girls' Night Out", "Drunk Minigolf", or "Death Dance in the Dark Domains".
target: 比如“闺蜜之夜”“醉酒迷你高尔夫”，或者“黑暗领域死亡之舞”。

source: Whoa... those definitely do NOT sound like the kind of things Faith or Joy would do.
target: 哇……这些可真不像是信念女巫或者乔伊会干的事。

source: Exactly!
target: 没错!

source: Faith is lovely, and the voice of reason, but she could use some thrill every now and then.
target: 信念女巫很可爱，总能保持理智，可偶尔也该找点刺激。

source: And Joy? Best leader ever, but half the time she's too bossy... and the other half she's hella stressed.
target: 至于乔伊？她是最棒的领队，可一半时间太爱发号施令，另一半时间又压力大得要命。

source: I've noticed.
target: 我已经注意到了。

source: Yeah... so that's me: the one who manages to have a personal life and does her best to help those two have one as well.
target: 是啊……所以，这就是我：有自己的生活，也尽力帮她们俩拥有自己的生活。

source: Hope, you know what? That sounds fun, but also very necessary.
target: 希望女巫，这听起来不光好玩，还很有必要。

source: I think so too. A "Girls' Night Out" every now and then is what keeps us from losing our minds from the high stakes we face day after day.
target: 我也这么觉得。每天面对的事都那么重大，偶尔来个“闺蜜之夜”，才不至于把自己逼疯。

source: I know I'm not saving the world constantly... but I'd be down for one of those plans one day...
target: 虽然我没有整天忙着拯救世界……不过，哪天也想跟你一起去玩这些……

source: Oh! Sure! I'm always down for some Drunk Minigolf.
target: 哦！当然！醉酒迷你高尔夫，我随时奉陪。

source: For the next few hours, Hope tells you what alcohols are best for Drunk Minigolf.
target: 接下来几个小时，希望女巫跟你讲了，玩醉酒迷你高尔夫时，最适合喝哪些酒。

source: Magic
target: 魔法

source: Magic... it can get boring because it involves lots of studying...
target: 魔法啊……有时候挺无聊的，因为有一大堆东西要学……

source: ...but it's also very cool, because it lets you make things explode. Kaboom!
target: ……可也很酷，能让东西爆炸。轰！

source: That sounds dangerous...
target: 这听起来很危险... ...

source: Well, danger IS my thing.
target: 危险本来就是我的爱好。

source: Like... it's not as if we're limited to specific spells, but each of us surely has their strengths.
target: 怎么说呢……我们倒不是只能用特定的法术，不过每个人确实各有所长。

source: I focus on my visions, all sorts of dangerous spells, and what we could call "attack" magic. I'm the glass cannon of the Coven!
target: 我主要擅长预知、各种危险法术，还有所谓的“攻击型”魔法。我就是女巫会的玻璃大炮！

source: Faith is more of an "out of combat" witch. She specializes in healing and utility spells.
target: 信念女巫更擅长“战斗之外”的事，专精治疗和各种实用法术。

source: Joy is quite proficient at most things, but her specialty is defensive magic.
target: 乔伊什么都挺擅长，不过最拿手的，还是防御魔法。

source: She's also the one with the strongest connection to the Goddess.
target: 她也是与女神关系最紧密的一位.

source: What's the deal with that?
target: 这是怎么回事?

source: With the Goddess? Well, for starters, she isn't technically a goddess.
target: 你说女神？首先，严格来说，她并不算女神。

source: (As a matter of fact, almost all things that call themselves "deities" tend not to be, in technical terms.)
target: （其实，几乎所有自称“神”的东西，严格来说，往往都不算神。）

source: Then... what's this Goddess if not a goddess?
target: 那麽... 如果不是女神,这个女神是什么?

source: It's complicated, and I'm not too clear on it myself, but I think it's like a collective consciousness of past Coven witches who live in some sort of immaterial plane.
target: 挺复杂的，我自己也没太弄明白。好像是历代女巫会成员组成的集体意识，存在于某个非物质位面。

source: ALL the past Coven witches?
target: 所有历代女巫会成员？

source: No idea. Maybe some? Just the first ones? Eh... magic stuff tends to be super obscure. It's pretty annoying.
target: 不知道。也许只有一部分？或者就最初那几个？唉……魔法这东西，总是神神秘秘、让人摸不着头脑的。烦死了。

source: What matters is that the Goddess is a good ally to have in our corner. She knows lots of stuff and gives very decent advice.
target: 重要的是，有女神这个盟友站在我们这边，很有帮助。她知道很多事，给的建议也挺靠谱。

source: The Coven's virtual assistant!
target: 女巫会的虚拟助手！

source: Don't let Joy hear you say that... but basically.
target: 可别让乔伊听见你这么说……不过，差不多。

source: Hope...
target: 希望女巫……

source: Yes?
target: 嗯？

source: Can you show me the spells that make things explode?
target: 能给我看看那些能让东西爆炸的法术吗？

source: NOW you're asking the right questions. Let's get to it!
target: 这才问到点子上了。走着！

source: And so begins a beautiful night full of bombastic pyrotechnics. Kaboom!
target: 于是，一个充满华丽焰火的美好夜晚开始了。轰！

source: Office Life
target: 办公室生活

source: Hmmm... I actually don't work in the office that often anymore.
target: 嗯……其实，我现在已经不怎么去办公室上班了。

source: Being Mr. Pappas' personal assistant and all...
target: 毕竟，现在是帕帕斯先生的私人助理……

source: Do you miss working in the office?
target: 你想念在办公室工作吗?

source: Well, both jobs were sort of shitty in their own unique ways.
target: 怎么说呢，两份工作都有各自糟心的地方。

source: Yikes.
target: 唉哟!

source: In the office I didn't have to carry a heavy throne with my boss on it...
target: 在办公室里，至少不用抬着沉甸甸的王座，连同上面的老板一起走……

source: Which was... an upside, right?
target: 这……算是个优点吧？

source: Heh... yes, it was.
target: 嘿……嗯，算是。

source: But doing a routine spreadsheet-based job in an office can get old fast.
target: 不过，每天坐在办公室里对着电子表格干重复工作，很快就会腻。

source: You input numbers for full hours... full days... full weeks...
target: 输数字，一输就是几个小时……一整天……一整周……

source: Soon the numbers start losing their meaning...
target: 数字很快就失去意义了...

source: ...and they become these mysterious symbols you inscribe here as some sort of mysterious ritual.
target: ……最后，就只剩些神秘符号，你把它们填进去，仿佛在进行什么神秘仪式。

source: The ritual of... finance!
target: 名为……财务的仪式！

source: Sort of, yes.
target: 嗯，差不多吧。

source: It can be incredibly dull and numbing.
target: 无聊得要命，整个人都会麻木。

source: On the other hand... it can also be soothing. The unexpected ASMR of fingers pressing keys, of numbers filling cells...
target: 不过……有时候也挺让人放松的。手指敲着键盘，数字填满格子……没想到吧，还能听出点ASMR的感觉。

source: Working in an office also has the upside of having coworkers.
target: 在办公室上班，还有个好处，就是有同事。

source: Were you friends with your coworkers?
target: 你跟同事是朋友吗？

source: I don't know about friends... I wouldn't meet any of them for coffee these days.
target: 朋友嘛……倒也说不上。现在要约喝咖啡，我是不会约他们的。

source: But we were a tight squad. They may not have been "friends" exactly, but we were... comrades.
target: 不过，我们挺团结的。也许算不上“朋友”，可也算……战友吧。

source: We had our little games and traditions that saved us all from terminal boredom.
target: 我们有自己的小游戏和小传统，免得大家真的无聊死。

source: Oh, no! Not death by yawn!
target: 哦，不！可不能打着哈欠就没命了！

source: You know it!
target: 就是啊！

source: And so we fought against it with dumb little office competitions, secret gambling on menial things... or Crazy Hat Thursdays!
target: 所以，我们会搞些傻乎乎的办公室比赛，偷偷拿小事打赌……还有周四疯帽日！

source: Crazy Hat Thursdays? I need to know more about that!
target: 周四疯帽日？这个我可得听听！

source: Happy to oblige.
target: 乐意效劳

source: Finn shows you some of his best looks for Crazy Hat Thursday while you two listen to some Office ASMR. What a nice night!
target: 你们听着办公室ASMR，芬恩给你看了几套自己在周四疯帽日的得意造型。真是个不错的夜晚！

source: The Merkingdom
target: 人鱼王国

source: So, I heard you say in the car that you're from the Merkingdom?
target: 我听你在车上说，你来自人鱼王国？

source: Yeah, I was born there... but I got out the minute I had the chance.
target: 是啊，我出生在那里……不过一有机会，就离开了。

source: I get you. I've heard... not-so-great things about that place.
target: 我懂。我听说过那个地方……名声可不怎么好。

source: Exactly.
target: 没错

source: I moved Abovewater, looking to be my own person.
target: 我搬到了水上世界，想过上自己的生活。

source: Rent an apartment; have a career; maybe even start a business... you know, the Abovewater Dream.
target: 租间公寓，有份事业，没准还能自己创业……你懂的，“水上梦”。

source: But maaaaaan, after these few years, I'm not sure if I can call it a "dream" anymore.
target: 可天哪，过了这几年，我都不确定还能不能叫它“梦”了。

source: Abovewater grinds you in thankless jobs for pennies, always under the promise of bright futures that never come.
target: 水上世界让你干着吃力不讨好的工作，把你榨干，只给几个小钱，却总用永远不会来的美好未来吊着你。

source: Tell me about it!
target: 可不是嘛！

source: They milk your dreams to push the limits of what's acceptable for a job.
target: 他们拿你的梦想做文章，让你不断忍受越来越过分的工作要求。

source: You go over forty hours a week, and you still somehow end up on an instant noodles diet.
target: 一周干四十多个小时，到头来还得靠方便面过日子。

source: Like... If I hear one more person tell me I don't have my dream job yet because I'm not "trying hard enough", I will cave their heads in with a hammer.
target: 再有谁说，我还没找到理想工作，是因为“不够努力”，我就拿锤子把他的脑袋砸瘪。

source: Yikes... I'm sorry the Abovewater didn't live up to your expectations...
target: 天哪……水上世界没能让你如愿，真让人难过……

source: Nah, it's not like it's your fault!
target: 哎，又不是你的错！

source: If anything, I'm sorry for venting.
target: 倒是我，不该一直跟你发牢骚。

source: It's okay. I can see why you might have some pent-up frustration!
target: 没关系，我能理解，你心里肯定憋了不少气！

source: Look, in the end, Abovewater still beats an authoritarian monarchy that's trigger-happy with public executions and whatnot.
target: 说到底，水上世界还是比那种动不动就公开处决人的专制君主国强。

source: But it's like when you live by yourself for the first time...
target: 可这就像第一次搬出去自己住……

source: You're so excited to be on your own that ANYTHING does the trick.
target: 终于能独立了，兴奋得什么地方都能凑合。

source: Your first apartment may very well be a hole in a wall.
target: 第一间公寓，可能就是个破得不行的小屋。

source: But by your third apartment, you realize you'd prefer a place with good lighting. On your fifth apartment, you learn you want central heating. And so on.
target: 可等搬到第三间，你就知道自己更想要采光好的；到了第五间，又发现还得有中央供暖。诸如此类。

source: That was me: I just wanted to escape the Vanderbilt regime, at any cost.
target: 我当时就是这样：只要能逃离范德比尔特政权，什么代价都愿意付。

source: Today, I realize Abovewater could... still do better?
target: 可现在，我觉得水上世界……也还是可以更好，对吧？

source: My man, I can assure you that I wholeheartedly agree.
target: 兄弟，我可以向你保证，我完全赞同。

source: Who knows... maybe one day things will improve.
target: 谁知道... 也许有一天事情会好转。

source: Yeah, maybe... or maybe we should start searching for a third, better place to live... like Finland!
target: 嗯，也许吧……或者咱们该再找第三个更好的地方住……比如芬兰！

source: You two spend the rest of the night searching information about Finland. Apparently, it's the country with the most heavy metal bands per capita!
target: 接下来的时间，你们一直在查芬兰的资料。据说，那是人均重金属乐队最多的国家！

source: His job
target: 他的工作

source: Well, I'm Mr. Pappas' personal assistant.
target: 我是帕帕斯先生的私人助理。

source: So... you... assist his personality?
target: 所以……你……是给他的个性当助手？

source: ...You have no idea what a personal assistant is, do you?
target: 你不知道什么是私人助理,是吗?

source: ...Maybe not. Explain it to me as if I had no idea.
target: ……可能确实不知道。你就当我一无所知，给我讲讲吧。

source: Sure.
target: 当然可以。

source: I devote myself to optimize Mr. Pappas' day-to-day life.
target: 我负责让帕帕斯先生的日常生活更高效。

source: From arranging meetings to organizing his schedule.
target: 从安排会议到安排日程

source: And many more things!
target: 还有很多事情!

source: It sounds like you liked the job!
target: 听起来你喜欢这份工作!

source: Yes, I do!
target: 是啊，我喜欢！

source: I mean... Mr. Pappas is a HORRIBLE boss.
target: 我是说……帕帕斯先生是个烂透了的老板。

source: But I like being a PA.
target: 可我喜欢当私人助理。

source: Ideally, you work for someone you respect and admire, making their success your mission.
target: 理想情况下，你会为一个自己尊敬、钦佩的人工作，把助他成功当作自己的使命。

source: It's like being the right hand to a valiant hero or a powerful commander.
target: 就像成为英勇的英雄，或者强大指挥官的左膀右臂。

source: You help them reach their full potential.
target: 帮助他们发挥全部潜力。

source: Sounds like a noble endeavor.
target: 听着是件高尚的事。

source: It is.
target: 没错

source: But alas... I'm stuck with Mr. Pappas...
target: 可惜……我偏偏摊上了帕帕斯先生……

source: ...a dumb, greedy tyrant who's inexplicably obsessed with shopping malls.
target: ……一个又蠢又贪婪的暴君，莫名其妙地痴迷购物中心。

source: Jeez.
target: 天呐

source: Yeah... my main task is to carry him in a big-ass throne.
target: 是啊……我的主要工作，就是抬着他那张大得要命的王座，连他一起抬。

source: Dang, Finn...
target: 天哪，芬恩……

source: How's... your back?
target: 你的背……还好吗？

source: Not good.
target: 情况不妙。

source: I think I can help with that, if you're game.
target: 你要是愿意，我想我能帮帮忙。

source: You spend the rest of the night chatting while you give Finn a massage. His back is basically made of knots. Poor soul.
target: 接下来的时间，你一边给芬恩按摩，一边跟他聊天。他整个后背都僵成一团了。可怜的人。

source: His hobbies
target: 他的爱好

source: Hmmm... I love going to the arcade late at night, when I have the chance.
target: 嗯……有机会的话，我喜欢半夜去游戏厅。

source: Late night arcade?!
target: 半夜去游戏厅？！

source: Yeah. I get burnt out from work, so sometimes I need to hit the streets in order to not lose my head.
target: 是啊，工作太累，有时候就得上街玩玩，免得自己发疯。

source: Finn hitting the streets!
target: 芬恩也要上街潇洒啦！

source: Heh, yes... it sounded a little corny, didn't it?
target: 嘿，是啊……这么说有点土，是吧？

source: Just a bit, but in a good way!
target: 就一点点，不过是挺讨人喜欢的那种！

source: The thing is, I need some activity that lets me release all the stress I've built up during the week.
target: 主要是，我得找点事干，把一周积下来的压力都释放出来。

source: Something fun, but also very high-energy.
target: 要好玩，也得足够带劲。

source: The arcade... laser tag... karaoke...
target: 游戏厅……激光枪对战……卡拉OK……

source: Nothing beats getting tipsy and trying to beat the high scores at DDR.
target: 喝得微醺，再去挑战DDR的最高分，别提多爽了。

source: Or going to karaoke with my coworkers and screaming my lungs out along to a good heavy metal song.
target: 或者跟同事一起去唱卡拉OK，扯着嗓子吼一首重金属。

source: Wow, Finn! I wouldn't have expected that from you!
target: 哇，芬恩！真没想到你还有这一面！

source: Ha! And you still haven't seen me drunk-dancing!
target: 哈！你还没见过我喝醉了跳舞呢！

source: And let me tell you: I hold half of the high scores at the arcade, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 而且，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，告诉你吧，游戏厅里有一半的最高分纪录，都是我的。

source: Whaaaaa... you mean I'm sitting here... with a celebrity?
target: 哇——你是说……我现在正坐在一位名人旁边？

source: Well, depending on who you ask... yes!
target: 嗯，看你问的是谁了……没错！

source: (Just kidding.)
target: (只是开玩笑。)

source: Don't sell yourself short!
target: 别小看自己！

source: Anyway... I've had so many good nights... dancing 'til dawn, or hearing all my peers roar when I hit an impossible note... I love it.
target: 总之……我过过不少美妙的夜晚，跳舞跳到天亮，或者飙出个难得离谱的音，让伙伴们放声欢呼……我太爱了。

source: I can tell! You have a twinkle in your eye when you talk about it.
target: 看得出来！一聊这些，你眼睛都亮了。

source: Yeah. Like... it's my dream to grow as a personal assistant, and I spend way too many hours at the office...
target: 是啊……我梦想着成为更出色的私人助理，也为此在办公室耗了太多时间……

source: ...but it feels good to be something other than just my job, y'know?
target: ……但除了工作，还能有点别的身份，这感觉真好，你懂吧？

source: Finn is so exhausted half of the time that you never imagined seeing such a fire in his soul. What an interesting fella...
target: 芬恩有一半时间都累得不行，你从没想过，他的心里居然还有这样的热情。真是个有意思的人……

source: How to run a cult
target: 如何管理邪教

source: Uhm, that's a good question.
target: 嗯,这是一个很好的问题。

source: Running a cult is full of challenges!
target: 经营邪教组织充满了挑战!

source: I can only imagine! Convincing all those people to abandon their lives just to worship you like a deity...
target: 想也知道！得说服那么多人放弃原来的生活，把你当神一样崇拜……

source: Oh, no, that part is actually quite easy.
target: 哦,不,那部分其实相当容易。

source: For some reason I keep walking into people who are ready to devote their lives to me.
target: 不知道为什么，我总能碰到愿意把一生都奉献给我的人。

source: I knew I was charming, but not THAT charming!
target: 我知道自己很有魅力，可没想到有这么大魅力！

source: Even your biggest foes can become faithful followers!
target: 即使你最大的敌人也能成为忠实的追随者!

source: (If you hit them hard enough.)
target: （只要揍得够狠。）

source: Taking notes here.
target: 记下了。

source: Besides that, the hard part is keeping the helpless little cultists alive and appeased.
target: 除此之外，难的是让那些什么都不会的小信徒好好活着，还得哄他们开心。

source: Did you know that they need food and sleep EVERY DAY?
target: 你知道吗？他们每天都得吃饭、睡觉！

source: No way!
target: 不会吧!

source: And they're always hanging around piles of poop and vomit! It's like they WANT to get sick and die!
target: 而且，他们老是在一堆堆屎和呕吐物旁边晃悠！简直像巴不得自己生病死掉！

source: Um, I'm sorry, did you say "piles of poop"?
target: 呃，抱歉，你刚刚说的是“一堆堆屎”？

source: Oh, yeah. You don't even want to KNOW about all the poop cleanup.
target: 哦，对。要清理多少屎，你绝对不会想知道。

source: Nobody ever warns you how much poop one cult can produce.
target: 从来没人提前告诉你，一个邪教能拉出多少屎。

source: Yikes. I guess being a cult leader isn't all glitz and glamor.
target: 嘶，看来当邪教教主，也不全是光鲜亮丽的事。

source: You betcha, my friend.
target: 当然,我的朋友。

source: But you know what? I love my little flock. I'd clean all the poop in the world for them.
target: 不过你知道吗？我爱我这群小信徒。为了他们，全世界的屎我都愿意铲。

source: That's so sweet of you.
target: 你真贴心

source: It's the least I can do. I mean, they're willing to give their lives for me (and many of them probably will).
target: 这是我该做的。毕竟，他们愿意为我献出生命（其中很多人大概真会如此）。

source: Why this sudden interest in cult leadership, though?
target: 不过，你怎么突然对当邪教教主感兴趣了？

source: I just want to keep my career options open! You never know.
target: 我只是想给职业发展多留点选择！谁知道以后会怎样呢。

source: Oh, your own cult? That sounds fun!
target: 哦,你自己的邪教吗? 这听起来很有趣!

source: Our cults could even become friends.
target: 我们的邪教甚至可以成为朋友。

source: (Otherwise I may have to bring destruction upon you.)
target: （不然，我可能就得灭了你们。）

source: Duly noted.
target: 都记下来了

source: You two keep talking about the hardships and challenges of running a cult.
target: 你们继续聊着经营邪教的种种艰辛与挑战。

source: The Lamb seems like such a good cult leader that, for a moment, you consider becoming a cult follower instead of a cult leader.
target: 羔羊看起来真是个出色的教主，有那么一瞬间，你觉得与其自己当教主，不如直接去当信徒。

source: Cult rituals
target: 邪教仪式

source: Oooh, rituals are some of the most fun you can have while being in a cult!
target: 哦——在邪教里，参加仪式可是最好玩的事之一！

source: Especially considering most of the other activities are either "hard labor", "hours of prayer", or "dying."
target: 尤其是其他活动基本只有“苦役”“祈祷好几个小时”，或者“去死”的时候。

source: I mean... some of the rituals also include dying; but the fun kind!
target: 我是说……有些仪式也得去死，不过是好玩的那种！

source: Eh... okay. What are some other rituals you do without the "dying" bit?
target: 呃……好吧。那你们有没有什么不需要“去死”的仪式？

source: Well, there's bonfires, feasts, funerals, holy days of rest...
target: 当然。有篝火、宴席、葬礼，还有神圣的休息日……

source: ...fighting pits, necromantic resurrections, sacrifices of the flesh...
target: ……角斗场、死灵复活、血肉献祭……

source: Wait, no, I'm pretty sure that last one involves dying.
target: 等等，不对。最后那个，我很确定是得死的。

source: Yeah, it sounds like it.
target: 嗯，听着是。

source: But does it involve the fun kind of "dying", though?
target: 可那也是好玩的那种“死”吗？

source: Totally!
target: 绝对!

source: A big tentacle erupts from the ground and gives a big, warm hug to the follower.
target: 一条巨大的触手从地下钻出来，给信徒一个大大的、温暖的拥抱。

source: The follower is all like "Aaaaaaaaah!", which you know is a fun sound, because it's the same sound you'd make if you were riding a roller coaster!
target: 信徒就会“啊啊啊啊——！”你知道，这肯定是开心的叫声，毕竟坐过山车时，大家也是这么叫的！

source: And the tentacle is all like "(UNINTELLIGIBLE SCREECHING ELDRITCH NOISES)".
target: 触手则会这样：“（无法听懂的、刺耳诡异的怪叫）”。

source: Fun!
target: 开心!

source: Eh... ah... well, the feasts and the bonfires surely sound like a good time!
target: 呃……啊……好吧，宴席和篝火听着，肯定挺好玩的！

source: Yay! I can teach you some of the lyrics to the chanting we do. It involves a lot of arcane forbidden languages... and repeating my name a lot!
target: 好耶！我可以教你几句我们吟唱的歌词。里面有好多神秘的禁忌语言……还会不停重复我的名字！

source: Sounds like a plan!
target: 就这么定了！

source: You spend the rest of the night learning cult chanting. The Lamb even improvises a bonfire and you do some silly ritual dancing together. And you know what? It IS fun!
target: 接下来的时间，你一直在学邪教的吟唱。羔羊甚至临时生了堆篝火，和你一起跳了些傻乎乎的仪式舞。你还别说，真挺好玩的！

source: Building the cult headquarters
target: 建立邪教组织总部

source: Building out the headquarters took FOREVER. But we've come a long way!
target: 修建总部可花了好长时间。不过，现在已经大不一样了！

source: When we started out, we were just a group of poor, starving souls in sleeping bags.
target: 刚开始，我们就是一群穷得叮当响、饿得前胸贴后背的人，睡觉只能钻睡袋。

source: Morale was low, and poop levels were high.
target: 士气很低，屎倒是堆得很高。

source: So I asked myself, "What would make this poor, hungry flock of mine happy?" And then it came to me!
target: 于是我问自己：“怎么才能让我这群又可怜、又饿的小信徒开心呢？”然后，我就想到办法了！

source: They needed a huge statue of me to pray to every day!
target: 他们需要一座我的巨型雕像，好每天向我祈祷！

source: Did it work?
target: 有用吗?

source: I think so! They sure chant at that statue a lot.
target: 我觉得挺管用的！他们确实老在雕像前吟唱。

source: That made me think: "Why stop at a big statue of myself?"
target: 这又让我想：“为什么只给自己造一座大雕像就停手呢？”

source: So I built a whole chapel for the followers to gather and listen to my holy word.
target: 所以，我又建了一整座礼拜堂，让信徒们聚在一起，聆听我的圣言。

source: They LOVE listening to my sermons. And sometimes there's even sacrifices!
target: 他们可爱听我布道了。有时还会安排献祭！

source: You spoil them!
target: 你宠坏他们了!

source: Hehe, those little rascals deserve that and more!
target: 嘿嘿，那些小淘气值得这么好的待遇，甚至更多！

source: Anyway, once I covered those basic necessities, I could move on to building less important structures, such as a cooking fire or a healing bay.
target: 总之，满足了这些基本需求后，我才开始修建不那么重要的设施，比如做饭的火堆、疗伤的地方。

source: Whoa, your headquarters doesn't sound half bad. I may end up moving there.
target: 哇,你的总部听起来还不错 我可能最终会搬到那里。

source: You're always welcome, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. The only price is eternal worship.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，随时欢迎你来，唯一的代价就是永远崇拜我。

source: And this is only the beginning. I wonder what new structures I can build now that I've covered all the essentials. Some sort of fun building perhaps...
target: 这还只是个开始。基本需求都满足了，接下来还能建点什么呢？也许该造点好玩的……

source: Ooh, like a nightclub! Nightclubs are fun!
target: 哦,像一个夜总会! 夜总会很有趣!

source: Hmm, I was thinking more in the vein of demonic summoning circles and confession booths and statues made of the bones of my enemies...
target: 嗯，我想的更像是恶魔召唤法阵、告解亭，还有用敌人的骨头造的雕像……

source: But a nightclub could be cool too!
target: 但夜总会也不错!

source: How many bones do you think I'd need to build one?
target: 你觉得造一间得用多少骨头？

source: No idea. Let's figure that one out!
target: 不知道，咱们研究研究！

source: You and the Lamb spend the rest of the night planning the new nightclub. It turns out you'll need a LOT of bones.
target: 接下来的时间，你和羔羊一直在规划那间新夜总会。结果发现，需要的骨头可真不少。

source: Doctrine
target: 教义

source: Ah, yeah, being an all-powerful cult leader isn't all fun and games and murder!
target: 啊，对。当个无所不能的邪教教主，可不只是吃喝玩乐、杀杀人！

source: Sometimes, I have to use my brain.
target: 有时候,我必须用我的大脑。

source: I can only imagine, with so many followers looking up to you.
target: 想也知道，毕竟有那么多信徒指望着你。

source: Totally! They kneel before me and go: "O almighty Lamb, enlighten us with your timeless wisdom".
target: 可不是！他们跪在我面前，说：“哦，万能的羔羊，请用您永恒的智慧启迪我们。”

source: Way to put me on the spot, guys!
target: 伙计们，这不是把我架上去了吗！

source: That's why I have these tablets.
target: 所以，我才带着这些石板。

source: Huh, yeah, I was actually curious about them. How do they work exactly?
target: 哦，对，我还真挺好奇的。这些石板具体怎么用？

source: Well, I carry them around and write my doctrines there when I'm in a thinky mood.
target: 我随身带着它们，哪天想动动脑筋，就往上面写教义。

source: My guys will do ANYTHING these tablets tell them to do!
target: 只要是石板上写的，我的信徒什么都肯干！

source: Really?
target: 真的吗?

source: Yeah! Like, one time I came back from an adventure and everyone was starving!
target: 对! 有一次我从一次冒险中回来 大家都在挨饿!

source: They're all like, "Bwaaa, we're hungry! If you're so all-powerful, why don't you make us a delicious fish bowl? We're tired of eating grass!"
target: 他们一个劲地说：“呜呜，我们饿了！你不是无所不能吗，怎么不给我们做碗好吃的鱼？我们都吃腻草了！”

source: Everyone is a food critic these days, amirite?
target: 现在人人都是美食评论家，是吧？

source: Yup. So I go over to the temple, I declare a 3-day ritual fast, and BOOM! Suddenly everybody's happy as a clam!
target: 就是啊。于是，我走进神殿，宣布举行三天斋戒仪式。嘿，立竿见影！大家立刻都开心得不得了！

source: Wow!
target: 哗!

source: Well, not everybody. There was this follower who was plotting to murder me.
target: 好吧，也不是所有人。有个信徒居然在策划谋杀我。

source: I'm blessing him every day, and there he is, spouting hatred... through a megaphone! Like... really?
target: 我每天都祝福他，他却在那里宣扬仇恨……还用上了扩音器！不是，至于吗？

source: Rude!
target: 真没礼貌！

source: And then it hits me: of course, the tablets!
target: 然后，我灵光一闪：对啊，石板！

source: I get one of them and I write "Sacrificing a follower is A-OK".
target: 我拿过一块，写上“献祭信徒完全没问题”。

source: Then I grab my knife and RIP! SLASH! SPLATTER!
target: 再抓起刀，撕啦！唰！血花四溅！

source: The sounds are meant to be murder sounds. I murdered him.
target: 这些是杀人时的声音。意思就是，我把他杀了。

source: Yeah, I got that. Dang, you play hard, don't you?
target: 嗯，这我听懂了。天哪，你是真下狠手啊？

source: You betcha! And with these tablets I also play smart! No more traitors and the followers had no issue with it since it was all within the doctrines.
target: 那当然！有这些石板，我还能用巧招！叛徒没了，其他信徒也没意见，毕竟一切都符合教义嘛。

source: Ah, if only I could use the tablets to teach my followers how to cook...
target: 唉，要是还能用石板教会信徒做饭就好了……

source: I guess there're miracles even the Lamb can't perform!
target: 看来，有些奇迹连羔羊也办不到！

source: Oh, whatever! I can just tell them to eat each other! Hehe!
target: 哦，无所谓！我直接让他们互相吃掉就行了！嘿嘿！

source: You spend the rest of the night learning about the Cult's doctrine. You hope the Lamb doesn't resort to cannibalism just yet: it'd be nice to visit and not be part of the menu.
target: 接下来的时间，你一直在了解邪教的教义。你希望羔羊暂时还别搞同类相食：能去做客，又不用成为菜单上的菜，就挺好的。

source: Death
target: 死亡

source: You want to talk about death? That's heavy, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 你想聊死亡？这话题可够沉重的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: You can say I'm not your standard conversationalist!
target: 可以说，我不是那种按常理聊天的人！

source: (Some say it's part of my charm.)
target: (有人说这是我魅力的一部分)

source: Fair!
target: 有道理！

source: I know a thing or two about death: I've been sacrificed, bled out, mangled, eaten, burnt to a crisp, crushed by a giant frog tongue...
target: 对死亡，我多少懂一点：被献祭、失血而死、被撕得稀烂、被吃掉、烧成焦炭、被巨蛙的舌头压碎……

source: Ouch.
target: 哎哟。

source: Ouch indeed.
target: 确实疼。

source: But at least I can come back after I die. My followers don't have that luxury.
target: 不过，至少我死了还能回来。我的信徒可没这待遇。

source: Ah, a cult member dying is never good news, my friend.
target: 朋友，死了个信徒，绝对不是什么好消息。

source: For one, seeing a corpse really kills my living followers' vibes.
target: 首先，看见尸体，活着的信徒就全没了兴致。

source: If that wasn't enough, dead people smell! Did you know?
target: 这还不算完，死人还会臭！你知道吗？

source: I've noticed.
target: 我已经注意到了。

source: Yeah... it was a big improvement the day I discovered you could actually bury the corpses to cover the smell.
target: 是啊……后来我发现，把尸体埋起来就能盖住臭味，生活一下子改善了不少。

source: But wanna know a little trick?
target: 但想知道一个小把戏吗?

source: If one day you don't feel like digging, you can just harvest the corpse meat and serve it as a nutritious, funky meal!
target: 哪天懒得挖坑，只要从尸体上取下肉，就能做出营养丰富、风味独特的一餐！

source: Wait... you mean you EAT your followers' remains?
target: 等等……你是说，你会吃掉信徒的遗体？

source: Noooo, silly, that'd be gross!
target: 才不会呢，傻瓜，那多恶心啊！

source: I have my FOLLOWERS eat their remains.
target: 我会让其他信徒吃掉那些遗体。

source: A cult has a lot of mouths to feed, y'know!
target: 邪教里可是有好多张嘴等着吃饭呢，你懂吧！

source: Okay, I can't help but wonder now: if I happened to die, what meal would you cook with my remains?
target: 好吧，我现在忍不住好奇：要是我不小心死了，你会把我的遗体做成什么菜？

source: Oh, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, you truly aren't your everyday standard conversationalist!
target: 哦，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你这聊天方式，确实太不一般了！

source: You two spend the rest of the night discussing potential recipes for your corpse in the event you died. You will call your lawyer next week to add it to your will.
target: 接下来的时间，你们一直在讨论，万一你死了，可以拿你的尸体做哪些菜。下周，你就要打电话给律师，把这些加进遗嘱。

source: Missing socks
target: 袜子不见了

source: Maaaan, missing socks are a total mystery to me!
target: 天哪，袜子失踪这事，我也完全搞不懂！

source: I go all "wash wash wash", and before I know it, they've vanished into thin air...
target: 我明明在那儿“洗呀洗呀洗”，结果一不留神，它们就凭空消失了……

source: They are sneaky motherfuckers!
target: 真是一群滑头王八蛋！

source: I guess it can get frustrating...
target: 听着就挺让人烦的……

source: It is... but those pesky socks won't defeat Dahlia Aquino, conqueror of Hell, vanquisher of stains!
target: 是啊……但这些讨厌的袜子，休想打败达丽雅·阿基诺——地狱征服者、污渍克星！

source: Other machines envy me; monsters admire me; GERMS FEAR ME!
target: 机器嫉妒我，怪物仰慕我，细菌惧怕我！

source: And the missing socks? They might have eluded me for now... but they can't hide for long.
target: 至于失踪的袜子？它们也许暂时逃过了我的手掌心……但藏不了多久。

source: Do you have any clue where the socks go, though?
target: 你知不知道袜子跑到哪里去了?

source: I'm not sure...
target: 我还不太确定……

source: Sometimes I think they're hiding just around the corner, scared shitless of my washing powers.
target: 有时候，我觉得它们就躲在拐角处，被我的洗涤神力吓破了胆。

source: Or maybe I clean them so hard that I literally ERASE THEM FROM EXISTENCE.
target: 也可能是我洗得太猛，直接把它们从存在中抹掉了。

source: That sounds likely!
target: 听起来很有可能！

source: And sometimes... sometimes I think they might be in France.
target: 有时候... 有时候我想他们可能在法国

source: ...Why France?
target: ...为什么是法国?

source: Why not?
target: 为什么不呢?

source: Well, Dahlia, I trust that one day you'll find the missing socks.
target: 达丽雅，我相信，你总有一天会找到那些失踪的袜子的。

source: I have a scrapbook filled with clues... wanna help me build theories about their whereabouts?
target: 我有本剪贴簿，里面全是线索……要不要帮我推理一下，它们到底去哪儿了？

source: I'm game.
target: 我加入。

source: And so you spend the rest of the night thinking hard about where missing socks go.
target: 于是，接下来的时间，你们一直在苦思冥想，那些失踪的袜子究竟去哪儿了。

source: It could be France.
target: 可能是法国

source: Mixing clothes
target: 衣服混洗

source: Oof, mixing clothes is a huge taboo.
target: 哎呀，把衣服混在一起洗，那可是大忌。

source: I had no idea.
target: 还真不知道。

source: I've seen some shit, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... the results can be catastrophic.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我可是见过大场面的……后果简直是灾难。

source: Fools who thought wool sweaters and undies could use the same kind of cycle...
target: 有些傻子，以为羊毛衫和内裤能用同一种洗涤程序……

source: Hopeless bastards who washed light-colored and dark-colored clothes together, only to find the colors bled into each other...
target: 还有些没救的混蛋，把浅色衣服和深色衣服一起洗，结果全串色了……

source: Absolute (clothing) bloodbaths, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... tragedies burnt into my retinas forever.
target: 简直就是一场场（衣物的）血案，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……那些惨剧，永远烙在了我的视网膜里。

source: You make a laundromat sound like a battlefield.
target: 你把洗衣店说得像战场一样。

source: Well, in a way, it is.
target: 从某种意义上说,是的。

source: But you know what? I'm gonna let you in on a little secret:
target: 但是你知道吗? 我要告诉你一个小秘密:

source: Sometimes even I go there and take those reckless risks myself.
target: 有时我也会去冒这些风险

source: Really? Why?
target: 真的吗? 为什么?

source: There's thrill in taking the path less travelled.
target: 不走寻常路，才刺激。

source: The foolish can find the most unexpected victories through their unending ingenuity.
target: 傻瓜也能凭着无穷的创造力，赢下一场谁都想不到的胜利。

source: What if I made colors bleed... INTO A NEW VERY AWESOME COLOR?!
target: 万一，我能让串出来的颜色……变成一种全新的、超酷的颜色呢？！

source: A new very awesome color? No way!
target: 一种全新的、超酷的颜色？不会吧！

source: YES! LIKE... LIKE...
target: 没错！比如……比如……

source: ...BLURPLE!
target: ……蓝紫色！

source: Whaaaaaa...?! Imagine that... blurple...
target: 哇——？！想象一下……蓝紫色……

source: A washing machine can only dream of leaving a mark in the annals of color history.
target: 能在色彩史上留下一笔，是洗衣机梦寐以求的事。

source: I know you can do it, Dahlia. You're by far the washing machine I trust the most.
target: 达丽雅，我知道你能做到。你可是我最信任的洗衣机。

source: That's great to hear...
target: 听你这么说，真好……

source: Especially because I was about to suggest you forfeit all your clothes to me.
target: 尤其是，我刚想让你把身上的衣服全都交给我。

source: D-Dahlia!
target: 达、达丽雅！

source: Haha! I meant so we can wash them all together and search for new colors, my friend.
target: 哈哈！我是说，把它们一起洗，试着发现新颜色啊，朋友。

source: And so, you turn the night into an adventure of color exploration! You're a bit cold, though.
target: 于是，这一晚变成了一场探索色彩的冒险！不过，你有点冷。

source: Her favorite setting
target: 她最喜欢的洗涤模式

source: I FUCKING LOVE ALL MY SETTINGS!
target: 我他妈每一种模式都爱！

source: No favorites, then?
target: 所以，没有最喜欢的？

source: All of them are my favorite! Think of it this way: settings are like weapons. You have to choose the one that is most useful to defeat your enemy.
target: 全都是我的最爱！这么想吧：洗涤模式就像武器，你得挑最管用的那件，才能打败敌人。

source: Your enemy as in... stains?
target: 你的敌人是指……污渍？

source: Exactly. But what the best weapon (or setting) is depends on several factors:
target: 没错。不过，哪件武器（或者哪种模式）最合适，还得看几个因素：

source: How strong is your enemy? What terrain are you battling on? How quickly do you want to conquer them, and what are you willing to sacrifice for it?
target: 敌人有多强？在哪种地形上交战？你想多快征服它们，又愿意为此付出什么代价？
