target: 我做了个民调，问大家，人鱼王国的统治方式，最糟糕的地方是什么。

source: Here are some of the most popular answers:
target: 以下几项，提到的人最多：

source: "Public executions are not cool."
target: "公开处决不酷".

source: "Maybe stop the serfdom thing?"
target: “也许该废除农奴制了？”

source: "Lots of mass control through constant media propaganda."
target: “不停通过媒体宣传，控制民众。”

source: "Bad international relationships mostly due to violent invasion of foreign territories."
target: “暴力入侵外国领土，导致国际关系恶劣。”

source: "Ruling based on fear and hatred."
target: “靠恐惧和仇恨统治。”

source: There's quite a bit more, but these are at the top. Maybe I can use this data to run my village in a new way?
target: 还有不少，不过这些排在最前。也许，我能用这些数据，换种方式治理村庄？

source: I mean, it's nice that you're being more open to critiques.
target: 你愿意听取批评，是件好事。

source: Right? I'm the best!
target: 对吧? 我最厉害了!

source: We could even brainstorm some fun new measures to enact, so for once, these peasants don't fear their ruler, but love them.
target: 咱们甚至可以一起想些好玩的新政策，让这些农民难得不再害怕统治者，而是爱戴统治者。

source: Especially because their ruler is me, Miranda Vanderbilt, the most lovable of all rulers!
target: 尤其，他们的统治者可是我，米兰达·范德比尔特，所有统治者中最讨人喜欢的！

source: You make a good point.
target: 你讲的有道理

source: Do you have any ideas?
target: 你有什么想法吗?

source: Film a TV comedy where Miranda must share an apartment with 3 other merpeople. She'll be seen as likeable and down-to-earth!
target: 拍一部电视喜剧，让米兰达与另外三个人鱼合租。大家就会觉得，她亲切又接地气！

source: No more public executions! Executions will be held privately to respect people's privacy.
target: 别再公开处决了! 处决将私下举行,以尊重人们的隐私.

source: A 20-foot statue of Miranda, but with a twist: the statue is made of cake! Free cake for the people!
target: 一座二十英尺高的米兰达雕像，不过有个特别之处：整座都用蛋糕做！让百姓免费吃蛋糕！

source: Wow... a Vanderbilt presented as down-to-earth?
target: 哇……把范德比尔特家的人，塑造成接地气的形象？

source: Do people really like that?
target: 人们真的喜欢这样吗?

source: For the most part, yes.
target: 大多数人喜欢，没错。

source: But you want your ruler to be perfect and powerful and clearly superior to you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 可你总希望自己的统治者完美、强大，而且明显比自己优越，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: If you saw your ruler as basically the same as you, you might even think a revolution to take the rulers down is a feasible thing.
target: 要是觉得统治者也跟自己差不多，大家可能还会觉得，起来革命、推翻统治者，也不是做不到。

source: Quick idea: if you rule your kingdom right, maybe the people won't focus that much on the possibility of bringing you to the guillotine.
target: 我有个想法：要是你把王国治理好了，也许大家就不会老想着把你送上断头台。

source: Hmmm... it's an eccentric idea, but you might be onto something.
target: 嗯……想法有点古怪，不过，你也许有点道理。

source: I've seen peasants having strange fixations with fictional characters.
target: 我见过农民们莫名其妙地迷恋虚构人物。

source: We do that, yes.
target: 是，我们会这样。

source: Marvelous. We could totally write this TV show in such a way that I seem likeable and relatable... but still aspirational, so the peasants will look up to me.
target: 太好了。剧里可以把我写得亲切又让人共鸣，同时也让人憧憬，好让农民们仰慕我。

source: We could even give you some cool superpowers. Your character could read minds, so that the people avoided having bad thoughts about you.
target: 甚至可以给你的角色加点酷炫超能力。比如读心术，这样大家就不敢在心里说你坏话了。

source: Brilliant!
target: 厉害!

source: ...Wait.
target: ……等等。

source: Isn't this... propaganda?
target: 这难道不是... 宣传?

source: No, it's a fun TV comedy! I was thinking of calling it "Miranda: Out of Water". Or "All Hail Miranda".
target: 不是，是部好玩的电视喜剧！我想叫《米兰达上岸记》，或者《米兰达万岁》。

source: ...Yes, this is totally propaganda.
target: ……对，这绝对就是宣传。

source: Now that I think of it, you might be right.
target: 现在我想起来,你可能是对的。

source: I tend to be, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 我通常都是对的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Except for when I thought of asking you for advice.
target: 除了想找你出主意的时候。

source: You betrayed me AND broke my record of always being right. Shame on you!
target: 你不光背叛我，还打破了我永远正确的纪录！真该为自己感到羞耻！

source: Miranda calls a chariot to take her back to the Merkingdom. Some days later, she will start filming a TV comedy that's basically propaganda to promote that you're dumb. Not cool.
target: 米兰达叫来一辆战车，返回人鱼王国。几天后，她开始拍一部电视喜剧，基本就是用来宣传你有多蠢的。太不厚道了。

source: I'm unsure, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 我不确定,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: My instinct tells me that the issue people have with public executions doesn't come from the "public" part of it.
target: 直觉告诉我，大家对公开处决不满，问题大概不在“公开”上。

source: Well, privacy is an increasingly important matter for people these days!
target: 隐私对现在的人来说越来越重要了!

source: Look at how much everyone hates when their online personal data is used by big corporations!
target: 你看，大公司用大家的网上个人信息时，大家有多讨厌啊！

source: Do they hate that more than the notion of being executed by the government?
target: 难道，比起被政府处决，他们更讨厌这个？

source: Maybe!
target: 也许吧!

source: I still have the strange feeling that this isn't great advice, but one of those infamous times when you embrace sheer absurdity and only make a situation worse.
target: 我怎么觉得，这不是好建议，又是你那种出了名的胡闹：一门心思走荒谬路线，把事情弄得更糟。

source: I never do that!
target: 我从来没有这样做!

source: We all know you do that -- quite often if you ask me.
target: 大家都知道你会这样。要我说，次数还不少。

source: A barrage of flashbacks pass through your mind.
target: 一连串回忆闪过脑海。

source: You trying to turn a griffin into a plate of pasta and failing miserably...
target: 你试图把狮鹫变成一盘意面，结果惨败……

source: You trying to flood the sky by throwing buckets of water into the air...
target: 你往空中泼了一桶桶水，试图淹没天空……

source: You suggesting that Miranda should do private executions instead of public executions...
target: 你建议米兰达，把公开处决改成私下处决……

source: Wait, that one is happening right now.
target: 等等，这段就在现在。

source: No, yeah, this is definitely terrible advice. You were right.
target: 不，对，这绝对是个烂主意。你说得对。

source: I tend to be, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 我通常都是对的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Except for when I thought of asking you for advice.
target: 除了想找你出主意的时候。

source: You betrayed me AND broke my record of always being right. Shame on you!
target: 你不光背叛我，还打破了我永远正确的纪录！真该为自己感到羞耻！

source: Miranda calls a chariot to be taken back to the Merkingdom. She mentions adding you to the list of people who must eventually meet the gallows.
target: 米兰达叫来一辆战车，返回人鱼王国。她提到，打算把你加入迟早得上绞刑架的名单。

source: She tells you not to worry: because you're friends, your execution can be private. Huzzah!
target: 她还让你别担心：看在朋友的份上，处决你时，可以不公开。万岁！

source: What a wonderful idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! It has many of my favorite things:
target: 多么美妙的点子, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 它有很多我最喜欢的东西:

source: Cake, which I've grown to like since I've started eating foods by myself...
target: 蛋糕，自从开始亲自吃东西，我就越来越喜欢了……

source: Disproportionate solutions involving giant things...
target: 还有，动不动就搬出巨大的东西，把阵仗搞得比问题还大……

source: And my favorite thing of all: me!
target: 还有我最喜欢的东西: 我!

source: Of course!
target: 当然了!

source: Really, it's a magnificent idea. One of my first acts as ruler was to gift the peasants a forty-piece silverware set so we could have some common interests.
target: 说真的，这主意太棒了。我刚开始统治时，就送过农民们一套四十件的银餐具，好让大家有点共同爱好。

source: My advisors told me this seemed like a cruel joke, since the village was afflicted with famine.
target: 顾问们说，这简直像个残酷的玩笑，因为村里正在闹饥荒。

source: Apparently famine and having forty pieces of silverware don't mesh well together, who would've thought?
target: 原来，饥荒和四十件银餐具不太搭，谁能想到呢？

source: An immense, delicious cake would be a great first step to combat this famine, wouldn't it?
target: 用一块巨大的美味蛋糕，作为解决饥荒的第一步，肯定很棒，对吧？

source: Providing food tends to be a good measure against famine, yes.
target: 对，给人吃的，通常是个解决饥荒的好办法。

source: Huzzah!
target: 万岁!

source: Thanks a lot, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. How can I pay you back for such great advice?
target: 太感谢了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。这么好的建议，我该怎么报答你？

source: No payment needed, Miranda. But... I wouldn't say no to a piece of that giant cake...
target: 不用报答，米兰达。不过……要分我一块那个大蛋糕，我肯定不会拒绝……

source: Of course!
target: 当然了!

source: Although, you know you can always ask for a piece of the real Miranda-cake, don't you?
target: 不过，想尝一块真正的“米兰达蛋糕”，随时都可以向我开口，你知道吧？

source: The... what?!
target: 那个... 什麽?

source: Huzzah!
target: 万岁!

source: Her Recent Achievements
target: 她最近的成就

source: Hmmm... ah, yeah!
target: 嗯……啊，对了！

source: Recently I got the "Scroll for Mounts".
target: 最近我拿到了“坐骑卷轴”。

source: The... what now?
target: 什么……卷轴？

source: It's a powerful scroll that gives you a special skill for riding mounts.
target: 那是个强大的卷轴，能赋予你驾驭坐骑的特殊技能。

source: I had to visit a sanctuary in the mountains to get it, where I faced riding challenges while a wise monk reviewed my technique.
target: 为了拿到它，我去了山上的一处圣地，接受骑乘考验，还有位睿智的僧人检查我的技巧。

source: Aaravi... do you mean... you got your driver's license?
target: 阿拉维……你是说……你考到驾照了？

source: My driving what? No, no, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I told you: it's a magic scroll that gives you the skill to ride mounts... the "Scroll of Mounts"!
target: 驾驶什么？不，不，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，说了是魔法卷轴，能让你学会驾驭坐骑……“坐骑卷轴”！

source: (Pretty sure it's a driver's license.)
target: （我很确定，那就是驾照。）

source: The thing is, I crawl so many dungeons that I have quite a bit of loot, so I was thinking of getting myself a good mount.
target: 我刷过那么多地牢，攒了不少战利品，所以，想给自己弄个好坐骑。

source: Tell me, what would be a good mount for Aaravi Mishra?
target: 那说说，什么样的坐骑，才适合阿拉维·米什拉？

source: Good question...
target: 问得好

source: I value adaptability over speed, really. When I travel, it's less about being in a rush and more about going to faraway lands... sometimes inhospitable ones!
target: 说真的，我更看重适应能力，不是速度。我出远门，不是为了赶路，而是要去遥远的地方……有时候，环境还挺恶劣！

source: I need a good, reliable mount that doesn't require lots of maintenance. I adventure too much to spend much time and gold on the mount.
target: 我得有个可靠、又不用费心照料的好坐骑。冒险这么忙，没空往坐骑上砸太多时间和金币。

source: Ah! Extra points if I can put a cup holder on it. That's always useful.
target: 啊！要是还能装杯架，那就更加分了。这个总有用。

source: Can't adventure without a good cup of coffee at hand!
target: 冒险时，手边怎么能没有一杯好咖啡！

source: You know it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 还是你懂，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: Perfect, I think I know enough now. I will proceed to give you the best mount recommendation ever!
target: 好，我觉得信息够了。接下来，就给你推荐史上最棒的坐骑！

source: Whoa, that's bold of you! Let's raise the stakes: if your recommendation is bullshit, I will stab you in the leg and leave.
target: 哇，口气不小！那加点赌注：要是你推荐得狗屁不通，我就往你腿上捅一刀，然后走人。

source: Uh... okay? You search for the best mount suggestion on your phone...
target: 呃……好吧？你掏出手机，搜索最合适的坐骑……

source: Secretariat, a celebrity racehorse who remains the undefeated champion thanks to its strict keto diet and its daily dose of scenic strolls on the beach.
target: 秘书处，明星赛马。靠着严格的生酮饮食，以及每天在海滩欣赏美景的散步，始终保持不败。

source: Bisbaal, the Battle Boar! It's a seasoned, sturdy mount known for being "mad thicc".
target: 战斗野猪比斯巴尔！久经沙场、结实耐用，以“厚实得离谱”闻名。

source: Bigotes, the regular-sized rabbit. It's a very portable mount with the cutest whiskers.
target: 比戈特斯，一只普通大小的兔子。十分方便携带，胡须可爱极了。

source: Secrewhat now?
target: 什么……秘书？

source: Secretariat! You don't know about Secretariat?!
target: 秘书处！你居然不知道秘书处？！

source: My previous question sort of hints at that already.
target: 我之前的问题已经暗示了这一点。

source: Fair.
target: 也是。

source: Look, Secretariat is only the most wonderful racehorse ever. It has a luscious mane and the most handsome hooves in the world.
target: 秘书处可是史上最棒的赛马。鬃毛丰美，蹄子更是全世界最好看的。

source: Why do you have so many pics of this horse saved on your phone?
target: 你手机里怎么存了这么多这匹马的照片？

source: I'm a true Secretariat fan! I follow it on all its social media channels.
target: 我可是秘书处的忠实粉丝！它所有社交账号，我都关注了。

source: Recently its owner died in a mysterious accident, and now it's up for sale. It's our opportunity, Aaravi!
target: 最近，它主人在一场离奇事故里去世，现在它挂牌出售了。机会来了，阿拉维！

source: I dunno, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, this fancy-ass horse doesn't seem to be very low-maintenance...
target: 不好说，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这匹娇贵的马，可不像好养活的样子……

source: LOW-MAINTENANCE?! OF COURSE NOT!
target: 好养活？！当然不是！

source: Aaravi, if you want a true celebrity racehorse...
target: 阿拉维，要是你想要一匹真正的明星赛马……

source: (I don't.)
target: （我不想。）

source: ...you need to give your 100%.
target: ……就得投入百分之百的心力。

source: We're talking the right diet (which is keto for Secretariat)...
target: 先是正确的饮食（秘书处吃的是生酮餐）……

source: Perfect, a horse eating better than myself.
target: 好极了,一匹马吃得比我还好

source: ...scenic strolls to the beach (but is that a chore or a dream, amirite?)...
target: ……去海滩散步、欣赏美景（这算干活，还是美梦成真啊，对不对？）……

source: It's definitely a chore.
target: 绝对算干活。

source: ...and of course, three hours of hoof maintenance to ensure Secretariat always has the most handsomest hooves.
target: ……当然，还得花三个小时护理蹄子，保证秘书处的蹄子永远是最好看的。

source: Stop!
target: 停下来!

source: It's obvious you want to marry this horse or something. Don't offer to help me and then make it about you and your weird horse stuff.
target: 停！你分明就想跟这匹马结婚吧？别说是来帮我，结果全变成你跟马的怪癖。

source: I'm out. Feel free  to send me the RSVP when you have a date for the wedding with the horse.
target: 我走了。等你跟马定好婚期，尽管给我发请柬。

source: She leaves. You spend the rest of the night imagining what it'd be like to marry Secretariat. Look at those hooves!
target: 她走了。接下来的时间，你一直在想，跟秘书处结婚会是什么样。瞧瞧那些蹄子！

source: Ooooh, look at this bodacious boar...
target: 哦——看看这头神气的野猪……

source: Bisbaal, huh?
target: 比斯巴尔，是吧？

source: Yeah, it's even spelled with a fancy diaeresis, but my phone doesn't display it properly.
target: 对，名字里还特意加了个双点变音符，不过，我的手机显示不出来。

source: And by "your phone" we mean "this game". We can't support diaeresis, dammit.
target: 而“你的手机”，说的就是“这个游戏”。我们显示不了双点变音符，妈的。

source: But you can let your imagination fly and imagine there's a diaeresis in "Bisbaal". You can even be adventurous and put it over an unexpected letter. Go for it!
target: 不过，你可以发挥想象，想象“Bisbaal”里有个双点变音符。胆子大点，还能把它放在意想不到的字母上。尽管试！

source: Ooh la la! A Battle Boar with a fancy name? Sign me up!
target: 哦啦啦！一头名字这么讲究的战斗野猪？我选它！

source: The name is a homage to that famous bard that sang the much-more danceable version of "Ave Maria". Look it up!
target: 这是在致敬那位著名的吟游诗人，就是唱了更适合跳舞版《Ave Maria》的那位。可以去查查！

source: Okay, okay, enough about the name! Don't get me wrong, it's cool; but I am here to look for a good mount, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 好好好，名字说够了！别误会，名字是挺酷，可我是在找好坐骑，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Well, look no further!
target: 那就不用再找了！

source: Bisbaal is sturdy, big, and durable. Its thicc skin is perfect for resisting all sorts of terrains and temperatures. It can also survive attacks and other collisions.
target: 比斯巴尔又大又结实，特别耐用。厚实的皮肤，能应付各种地形和温度，挨打、碰撞也不在话下。

source: Hmmm, you're not wrong. Look at that big boar butt... you can surely put a cup holder there.
target: 嗯，说得没错。看看那大猪屁股……上面肯定能装个杯架。

source: I could fight while mounted AND drink my coffee? Now, that's something.
target: 一边骑着打架，还能一边喝咖啡？这才像话。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I think you nailed it here. Bisbaal could very well become my mount. I am in debt to you.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这回你推荐对了。比斯巴尔真能当我的坐骑。我欠你个人情。

source: You can pay me back by taking me for a ride on your battle boar.
target: 你可以带我骑你的战猪来报答我

source: Okay, it's a date!
target: 行，就当约会了！

source: A date?!
target: 约会?

source: I mean...! I... uh... hmpf... I JUST MEANT I'LL TAKE YOU ON A RIDE ON MY BATTLE BOAR, OKAY?! Make of it what you want!
target: 我是说……！我……呃……哼……我只是答应带你骑战斗野猪，行了吧？！爱怎么想怎么想！

source: Hehe... okay.
target: 嘿嘿……好。

source: (It's a date.)
target: （就是约会。）

source: You keep looking at pics of Bisbaal while Aaravi daydreams about the cool trips she'll take once she gets it.
target: 你继续看着比斯巴尔的照片，阿拉维则畅想着，等买到它，就要去哪些地方冒险。

source: ...What are you smoking?
target: ……你嗑了什么？

source: This is a regular-sized rabbit!
target: 这就是只普通大小的兔子！

source: First of all, there's no way a regular-sized rabbit is properly equipped to take me to every corner of the realm and survive all sorts of terrain.
target: 首先，这么大的兔子，哪可能带我走遍世界，还应付得了各种地形。

source: Second, and most important:
target: 第二,也是最重要的一点:

source: How the fuck I am supposed to ride that?
target: 我他妈怎么骑它？

source: You... sit on it?
target: 你……坐上去？

source: It's a regular-sized rabbit!
target: 它就是只普通大小的兔子！

source: Which makes it very portable and convenient. You can even switch roles every now and then and take it in your purse for a while. Cute!
target: 所以才方便携带啊。还可以时不时换换角色，把它装进手提包，带它走一段。多可爱！

source: It's not cute, goddammit; it's dumb. A regular-sized rabbit is not a ride!
target: 可爱个屁，是蠢！普通大小的兔子，可不能当坐骑！

source: Yes it is!
target: 它就是坐骑！

source: No, it is not!

target: 哇，所以你这几天才一直吃酸奶！

source: Huh? No, no. I had no idea about the prize.
target: 啊？没有没有，我根本不知道有奖。

source: I just like yogurt.
target: 我只是喜欢酸奶。

source: Ah, okay.
target: 啊，原来如此。

source: But, maaaaan... I have no idea what I'm supposed to do with 10,000 dollars.
target: 可问题是，伙计……这一万美元，我真不知道该怎么花。

source: Buy a yacht?
target: 买个游艇?

source: I don't think you can buy a yacht with 10,000 dollars.
target: 一万美元，应该买不了游艇吧。

source: See? I'm lost, dude.
target: 看吧？我完全没头绪，伙计。

source: Normally, I don't manage more than 30 dollars at the same time.
target: 平时我手头的钱，从来不超过三十美元。

source: Any clue what you'd like to get with that much money?
target: 那你有没有想过，拿这么多钱买点什么？

source: Hmmm...
target: 那个...

source: The classics: I want something that doesn't translate into responsibilities or stress.
target: 老规矩：买的东西，不能给我添责任或者压力。

source: No complicated stuff... no classy stuff... no ooh-la-là stuff...
target: 不要复杂的……不要高雅的……也不要那种“噢啦啦”的花哨玩意儿……

source: I'm a simple man, y'know?
target: 我是一个简单的人,你知道吗?

source: Taking notes here...
target: 记下了……

source: Ah! And not a goose! Goose bad.
target: 啊！还有，不能是鹅！鹅不好。

source: W-Why would you use 10,000 dollars to buy a single goose?
target: 为、为什么会花一万美元，就买一只鹅啊？

source: I don't know!
target: 我不知道！

source: Just not a goose, okay?
target: 反正别买鹅，好吗？

source: Then...
target: 那麽...

source: Easy: 10,000 one-dollar burgers.
target: 简单：一万个一美元汉堡。

source: Bet everything on red. You know what's better than 10,000 dollars? 20,000 DOLLARS!
target: 全押红色！知道什么比一万美元更好吗？两万美元！

source: A goose
target: 一只鹅

source: Hmmm, that's an intriguing idea...
target: 嗯,这是一个有趣的想法...

source: I do like one-dollar burgers.
target: 我喜欢一块钱的汉堡

source: And if my math isn't wrong... 10,000 dollars should... give-or-take... let me buy 10,000 one-dollar burgers.
target: 要是我没算错……一万美元应该……大概……能买一万个一美元汉堡。

source: I'm no scientist; but probably.
target: 我不是科学家,但可能吧

source: And you know what that is?
target: 你知道这是什么吗?

source: A lot of one-dollar burgers!
target: 很多一块钱的汉堡!

source: A whole lot! Om nom nom!
target: 超级多！啊呜啊呜！

source: Yes, dude... imagine that... I'd have a burger for every moment I needed one.
target: 对啊，伙计……想想看……以后我什么时候想吃汉堡，就什么时候有。

source: I never dreamed of living such a life of luxury... a life where I'd always have a burger in hand.
target: 我做梦也没想过，自己能过上这么奢侈的日子……手里永远有个汉堡。

source: What a gentleman dandy you'd be!
target: 那你可真是位阔绰的时髦绅士啊！

source: Totally. Let's not waste any more time, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: to the burger place!
target: 可不是。别浪费时间了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%：去汉堡店！

source: Wait... are you planning to buy all 10,000 burgers at once?
target: 等等……你是打算一次买齐一万个汉堡？

source: ...Yes?
Brian, they'd get bad in a couple days.
target: 布赖恩，那过个两天就坏了。

source: Just keep the money and have a sort of "burger fund".
target: 先把钱留着，当成一笔“汉堡基金”就行。

source: Dude, you have the smarts to manage money!
target: 伙计，你真有管钱的头脑！

source: What if you joined me? I can be the money-man; you'll be the brains.
target: 要不咱们合伙吧？我出钱，你动脑。

source: I'm in.
target: 算我一个。

source: And so you two go the rest stop's convenience store. You buy the first 2 of 10,000 burgers you'll be eating for the time being.
target: 于是，你们去了休息站的便利店。在接下来要吃的一万个汉堡里，你们先买了两个。

source: Whaaaaaaa--?
target: 什——么？

source: I told you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: no stress!
target: 我说了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%：不能有压力！

source: Sure, but what if you won?
target: 当然,但是如果你赢了呢?

source: That's the point! What if I won?!
target: 问题就在这儿！我要是赢了怎么办？！

source: I have no idea what to do with $10,000...
target: 我连一万美元该怎么花，都不知道……

source: ...imagine if I had $20,000!
target: ……你想想，要是变成两万美元！

source: I could lose too... I guess that'd make things easier. But it's too risky!
target: 也可能会输……那样应该就省事了。但太冒险了！

source: Brian... do you want to LOSE the $10,000?
target: 布赖恩……你想把这一万美元输掉吗？

source: I... guess not?
target: 我……应该不想吧？

source: See? This is a terrible idea. Complete LOSE-LOSE scenario.
target: 看吧？这主意太糟了。横竖都输。

source: I suppose we have... very different ideas of what'd constitute a WIN or a LOSS...
target: 看来，我们对什么叫赢、什么叫输……想得很不一样。

source: Yes. It might be better if we parted ways until I solve this...
target: 对。在我解决这个问题之前，咱们还是先分开吧……

source: Otherwise, you'll find a way to invest this money and make even more money.
target: 不然，你又会想出什么投资的办法，让这笔钱越变越多。

source: I can't have that.
target: 那可不行。

source: I must go now. Maybe I get lucky and find a man to sell me a $10,000 burrito, who knows...
target: 我得走了。说不定运气好，能碰到个人，卖我一个一万美元的墨西哥卷饼。谁知道呢……

source: Bye, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! Wish me luck!
target: 再见 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 祝我好运!

source: And so, Brian leaves. There he goes, that charming dumb zombie, probably on his way to waste $10,000 on something stupid.
target: 于是，布赖恩走了。这个可爱又傻乎乎的僵尸，大概正准备把一万美元，浪费在某样蠢东西上。

source: Noooooooooo, not the goose!
target: 不——要，不能是鹅！

source: It's the one thing I asked from you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我就提了这么一个要求啊！

source: I guess I was just intrigued... what's with the goose?
target: 我就是有点好奇……鹅到底怎么了？

source: Brian puts his hand over your mouth.
target: 布赖恩一把捂住了你的嘴。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, some questions are better left unanswered.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%有些问题最好不要回答。

source: Brian goes silent, his eyes locked on a fixed point, face frozen in a dreadful expression.
target: 布赖恩不再出声，双眼死死盯着某处，脸上凝固着惊恐的表情。

source: You can almost see visions of fire, screams, and a goose super-imposed in his eyes, as if a tragic flashback was replaying in his mind.
target: 你几乎能在他眼中，看见火焰、惨叫，还有一只鹅的影像交叠，仿佛某段惨痛回忆正在他脑海里重演。

source: Brian?
target: 布赖恩？

source: Sorry... I was gone for a second.
target: 对不起……刚才走神了一下。

source: You know? It's been a while already; but there are days when I feel as if I've never escaped...
target: 你知道吗？明明已经过去一阵了，可有些日子，我还是觉得自己从来没逃出去……

source: ...What?
target: 什麽?

source: The goose, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... the goose is always nearby...
target: 鹅, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... 鹅总是在附近...

source: I need to leave now... I can't stay at the same place for too long...
target: 我现在需要离开... 我不能在同一个地方呆太久...

source: Brian!
target: 布赖恩！

source: But it's too late. He stands up and leaves, running into the dark of the night.
target: 可已经太迟了。他站起身，转身跑进黑夜。

source: What the fuck?
target: 这他妈什么情况？

source: Changing the Merkingdom
target: 改变人鱼王国

source: Changing the Merkingdom? That's easier said than done!
target: 改变人鱼王国？说起来容易，做起来难！

source: Maybe; but if we don't challenge ourselves with the task, change might never happen!
target: 也许吧，可要是我们连试都不敢试，那就可能永远不会有改变！

source: You're not wrong, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 你没有错 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: But how do you bring change to a place so rooted in tradition and so uncritical of the Crown's unethical practices?
target: 可一个地方，传统根深蒂固，人们对王室那些不道德的做法又毫无质疑，该怎么改变呢？

source: With the power of dance!
target: 靠舞蹈的力量！

source: You're silly... but no, for real: how do we bring about change?
target: 你可真逗……不过说真的，我们该怎么推动变革？

source: I've discussed this topic with some like-minded peers in court.
target: 我和宫廷里几位志同道合的同僚，讨论过这个问题。

source: Navigating what we could do and what might happen is like travelling through a tortuous maze... which, more often than not, ends with our heads on a pike.
target: 想弄清能做什么、又会有什么后果，就像走进一座曲折的迷宫……而大多数路的尽头，都是我们的脑袋被插在长矛上。

source: Not ideal.
target: 不尽理想.

source: Not ideal indeed.
target: 实在不理想

source: Well, tell me what you've reflected on with these other people and let's work from there.
target: 那就说说你们都想过些什么，我们再接着想。

source: There's nothing to be lost by two dreamers just discussing how things could be better...
target: 两个怀抱理想的人，只是聊聊怎么让一切变得更好，又没什么损失……

source: Hmmm... well, it can't be a sudden change, that's for sure.
target: 嗯……首先，可以肯定，不能变得太突然。

source: It sounds ideal, but the Merkingdom isn't ready for change, and trying to apply it bluntly and suddenly won't have a lasting effect.
target: 骤然变革听着很美好，可人鱼王国还没做好准备。强硬地一蹴而就，也不会有长久的效果。

source: It needs to work long-term, gotcha.
target: 得从长远考虑，明白了。

source: We also can't fight back by sacrificing our own principles and using the same horrible tactics we despise...
target: 我们也不能牺牲自己的原则，用自己最鄙视的那些可怕手段去反抗……

source: Otherwise we could lose ourselves in this crusade... and what would be the point then?
target: 否则,我们会在这场战役中失去自我... 那又有什么意义呢?

source: I've gotta say, Adrien: this already sounded like a tough endeavor... and all these caveats aren't making it any easier!
target: 不得不说，阿德里安，这事本来就够难了……再加上这些限制，更难了！

source: No one said this was going to be easy...
target: 没人说这很容易...

source: ...but we can't give up.
target: 但我们不能放弃。

source: I trust that change is possible. I trust that the Merkingdom can be better.
target: 我相信改变是可能的。我相信，人鱼王国可以变得更好。

source: It can! But how could you bring about such change...?
target: 当然可以！可是，要怎样才能带来这样的改变呢……？

source: The people won't listen to dissidents... but what if you could find someone in a place of power who would listen to reason and become the face of change?
target: 民众听不进异议者的话……可要是能找到一位掌权的人，既听得进道理，又能站出来引领变革呢？

source: Don't overcomplicate it: go guillotine.
target: 别想那么复杂：上断头台。

source: You can't change the Merkingdom. Wisdom is accepting what you can't change. Apply for citizenship in Belgium, a place that's probably much nicer than the Merkingdom anyway.
target: 你改变不了人鱼王国。接受无法改变的事，才是智慧。去申请比利时国籍吧，反正那里大概比人鱼王国好多了。

source: Um... that's... not a farfetched strategy.
target: 嗯……这个策略……倒不是异想天开。

source: The biggest roadblock we face when deciding how to bring real, lasting change to the Merkingdom is how strong the Crown's grip over the people is.
target: 我们想给人鱼王国带来真正、持久的变革，最大的障碍，就是王室对民众的掌控太牢了。

source: They have mastered the art of propaganda, and they even weaponize religion expertly.
target: 他们深谙宣传之道，甚至能熟练地把宗教变成武器。

source: Most people are truly devoted to the Vanderbilts.
target: 大多数民众，都真心拥戴范德比尔特家族。

source: I mean... not that it matters... but they are a bunch of charming, sexy, powerful sisters...
target: 我是说……虽然这不是重点……可那几位姐妹，确实又迷人、又性感、又强大啊……

source: I may abhor their methods, but that doesn't mean I can disagree with you.
target: 我厌恶她们的手段，但你这话，我还真没法反驳。

source: The thing is, you're right: perhaps the most clever way of circumventing this problem is by not completely toppling the Vanderbilt regime.
target: 关键是，你说得对：要绕过这个难题，最聪明的办法，也许就是不把范德比尔特政权彻底推翻。

source: But... who could be our face for change?
target: 不过……谁能站出来引领这场变革呢？

source: I can't help but admire Bellanda's military prowess, but she has trained herself not to get too personal when waging war.
target: 贝兰达的军事才能，确实让我钦佩。可她已经训练得在打仗时，不带太多个人感情。

source: She sees an army, not the individuals who form its ranks.
target: 她眼里是一支军队，不是组成军队的一个个活人。

source: And Laudanda? She's playing the most complex game of chess in which we all are her pawns... she'd never accept change unless it directly benefitted her or the Crown.
target: 至于劳丹达？她下着一盘最复杂的棋，而我们全是她的棋子……除非能让她或王室直接获益，否则她绝不会接受变革。

source: What about Miranda?
target: 那米兰达呢？

source: Miranda?
target: 米兰达?

source: Yes, think about it: she was sent to study in the Monster Realm, making her the one least influenced by the Vanderbilt ways.
target: 对啊，你想想：她被送到怪物世界读书，受范德比尔特家那一套的影响最少。

source: And I've heard that she's recently started to question the ways of the Merkingdom!
target: 而且，我听说她最近已经开始质疑人鱼王国的做法了！

source: ...Really?
target: ...真的吗?

source: It does make sense... she's obnoxious, but Miranda is undoubtedly charming and easy to love...
target: 确实有道理……虽然她很招人烦，可米兰达无疑很有魅力，也很容易让人喜欢……

source: ...BY THE MERPEOPLE, THAT IS.
target: ……我是说，让人鱼民众喜欢。

source: See? It looks we have the seed of a plan for real change in the Merkingdom!
target: 看吧？我们好像已经有了个初步计划，能让人鱼王国真正发生改变！

source: Indeed, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. We can't rush this... it's still a delicate plan that should be executed perfectly.
target: 是的，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。这件事不能急……计划依然需要小心处理，执行更得完美无缺。

source: But I could bring this idea to the other people craving change down there.
target: 不过，我可以把这个想法，带给水下那些同样渴望变革的人。

source: I can't stress enough how grateful I am. Is there anything I can do for you?
target: 我实在是太感激了 有什么我可以帮你的吗?

source: Well, your company is more than enough, Adrien. Let's watch the night sky together, shall we?
target: 有你陪着就足够了，阿德里安。一起看夜空吧，好吗？

source: I'd love that.
target: 我很乐意

source: And so you do. Adrien is full of hope and excitement. Change might not happen soon... but now, it looks more possible than ever before.
target: 于是，你们一起仰望夜空。阿德里安满怀希望，激动不已。改变也许不会很快到来……但现在，它看起来比以往任何时候都更有可能。

source: Huzzah!
target: 万岁!

source: Um... but that would be... quite the sudden change.
target: 嗯……可是这样……变得也太突然了。

source: The suddenest of changes!
target: 最突然的变化!

source: Yet I made it quite clear that sudden changes are not good, ultimately.
target: 可我刚才说得很清楚，从长远看，骤然变革不是好事。

source: Oh, did you? I have a pretty short attention span.
target: 哦，你说过吗？我这人注意力不太持久。

source: ...Right.
target: 对

source: The thing is, if we execute the ones in power -- which is a tall order in and of itself... soon someone will crawl up to take their place, and nothing will change.
target: 问题是，就算我们处决了掌权者——光这件事本身就难得很——很快也会有别人爬上来取而代之，结果什么都没变。

source: Well...
target: 这个...

source: ...you could guillotine them too.
target: ……那就把他们也送上断头台。

source: Sure. Then, following the same rationale, someone else would take their place.
target: 当然。可照这个逻辑，又会有人来接替他们。

source: Maybe, but then you guillotine them too!
target: 可能吧，那就再把这些人送上断头台！

source: And should we keep doing this ad infinitum, or...?
target: 然后，我们就这样无穷无尽地继续下去，还是……？

source: Until the Merkingdom is the fairest, most headless kingdom in the whole realm!
target: 一直到人鱼王国成为整个世界里，最公正、最没有脑袋的王国！

source: I trust you can see the inefficacy of your proposal, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我相信你也看得出，这个提议行不通。

source: I do... it's just that I really like guillotines.
target: 我确实... 只是我真的很喜欢断头台

source: I hear you; but it's still a bad idea.
target: 我明白，可这依然不是个好主意。

source: Not to mention, it's basically jumping straight to using the same tactics the Crown uses.
target: 更别说，这根本就是直接用上了王室那一套手段。

source: I'm sure your intentions are good, but your advice is honestly terrible.
target: 我相信你是好意，可你的建议实在糟糕。

source: I must depart now... this conversation has reminded me of the urgency of my many ventures.
target: 我得告辞了……这次谈话提醒了我，手头许多事都得抓紧。

source: Farewell, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Keep trying your best to give actually useful advice.
target: 再会，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。继续努力，争取下次给出真正有用的建议。

source: Practice makes perfect!
target: 熟能生巧！

source: Adrien leaves, heading toward his next quest. You wish him the best... but it still tastes a bit sour, being a failure and all.
target: 阿德里安离开，踏上下一段征程。你祝他一切顺利……可毕竟这次搞砸了，心里还是有点不是滋味。

source: That sounds like giving up on the Merkingdom, though.
target: 可这听起来，就是放弃人鱼王国了。

source: It's not giving up! It's just re-locating your efforts to a more promising kingdom: Belgium.
target: 不是放弃！只是把你的努力，投入一个更有前途的王国：比利时。

source: Is Belgium even a kingdom?
target: 比利时也是王国吗？

source: As in, having a monarchy and all...?
target: 就是，也有君主制什么的……？

source: It is! Belgium is a hereditary parliamentary constitutional monarchy.
target: 没错! 比利时是世袭的议会君主立宪制国家.

source: Fine, but still, I told you: I want to change my motherland for the better.
target: 好吧，可我说了：我想让自己的祖国变得更好。

source: I refuse to give up on the Merkingdom.
target: 我绝不放弃人鱼王国。

source: But Belgium has tens of types of Belgian Waffles!
target: 但比利时有数十种比利时华夫饼!

source: BELGIAN WAFFLES, Adrien!
target: 比利时华夫饼啊，阿德里安！

source: Yes, I hear you, and yet...
target: 是，我听到了，可是……

source: Did you know Belgians invented French fries?
target: 你知道比利时人发明了薯条吗?

source: That can't be right.
target: 不对吧。

source: I know. The name sounds very French, but Belgians claim they invented French fries.
target: 我懂。名字听着很法国，可比利时人说，法式薯条是他们发明的。

source: And I, for one, believe them.
target: 反正，我信他们。

source: Stop, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 打住，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: I was clear in my quest for change, and here you are, trying to seduce me with these factoids about Belgium.
target: 我说得很清楚，我要的是变革，你却在这儿拿比利时的冷知识诱惑我。

source: Who are you? My friend, or some sort of influencer sponsored by the Belgian department of tourism?
target: 你到底是谁？我的朋友，还是比利时旅游部赞助的网红？

source: I must depart now, before your Belgian spell manages to charm me.
target: 趁你这比利时魔咒还没把我迷住，我得赶紧告辞。

source: Adrien leaves... probably not to go to Belgium.
target: 阿德里安走了……大概不是去比利时。

source: Fuck. You lost his chivalrous company... and you won't get the commission money the Belgian department of tourism promised you.
target: 操。你失去了这位骑士的陪伴……比利时旅游部答应给的佣金，也拿不到了。

source: Preparing for the Future
target: 筹备未来

source: Nah, Joy and Faith are the boring ones that do the planning and all that.
target: 才不呢，乔伊和信念女巫才是负责做计划、忙这忙那的无聊家伙。

source: Me? I've died three times already; who says I won't die a fourth time next week?
target: 我吗? 我已经死了三次了 谁说我下星期不会第四次死了?

source: Yikes, Hope...
target: 这话听着怪吓人的，希望女巫……

source: Hey, the facts speak for themselves!
target: 嘿，事实就摆在这儿！

source: Well, still!
target: 可就算这样……！

source: Still?
target: 就算这样，怎么了？

source: I mean... I don't want to sound morbid: but what if you DO die soon? Have you planned for that?
target: 我的意思是……我不是故意聊这么阴森的话题，可要是你真很快就死了呢？你为这事做过准备吗？

source: Dang, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! I didn't know you were this hardcore!
target: 哇，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！没想到你这么狠啊！

source: Oh, sorry, I didn't want to overstep.
target: 哦，对不起，我不是想冒犯你。

source: Don't sweat it... you're not wrong.
target: 别紧张……你说得没错。

source: I have this funny habit of dying, and it'd be very cool if I could leave something to the next Hope so she doesn't feel so lost or unready...
target: 我有个怪毛病，就是老死。要是能给下一任希望女巫留点东西，让她不至于那么迷茫、那么没准备，那倒挺酷的……

source: Whoa, that's a bit dark.
target: 哇，这话题有点沉重。

source: Dark, but necessary... but I'm still an awful planner...
target: 是沉重，可也得想……但我还是特别不会做计划……

source: But hey, you brought us here, so now you'll help me with this, right?
target: 不过，嘿，话题是你提的，现在得帮我想想了，对吧？

source: If that's what you want, I'm game.
target: 你想的话，我当然奉陪。

source: That's the spirit!
target: 这才对嘛！

source: It must be something actually useful, as in no sentimental bullshit.
target: 得是真正有用的东西，别搞那些煽情的屁话。

source: I want to help this hypothetical Hope... but at the same time it's a bit about me, y'know?
target: 我想帮到假设中的那位希望女巫……可同时，这事也跟我自己有关，懂吧？

source: How so?
target: 怎么说？

source: Well, this Hope will still be Hope. She will represent all of us Hopes!
target: 不管怎样，她还是希望女巫。她代表的，是我们所有历代希望女巫！

source: I worked too hard and kicked too much ass only for an uncool gal to mess that up.
target: 我拼死拼活，揍翻了那么多对手，可不能让个不酷的姑娘，把这一切全搞砸。

source: So my legacy should be a powerful message from beyond that tells the new Hope: "you'd better be cool".
target: 所以，我留下的东西得像从另一个世界传来的强硬宣言，告诉新任希望女巫：“你最好给我酷一点。”

source: Dang, who's the hardcore one now?
target: 嚯，现在是谁更狠啊？

source: I was born hardcore; I will die hardcore... and my next me should be hardcore too.
target: 我生来够狠，死也得够狠……下一个我，照样得狠。

source: The question is: are you truly hardcore enough?
target: 问题是:你真的够狠吗?

source: You brought up this weird topic, so it's time to put your money where your mouth is: gimme your best idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 这么怪的话题是你提的，该拿出真本事了：%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，把你最棒的点子说来听听。

source: Your iconic shoes, so she can learn to... walk in your shoes.
target: 留下你那双标志性的鞋，让她学着……穿上你的鞋，走过你走过的路。

source: Never trust anyone to be as cool as you... not even future you! Write a comprehensive style-book on the Hope brand.
target: 别指望谁都能跟你一样酷……哪怕是未来的你！给“希望女巫”这个品牌，写一份详尽的风格手册。

source: A bag of fortune cookies with mysterious nonsensical fortunes... just to fuck with her.
target: 留一袋幸运饼干，签语写得神神秘秘、莫名其妙……就为了耍耍她。

source: Wow...
That's like... super corny.
target: 这也……太老土了。

source: Which is a good thing?
target: 所以，是好事？

source: Nah.
target: 没有。

source: Aside from the fact that it's a cheesy-AF motivational quote...
target: 先不说，这句励志名言他妈的俗到家了……

source: ...the "metaphor" doesn't even hold.
target: ……就连这个“比喻”，也根本说不通。

source: Like, as charming as it sounds (which isn't much anyway), it actually means nothing.
target: 就算它听着挺动人——其实也没多动人——也根本没什么实际意义。

source: I am effectively just leaving her some shoes.
target: 说到底，我只是给她留了几双鞋。

source: I don't know, it sounded smart in my head.
target: 不知道啊，在我脑子里的时候，听着还挺聪明的。

source: Well, it sure didn't sound smart when it got out of your head, pal.
target: 可它一出你的脑子，就一点也不聪明了，朋友。

source: But hey, you tried!
target: 不过，嘿，至少你努力过了！

source: Here, have this.
target: 来,拿着这个

source: She puts something on your forehead and leaves into the dark of the night.
target: 她往你额头上贴了个东西，便走进夜色里。

source: When you check the thingie, it turns out to be a sticker depicting a smiling Hope saying "you tried!"
target: 你拿下来一看，原来是张贴纸：希望女巫笑眯眯地说着“你努力过了！”

source: You're onto something here.
target: 你这点子有门儿。

source: I am indeed very cool... maybe so cool that not even future me can match my coolness.
target: 我确实很酷……说不定酷到连未来的我，都赶不上。

source: It's a craft refined over the last four lifetimes.
target: 这可是我花了四辈子，才打磨出来的本事。

source: I can't risk the next Hope not taking on my coolness and having to start all over again.
target: 我可不能冒险，让下一任希望女巫接不住我的酷劲儿，结果一切又得从头来。

source: She should continue this saga of cool Hopes, starting where I left off.
target: 她得接着我走到的地方，继续谱写历代希望女巫的酷炫传奇。

source: Yeah, it's like they say: "on the shoulders of giants".
target: 是啊，就像那句话说的：“站在巨人的肩膀上”。

source: Except, I guess this giant is just four Hopes, one on top of the other.
target: 只不过，我猜这个巨人，是四个希望女巫，一个叠一个摞起来的。

source: Which, you must admit, sounds like a pretty cool giant.
target: 你得承认，这巨人听着就挺酷的。

source: It does, yes.
target: 没错,是的。

source: Look, I know this all sounds a bit silly, but for real:
target: 听着，我知道这听上去有点傻，可说真的：

source: It's frustrating to know I could die soon while fighting evil, and everything I built could suddenly turn into nothing.
target: 一想到自己可能很快就会在对抗邪恶时死去，辛苦建立的一切，也会突然化为乌有，真的很难受。

source: I made my peace with that when I joined the Coven. It is what it is.
target: 加入女巫会的时候，我就接受这件事了。事实就是这样。

source: But if I could pass the baton, so to speak...
target: 不过，如果能把接力棒传下去……

source: ...at least it wouldn't feel like building a house of cards only for a gust of wind to blow it all away forever.
target: ……至少就不会像用纸牌搭了间房，结果一阵风吹来，就永远什么都不剩了。

source: Yeah, I get it. I think we all want to leave this Earth feeling like we left something behind.
target: 嗯，我明白。我想，我们都希望离开这个世界时，觉得自己曾留下过什么。

source: Yes, like a style-book on the Hope brand.
target: 对，比如一本“希望女巫”品牌风格手册。

source: Goddess forbid the next Hope even consider wearing something that's not black or black-adjacent.
target: 女神保佑，可千万别让下一任希望女巫，动起穿黑色、近黑色以外衣服的念头。

source: The horror!
target: 那可太可怕了！

source: Right?
target: 对吧?

source: You spend the night writing a first draft of the style-book. It's a bonding experience that teaches you what Hope holds most dear about her own identity.
target: 这一晚，你们一起写下了风格手册的初稿。你们的关系更近了，你也了解了希望女巫最珍视的、自己身上的那些特质。

source: ...Why?
target: 为什么?

source: It'd be fun!
target: 会很有趣的!

source: Except it wouldn't?
target: 可一点也不好玩啊？

source: Also, what's the point at all?
target: 还有,有什么意义呢?

source: I want to leave some legacy to help future me...
target: 我想留点东西，帮帮未来的自己……

source: ...not some random fortunes to prank her.
target: ……不是留几条莫名其妙的签语，恶作剧整她。

source: One could say "beware of that which is blue".
target: 比如有一条可以写：“当心一切蓝色之物。”

source: She wouldn't know what the fuck this "blue danger" is, and she'd get frightened by all things blue!
target: 她哪知道这“蓝色危险”他妈的是什么，就会被所有蓝色的东西吓到！

source: Oh, and another one could say "NEVER VISIT FRANCE".
target: 哦，另一条可以写：“绝对别去法国。”

source: And she would be all like, "but why?", and maybe she was planning a trip to France, but then she wouldn't be so sure about it.
target: 她肯定会想：“可为什么啊？”说不定本来正计划去法国，这下就拿不准主意了。

source: Believe me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, all of this is way less funny than you think.
target: 相信我，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，这事远没有你想的那么好笑。

source: It's just dumb... and a bit annoying when I'm a fortune teller myself.
target: 就是蠢……而且我自己就是预言师，听着还有点烦。

source: Oh, right. Then I guess the prank wouldn't work.
target: 哦，对。那这恶作剧大概也骗不了她。

source: It wouldn't, no.
target: 不会的,不会的。

source: And... wait... I am having a vision of the future.
target: 还有……等等……我看到未来的景象了。

source: It's me... and I'm at risk... if I stay here any longer... I'm in danger... of listening to more of your dumb ideas.
target: 是我……我有危险……要是再待下去……我就有可能……听到你更多的蠢主意。

source: Dang, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... I can't take that risk. I'm sure you understand.
target: 唉，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……这个险我可冒不起。我相信你能理解。

source: Bye.
target: 再见。

source: She leaves into the dark of the night.
target: 她走入了黑暗的夜晚。

source: She was probably not wrong, as you had a couple more ideas for what the fortune cookies could say.
target: 她大概没说错，毕竟你还想了好几条，能写进幸运饼干里的签语。

source: His Boss
target: 他的老板

source: Oof, Mr. Pappas...
target: 唉，帕帕斯先生啊……

source: Not a fan, huh?
target: 看来不怎么喜欢他？

source: He makes me carry him on a big-ass throne; you tell me.
target: 他让我抬着他那张大得要命的宝座到处跑，你说呢？

source: Being the personal assistant for a good boss would be a dream come true.
target: 给一个好老板当私人助理，本来是我梦寐以求的事。

source: Not for a deranged man who's obsessed with shopping malls.
target: 可不是给一个满脑子购物中心的疯子当。

source: I'm sure there's a better boss out there for you. You'll meet them one day...
target: 你肯定能找到更好的老板。总有一天，你会遇到的……

source: ...and you'll be a boss/personal assistant match made in heaven!
target: ……到时候，你们就是老板和私人助理的天作之合！

source: In the meantime... Mr. Pappas it is...
target: 在那之前……也只能先跟着帕帕斯先生了……

source: He might be the worst boss of all time.
target: 他可能是有史以来最糟糕的老板

source: Always busting my balls with the dumbest, most useless tasks...
target: 总拿最蠢、最没用的差事烦我，烦得我蛋疼……

source: Hmmm... can't you bust his balls in return? Even a bit?
target: 嗯……那你不能也让他蛋疼一下？哪怕一点？

source: I don't want to have anything to do with his balls!
target: 我不想跟他的蛋蛋有任何关系!

source: Nah, I meant like pulling some sort of prank on him.
target: 不是，我是说，比如搞个恶作剧整整他。

source: A prank you say... that's not a half-bad idea...
target: 你说恶作剧啊……这主意倒还不错……

source: Yes! Something big enough that you can find some solace in knowing you had your payback.
target: 对！搞个够大的，让你一想到自己报了仇，心里就舒坦。

source: Yes... yes... and yet not so big that it's outright absurd or makes me invest too much into it...
target: 对……对……可也不能大到离谱，或者得让我搭进去太多……

source: The perfect prank balance!
target: 找到恶作剧的完美平衡！

source: (If only Polly and Scott aimed for that...)
target: （要是波莉和斯科特也肯追求一下这个就好了……）

source: Well, I think I can give this idea of yours a chance...
target: 嗯，你这主意，我可以试试……

source: Let's just make sure the prank can't be tracked back to me, so I don't get fired!
target: 不过得确保，恶作剧不会查到我头上，这样我才不会被炒鱿鱼！

source: Right! Haha! No pressure at all!
target: 没错！哈哈！一点压力都没有！

source: So, what should this prank be?
target: 那么,这个恶作剧应该是什么?

source: Ehhhhh...
Put on a wig and marry Mr. Pappas. After 30 years of marriage (and 2 children) you can remove your wig (and your children's wigs) to reveal the ruse! Sike!
target: 戴上假发，和帕帕斯先生结婚。等结婚三十年、有了两个孩子之后，再摘下你的假发——还有孩子们的假发——揭晓骗局！骗你的啦！

source: Fart cushion on Mr. Pappas' throne. A classic.
target: 往帕帕斯先生的宝座上放个放屁坐垫。经典。

source: Start a rumor that there's a wildcat loose in the office. After a month of that, you can safely take a shit on Mr. Pappas' desk and pin it on the wildcat.
target: 先放出风声，说办公室里有只野猫乱窜。过一个月，你就可以放心地在帕帕斯先生桌上拉一泡，再甩锅给野猫。

source: ...How would that even work?
target: ……这到底要怎么操作？

source: Like... are the children actors? Why do they wear wigs at all? How is "30 years of marriage" not "investing too much"?
target: 比如……孩子是演员吗？他们为什么也要戴假发？“结婚三十年”，怎么就不算“搭进去太多”了？

source: ...Well?
target: ……说呀？

source: ...Look! I just wanted to say something silly! It's my whole thing!
target: ……听着！我就是想说点傻话！我一向就这样！

source: It sounded fun in my head!
target: 在我脑子里的时候，听着挺好玩的啊！

source: Ehm.... I should leave now.
target: 额... 我该走了

source: ...To buy a wig?
target: ...买个假发?

source: Finn slowly stands up and walks into the dark of the night, maybe never to be seen again.
target: 芬恩慢慢地站起,走入了夜晚的黑暗,也许再也见不到了.

source: It did sound fun in your head, goddammit!
target: 可它在你脑子里的时候，明明很好玩啊，他妈的！

source: ...Dude, I'm literally the one who carries that throne everywhere.
target: ……伙计，天天抬着那张宝座到处走的，就是我。

source: I'd be the prime suspect.
target: 我会是首要嫌疑人。

source: But it makes fart noises!
target: 但它会发出放屁的声音!

source: Look, let me give you a list of reasons why this is a bad idea:
target: 听着,我给你一份清单 说明为什么这是个坏主意:

source: Firstly, it's a childish prank. It might give satisfaction to an eight year old, but not to me.
target: 第一，这恶作剧太幼稚。八岁小孩可能会觉得过瘾，我不会。

source: Secondly, as stated, it'd frame me almost instantly.
target: 第二，刚说了，几乎立刻就能查到我头上。

source: Thirdly, Mr. Pappas already farts quite often when I'm carrying him on his throne.
target: 第三，我抬着帕帕斯先生和他的宝座时，他本来就没少放屁。

source: I suspect he does it as a fucked-up power move.
target: 我怀疑他是在用这种操蛋的方式，显摆自己有权势。

source: Yikes.
target: 唉哟!

source: Yeah, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%: very yikes.
target: 是啊，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，特别糟心。

source: And that's not even mentioning the worst part of this plan of yours.
target: 而这，还没说到你这计划最糟的地方。

source: It makes it quite obvious who put this fart cushion here when I sat on the bench earlier.
target: 我刚才往长椅上一坐，就坐到了放屁坐垫。现在可太明显了，是谁放的。

source: ...It's fun!
target: ...这很有趣!

source: It's not.
target: 不好玩。

source: He leaves into the dark of the night, leaving you alone there.
target: 他走进夜色，留下你孤零零一个。

source: No one understands your refined sense of comedy!
target: 根本没人懂你高雅的幽默感！

source: Hmmm...
target: 那个...

source: It's a bit absurd... but not too much.
target: 是有点荒唐……但不算过头。

source: It's not like you're suggesting to prank-marry him while wearing a wig.
target: 又不是让你戴着假发跟他结婚，拿这个当恶作剧。

source: Hehe... of course!
target: 嘿嘿……那当然！

source: (It's not as if I was considering an idea like that at all...)
target: （我才没有考虑过这种点子呢……）

source: Sure, the setup will take some time, but not a lot... and it will clear me from any suspicion.
target: 前期铺垫是得花点时间，不过也不算多……而且能洗清我的嫌疑。

source: Dare I say... this is the perfect crime?
target: 我敢说... 这是完美的犯罪?

source: The perfect prank!
target: 完美的恶作剧!

source: Fuckin' Mr. Pappas... it already feels great to know he doesn't suspect the shitstorm that's coming...
target: 操蛋的帕帕斯先生……一想到他对即将降临的腥风屎雨，还毫不知情，我就已经爽了……

source: Hehe... shitstorm...
target: 嘿嘿……屎雨……

source: The only loose end is the shit pointing in my direction.
target: 唯一的破绽，就是那坨屎可能会暴露是我干的。

source: But that has an easy solution: you need to follow a similar diet to that of a wildcat, so the story holds.
target: 这个好解决：你照着野猫的食谱吃，就能把故事圆上了。

source: Genius!
target: 天才！

source: ...Do you think wildcats eat spaghetti? I really like spaghetti.
target: 你觉得野猫会吃意大利面吗? 我真的很喜欢意大利面

source: Only one way to find out!
target: 只有一个办法能查出来!

source: You search online for info about wildcats, and start scribbling the plans for this formidable prank.
target: 你上网查起野猫的资料，并动笔草拟这个了不起的恶作剧计划。

source: Will it work? Who knows! But for the time being, you and Finn have a fun time together.
target: 能成吗？谁知道！反正此时此刻，你和芬恩一起玩得挺开心。

source: Applying for the cult
target: 申请加入教团

source: You wanna be in my cult? Really?
target: 你想加入我的教团？真的？

source: Sure, why not? We're already friends, so the natural next step would be to pledge my eternal devotion to you.
target: 当然，为什么不呢？咱们都已经是朋友了，顺理成章的下一步，不就是向你献上永恒的忠诚吗？

source: You have... a very intense view of friendships, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 你对友谊的理解……有点太热烈了，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: That's me!
target: 这就是我!

source: But I mean... are you sure you're cut out for the cultist lifestyle?
target: 不过，我是说……你确定自己适合当教徒吗？

source: You're so... independent.
target: 你这么... 独立。

source: That's not true! I can depend! I'd make a great cultist!
target: 才不是！我也可以依赖别人啊！我肯定能当个优秀的教徒！

source: Non-related question: what makes a good cultist?
target: 顺便问个不相干的问题：好教徒得具备什么条件？

source: Well, you gotta bring some value to the cult, y'know? Like: are you incredibly faithful? Do you have strong constitution? Are you OK eating poop?
target: 嗯，你总得给教团带来点价值，对吧？比如，你够虔诚吗？体格够强壮吗？能接受吃屎吗？

source: ...what was that last one?
target: ...那最后一个是什么?

source: Yeah, I know how it sounds. But hey, the cult life is hard: there's days when there's too little food and too much poop.
target: 对，我知道这话听着不太对劲。可教团生活不容易啊，有时候就是饭太少，屎太多。

source: And it's in those days when you feel blessed of having some those weirdos around.

source: Let's just sleep in the car and call it a night, yeah?
target: 我们睡在车里吧 今晚就到此为止 好吗?

source: Gotcha!
target: 明白！

source: You spend the night crammed in the car together.
target: 你们一起挤在车里过了一夜。

source: Something is off.
target: 有点不对劲

source: Finally! A rest stop! I need to lie down for a bit. These last few days have been intense.
target: 终于！休息站！我得躺会儿。这几天可真够折腾的。

source: Empty? Again?
target: 又是空的？

source: What if we turn around? We might just be going in the wrong direction.
target: 要不掉头？说不定我们只是走错方向了。

source: I don't know, buddy. Maybe we can't find another place that's less... fucked-up.
target: 不知道啊，伙计。也许我们找不到一个没这么……操蛋的地方。

source: But if we turn back? We know for sure that there's a bunch of fucked-up places waiting for us.
target: 可要是回头呢？那就能确定，有一堆操蛋的地方等着我们。

source: That's true...
target: 这是真的...

source: I don't know if I can take another round of visiting those places all over again.
target: 我不知道我能不能再去一次那些地方

source: But what if we're like... like, in the eye of a storm, Polly? What if all the paths we can take are wrong choices?
target: 可波莉，要是我们就像……就像在风暴眼里呢？要是往哪走，都选错了呢？

source: ...Let's cross our fingers and hope that's not the case, Scott.
target: ……只能祈祷不是这样了，斯科特。

source: Well, you know what? Even if it is, at least we're together, bros!
target: 你知道吗? 就算是,至少我们在一起,兄弟!

source: Yeah, you're right.
target: 是啊,你说得对。

source: (Let's just hope we're not in the eye of a fucking storm...)
target: （只希望我们没在什么他妈的风暴眼里……）

source: So, should we keep driving forward, then?
target: 那就继续往前开？

source: Hmmm... yeah, let's do that.
target: 嗯……好，就这样吧。

source: Perfect! Better get some rest, then!
target: 太好了！那赶紧休息吧！

source: Yes. Tomorrow might be a long day.
target: 对 明天可能会是漫长的一天。

source: And so you all go to sleep. You try not to think too much about all this.
target: 于是，你们都去睡了。你尽量不去多想这一切。

source: Why is all this happening...?
target: 为什么会发生这一切……？

source: Well, you're only supposed to drive until you either lose or reach a Destination. But you're not doing either this time.
target: 嗯，按原本的设计，你只需要一直开车，直到失败，或者抵达一个目的地。可这次，你两个都没选。

source: We didn't count on you going for longer than eight weeks or so.
target: 我们原以为，你顶多也就跑上八周左右。

source: So, I imagine the game is starting to malfunction because you're pushing it to its limits.
target: 所以,我想这个游戏开始出故障了 因为你把它推到了极限。

source: ...Game?
target: ……游戏？

source: Ah, yes: this is all a game.
target: 啊,是的,这是一场游戏。

source: I guess there's no point in hiding it now. You've come to this very same realization yourself a few times in the past.
target: 我想，现在也没必要瞒着了。以前，你也有好几次自己意识到了这一点。

source: It always disrupts things a bit...
target: 每次都会让情况有点乱……

source: What...?
Sorry... this is probably a tad overwhelming.
target: 抱歉……这信息量大概有点让你招架不住。

source: Normally, the loop ends and resets, and everything goes back to normal.
target: 通常，循环结束、重置，一切就恢复正常了。

source: The problem now is that you're not ending the loop. Some other loops have even been created by these errors, and they are now overlapping with this one.
target: 现在的问题是，你迟迟没结束循环。这些错误甚至还生成了别的循环，跟当前这个重叠在一起。

source: You're overtaxing the system, and the malfunctions are spreading exponentially.
target: 系统已经超负荷了，故障还在以指数级的速度扩散。

source: I don't know: fuck up your resources, reach a Destination...
target: 我也不知道该怎么说：把资源耗到完蛋，或者抵达一个目的地……

source: Just end the loop, okay?
target: 停止循环,好吗?

source: So, if this is a game...
target: 所以,如果这是个游戏...

source: Does that mean you are...?
target: 也就是说你是... ?

source: Yes.
target: 对

source: And we just keep going on the road trip in repeating loops...?
target: 所以，我们就是一遍又一遍地循环，继续这趟公路旅行……？

source: Yes, you do.
target: 对，就是这样。

source: What's the point of everything? Why...?
target: 那这一切有什么意义？为什么……？

source: ...I don't even know where to start.
target: 我甚至不知道从哪里开始。

source: It's okay.
target: 没关系。

source: I can imagine this is a lot to take in.
target: 我能想象，这些事确实很难一下子接受。

source: At least the road trip has been nice, hasn't it?
target: 至少这趟公路旅行很愉快,不是吗?

source: (Up until it all went to shit...)
target: (直到一切都变得一团糟... )

source: Yeah, we tried to make it nice... chaotic, but in a fun way. Good memories, you know?
target: 嗯，我们努力把它写得愉快……乱归乱，但乱得好玩。留点美好的回忆，你懂的。

source: Yeah. Good memories...
target: 对 美好的回忆...

source: The sky looks nice tonight, doesn't it?
target: 今晚的天空挺美的，是吧？

source: I guess it does, yeah...
target: 嗯，我想是的……

source: What's happening to Scott?
target: 斯科特怎么了？

source: Hmmm... it's hard to tell.
target: 那个... 很难说

source: The system is using most of its processing power to deal with all of these malfunctions.
target: 该系统正在利用其大部分的处理能力来处理所有这些故障.

source: My guess is Scott is subconsciously forfeiting most of his internal processes so the system can deal with this whole mess.
target: 我猜，斯科特在无意识地停掉自己大部分内部运算，好让系统有余力，处理眼前这堆烂摊子。

source: He truly is a good boy, isn't he?
target: 他真的是个好孩子,不是吗?

source: Yeah, that's Scott for you.
target: 嗯，他就是这样的斯科特。

source: But as a result, he might be running his core processes and character cornerstones only...
target: 可这样一来，他可能只剩核心运算，以及构成人物的基本特质还在运行……

source: ...becoming the simplest expression of what Scott is meant to be.
target: ……逐渐变成了最简单、最原初的那个斯科特。

source: Character cornerstones?
target: 人物的基本特质？

source: Well, characters are a complex thing. You develop one cornerstone first... a sort of thematic pillar. Then you build a few more...
target: 角色其实很复杂。先确立一个基本特质……像一根支撑主题的柱子。接着，再添上几根……

source: ...then it's a snowball effect: the character starts to get fleshed out from all those pillars.
target: ……然后就像滚雪球，围绕这些支柱，人物会一点点变得丰满。

source: And thus, Scott is slowly regressing to his main cornerstone.
target: 而斯科特，现在正慢慢退回最核心的那个基本特质。

source: What would that be?
target: 那会是什么?

source: I guess you'll find out if you all keep going.
target: 我想，如果你们继续走下去，就会知道了。

source: Is he in danger, or...?
target: 他有危险吗 还是... ?

source: No. I'm quite sure things will go back to normal once we solve all this malfunctioning.
target: 没有。 我敢肯定,一旦我们解决了这些故障,事情就会恢复正常。

source: But you all need to end the loop, Polly.
target: 不过，波莉，你们得结束这次循环。

source: Have you looked at that? What the fuck is it?
target: 你看到那个了吗？那他妈的是什么？

source: The system is cannibalizing itself, it seems.
target: 看来这个系统正在吞噬自己

source: It's doing all kinds of somersaults to avoid completely imploding.
target: 它在拼命折腾，想尽办法，不让自己彻底崩溃。

source: It looks intense; almost beautiful.
target: 看着真震撼，甚至有点美。

source: It looks dangerous, and imminent. You have to end the loop.
target: 看着很危险，而且就快撑不住了。你们必须结束循环。

source: That sanctuary was fucked up, man.
target: 那个避难所，真他妈邪门。

source: All my suffering is... what? A narrative device? My character's cornerstone? A twist?
target: 我受过的所有苦，都是……什么？一种叙事手段？我这个角色的基本特质？还是剧情转折？

source: Not exactly.
target: 不尽然。

source: The way I wrote you, your tragedy isn't supposed to be your cornerstone, Polly.
target: 在我写下的你身上，悲剧不该是最核心的特质，波莉。

source: If anything, it's what comes next: how you always choose to embrace life, no matter what curveball it throws you.
target: 真要说的话，核心是悲剧之后的事：不管生活丢来什么意外，你总会选择拥抱它。

source: First of all: cheesy.
target: 首先：真俗。

source: Second: it's all nice and positive; but it still stings when you're on my end.
target: 其次：说得是挺美好、挺积极，可站在我这边，还是会疼。

source: I'm not arguing with that. But you know conflict is also part of fiction.
target: 这一点，我不否认。不过，你也知道，故事里总会有冲突。

source: Why are we even arguing, anyway? What's the point of these conversations when this is all just code and script?
target: 不过，我们干嘛还在争这个？既然一切都只是代码和剧本，这些对话又有什么意义？

source: Look, I'm not gonna pretend there isn't a script behind all this. There is one.
target: 听着，我不会假装，这一切背后没有剧本。确实有。

source: But when you create a character, it soon grows past its cornerstones. It's almost as if you set them free.
target: 可当你创造一个角色，很快，她就会超出最初的设定。就好像你给了她自由。

source: Yes, I do write your words; but while writing you, I also wonder to myself, "What would Polly do? What would she say?"
target: 是，台词是我写的。可写你的时候，我也会问自己：“波莉会怎么做？她会说什么？”

source: It's like an object you've set into motion, you know?
target: 就像你推了一个物体，让它动起来，懂吗？

source: Once it's moving, you're not necessarily applying force anymore, and yet they keep moving.
target: 它一旦动起来，就算你不再施力，它也会继续往前。

source: I can imagine where you may be headed, but ultimately I don't entirely know.
target: 我能想象，你可能会走向哪里，可说到底，我也不完全知道。

source: Like... a road trip where you don't know what destination you're headed for.
target: 就像……一趟公路旅行，你不知道自己会去哪个目的地。

source: Oh, shut up!
target: 哦,闭嘴!

source: My point is you can be fictional and still, in a way, be real.
target: 我想说的是，你可以是虚构的，同时又在某种意义上，真实地存在。

source: You're made of pieces of myself and people I love. Traits, beliefs, anecdotes...
target: 你身上有我，也有我爱的人。一些性格、信念，还有我们经历过的事……

source: I've seen the sun rise after a party, and for a moment I set all my worries aside and just thought, "Fuck, life's good."
target: 我也曾在派对后看着太阳升起。有那么一刻，我把所有烦恼抛到一边，只想着：“操，活着真好。”

source: And that's you.
target: 这就是你。

source: Now people will get to meet you, and I wish... I trust that some people will look at life differently thanks to you.
target: 现在，大家都会认识你。而我希望……我相信，有些人会因为你，换一种眼光看待生活。

source: That effect will be very real.
target: 这种影响，会是真实的。

source: I wanna think that after this, there's a Polly who stays in these stories: having misadventures and creating more good memories.
target: 我愿意相信，在这之后，会有一个波莉，留在这些故事里：一路闯祸，一路创造更多美好的回忆。

source: But there's another Polly, one that goes beyond the story, beyond the game: the Polly that stays in motion even after I'm gone.
target: 可还有另一个波莉，会走出故事，走出游戏。即便我不在了，她也会继续往前。

source: You asked why we have these conversations.
target: 你问我，为什么要有这些对话。

source: To me? I think these conversations are about reflecting on the meaning and purpose of the characters I create; where they come from and where they go.
target: 对我来说？我想，这是在思考，我创造的角色有什么意义，为什么存在。他们从哪里来，又会去向哪里。

source: To you? I sincerely don't know.
target: 对你来说？说真的，我也不知道。

source: I'm sorry I can't give you better answers.
target: 对不起,我不能给你更好的答案。

source: To the Polly who will stay, I can only do my best to write you faithfully and with care.
target: 对于会留下的那个波莉，我能做的，只有尽力忠实、用心地写好你。

source: To the Polly who will go... wherever you go, I'll be rooting for you.
target: 对于会走出去的那个波莉……不管你去哪里，我都会为你加油。
